import os
import re
import asyncio
import shlex
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Set
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from hive_mind.agent_sdk.base_agent import AgentTool

class ExecTool(AgentTool):
    """
    Tool for executing shell commands in a sandboxed environment
    """
    
    # Set of potentially dangerous commands that are blocked
    # This is not exhaustive and should be expanded based on security needs
    BLOCKED_COMMANDS = {
        "rm", "rmdir", "del", "format", "mkfs", 
        "dd", "chmod", "chown", "sudo", "su", 
        "passwd", "mount", "umount", "shutdown", "reboot"
    }
    
    # Command pattern blocklist (regex patterns)
    BLOCKED_PATTERNS = [
        r">(.*)",         # Output redirection
        r">>(.*)",        # Append redirection
        r"<(.*)",         # Input redirection
        r"\|(.*)",        # Pipe (can be allowed for specific commands)
        r"&$",            # Background execution
        r";(.*)",         # Command chaining
        r"`(.*)`",        # Command substitution
        r"\$\((.*)\)"     # Command substitution
    ]
    
    def __init__(self, workspace_path: str, allowed_commands: Optional[Set[str]] = None):
        """
        Initialize the ExecTool with a workspace path and allowed commands
        
        Args:
            workspace_path: Base directory for command execution
            allowed_commands: Set of commands that are explicitly allowed
        """
        super().__init__(
            name="exec_tool",
            description="Execute shell commands in the workspace",
            parameters={
                "command": "The command to execute",
                "timeout": "Timeout in seconds (default: 30)"
            }
        )
        self.workspace_path = Path(workspace_path)
        self.allowed_commands = allowed_commands or {
            "ls", "dir", "cd", "pwd", "echo", "cat", "more", 
            "head", "tail", "find", "grep", "mkdir", "touch", 
            "python", "pip", "git", "npm", "node"
        }
        
        # Ensure workspace directory exists
        os.makedirs(self.workspace_path, exist_ok=True)
    
    async def execute(self, command: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute a shell command
        
        Args:
            command: Command to execute
            timeout: Maximum execution time in seconds
            
        Returns:
            A dictionary with the command output
        """
        # Verify the command is safe to execute
        validation_result = self._validate_command(command)
        if not validation_result["valid"]:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": validation_result["reason"]
            }
            
        try:
            # Create a process to execute the command
            proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_shell(
                command,
                stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
                cwd=str(self.workspace_path)
            )
            
            # Wait for the process to complete with timeout
            try:
                stdout, stderr = await asyncio.wait_for(proc.communicate(), timeout)
                
                # Decode output
                stdout_str = stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
                stderr_str = stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
                
                return {
                    "success": proc.returncode == 0,
                    "exit_code": proc.returncode,
                    "stdout": stdout_str,
                    "stderr": stderr_str
                }
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                # Kill the process if it times out
                try:
                    proc.kill()
                except:
                    pass
                    
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "error": f"Command timed out after {timeout} seconds"
                }
                
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Error executing command: {str(e)}"
            }
    
    def _validate_command(self, command: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Validate that a command is safe to execute
        
        Args:
            command: The command to validate
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with validation result
        """
        # Split the command to get the base command
        try:
            # Get the base command
            base_command = shlex.split(command)[0]
            
            # Check if it's in the blocked commands list
            if base_command in self.BLOCKED_COMMANDS:
                return {
                    "valid": False,
                    "reason": f"Command '{base_command}' is not allowed for security reasons"
                }
                
            # Check if it's not in the allowed commands list
            if base_command not in self.allowed_commands:
                return {
                    "valid": False,
                    "reason": f"Command '{base_command}' is not in the allowed commands list"
                }
                
            # Check for blocked patterns
            for pattern in self.BLOCKED_PATTERNS:
                if re.search(pattern, command):
                    return {
                        "valid": False,
                        "reason": f"Command contains blocked pattern: {pattern}"
                    }
                    
            # If all checks pass, the command is valid
            return {
                "valid": True
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "valid": False,
                "reason": f"Error parsing command: {str(e)}"
            }

import os
import json
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
import aiofiles
from pathlib import Path

from hive_mind.agent_sdk.base_agent import AgentTool

class FileTool(AgentTool):
    """
    Tool for working with files in the agent workspace
    """
    
    def __init__(self, workspace_path: str):
        """
        Initialize the FileTool with a workspace path
        
        Args:
            workspace_path: Base directory for file operations
        """
        super().__init__(
            name="file_tool",
            description="Read, write, and manipulate files in the workspace",
            parameters={
                "action": "The action to perform (read, write, list, exists, delete)",
                "path": "The path to the file or directory, relative to the workspace",
                "content": "The content to write (for write action only)",
                "overwrite": "Whether to overwrite existing files (for write action only)"
            }
        )
        self.workspace_path = Path(workspace_path)
        
        # Ensure workspace directory exists
        os.makedirs(self.workspace_path, exist_ok=True)
    
    async def execute(self, 
                    action: str, 
                    path: str, 
                    content: Optional[str] = None,
                    overwrite: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute file operations
        
        Args:
            action: The action to perform (read, write, list, exists, delete)
            path: The path to the file or directory
            content: The content to write (for write action only)
            overwrite: Whether to overwrite existing files (for write action only)
            
        Returns:
            A dictionary with the operation result
        """
        # Ensure the path doesn't try to escape the workspace
        full_path = self._get_safe_path(path)
        
        try:
            if action == "read":
                return await self._read_file(full_path)
            elif action == "write":
                return await self._write_file(full_path, content, overwrite)
            elif action == "list":
                return await self._list_files(full_path)
            elif action == "exists":
                return self._file_exists(full_path)
            elif action == "delete":
                return await self._delete_file(full_path)
            else:
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "error": f"Unknown action: {action}"
                }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": str(e)
            }
    
    def _get_safe_path(self, path: str) -> Path:
        """
        Ensure the path doesn't escape the workspace
        
        Args:
            path: The requested path
            
        Returns:
            A safe Path object
        
        Raises:
            ValueError: If the path attempts to escape the workspace
        """
        # Normalize the path and resolve any symlinks
        full_path = (self.workspace_path / path).resolve()
        
        # Check if it's within the workspace
        if not str(full_path).startswith(str(self.workspace_path.resolve())):
            raise ValueError(f"Path {path} attempts to escape the workspace")
            
        return full_path
    
    async def _read_file(self, path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Read a file
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with the file content
        """
        if not path.exists():
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"File {path} does not exist"
            }
            
        if not path.is_file():
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"{path} is a directory, not a file"
            }
            
        try:
            async with aiofiles.open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                content = await f.read()
                
            return {
                "success": True,
                "content": content
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Error reading file: {str(e)}"
            }
    
    async def _write_file(self, path: Path, content: str, overwrite: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Write content to a file
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file
            content: Content to write
            overwrite: Whether to overwrite existing files
            
        Returns:
            Status of the operation
        """
        if path.exists() and not overwrite:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"File {path} already exists and overwrite is False"
            }
            
        # Ensure parent directory exists
        os.makedirs(path.parent, exist_ok=True)
            
        try:
            async with aiofiles.open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                await f.write(content)
                
            return {
                "success": True,
                "path": str(path.relative_to(self.workspace_path))
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Error writing file: {str(e)}"
            }
    
    async def _list_files(self, path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        List files in a directory
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the directory
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with list of files and directories
        """
        if not path.exists():
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Directory {path} does not exist"
            }
            
        if not path.is_dir():
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"{path} is a file, not a directory"
            }
            
        try:
            files = []
            directories = []
            
            for item in path.iterdir():
                rel_path = str(item.relative_to(self.workspace_path))
                if item.is_file():
                    files.append(rel_path)
                elif item.is_dir():
                    directories.append(rel_path)
                    
            return {
                "success": True,
                "files": files,
                "directories": directories
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Error listing directory: {str(e)}"
            }
    
    def _file_exists(self, path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Check if a file or directory exists
        
        Args:
            path: Path to check
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with existence information
        """
        exists = path.exists()
        is_file = path.is_file() if exists else False
        is_dir = path.is_dir() if exists else False
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "exists": exists,
            "is_file": is_file,
            "is_dir": is_dir
        }
    
    async def _delete_file(self, path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Delete a file or directory
        
        Args:
            path: Path to delete
            
        Returns:
            Status of the operation
        """
        if not path.exists():
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Path {path} does not exist"
            }
            
        try:
            if path.is_file():
                path.unlink()
            elif path.is_dir():
                # This will fail if the directory is not empty
                path.rmdir()
                
            return {
                "success": True,
                "deleted": str(path.relative_to(self.workspace_path))
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Error deleting {path}: {str(e)}"
            }

"""
Notification service for the Hive Mind system.
Handles notifications about file changes in the embedded project representation
and other events that agents need to be notified about.
"""

import asyncio
import json
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Set, Optional, Callable
import time

# Configure logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class NotificationService:
    """
    Service for managing notifications between agents about file changes
    and other events in the embedded project.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, 
                team_manager=None,
                message_bus=None):
        """
        Initialize the notification service
        
        Args:
            team_manager: Optional team manager for accessing agents
            message_bus: Optional message bus for agent communication
        """
        self.team_manager = team_manager
        self.message_bus = message_bus
        self.file_watchers = {}  # Maps file paths to sets of agent_idsa
        self.project_watchers = set()  # Set of agent_ids watching the entire project
        self.last_modified = {}  # Maps file paths to last modified timestamps
        self.event_callbacks = {}  # Maps event types to callback functions
        self.pending_notifications = []  # Queue of pending notifications
    
    def register_file_watcher(self, agent_id: str, file_path: str) -> bool:
        """
        Register an agent as a watcher for a specific file
        
        Ar
            agent_id: ID of the agent that wants to watch the file
            file_path: Path to the file to watch
            
        Returns:
            True if registration was successful
        """
        if file_path not in self.file_watchers:
            self.file_watchers[file_path] = set()
            
        self.file_watchers[file_path].add(agent_id)
        logger.info(f"Agent {agent_id} is now watching file {file_path}")
        
        return True
    
    def unregister_file_watcher(self, agent_id: str, file_path: str) -> bool:
        """
        Unregister an agent as a watcher for a specific file
        
        Args:
            agent_id: ID of the agent that wants to stop watching
            file_path: Path to the file to stop watching
            
        Returns:
            True if unregistration was successful
        """
        if file_path in self.file_watchers and agent_id in self.file_watchers[file_path]:
            self.file_watchers[file_path].remove(agent_id)
            logger.info(f"Agent {agent_id} is no longer watching file {file_path}")
            
            # Clean up empty watcher sets
            if not self.file_watchers[file_path]:
                del self.file_watchers[file_path]
                
        return True
    
    def register_project_watcher(self, agent_id: str) -> bool:
        """
        Register an agent as a watcher for the entire project
        
        Args:
            agent_id: ID of the agent that wants to watch the project
            
        Returns:
            True if registration was successful
        """
        self.project_watchers.add(agent_id)
        logger.info(f"Agent {agent_id} is now watching the entire project")
        
        return True
    
    def unregister_project_watcher(self, agent_id: str) -> bool:
        """
        Unregister an agent as a watcher for the entire project
        
        Args:
            agent_id: ID of the agent that wants to stop watching
            
        Returns:
            True if unregistration was successful
        """
        if agent_id in self.project_watchers:
            self.project_watchers.remove(agent_id)
            logger.info(f"Agent {agent_id} is no longer watching the entire project")
            
        return True
    
    def register_event_callback(self, event_type: str, callback: Callable) -> bool:
        """
        Register a callback function for a specific event type
        
        Args:
            event_type: Type of event to register for
            callback: Callback function to call when the event occurs
            
        Returns:
            True if registration was successful
        """
        self.event_callbacks[event_type] = callback
        logger.info(f"Registered callback for event type: {event_type}")
        
        return True
    
    async def notify_file_change(self, 
                               file_path: str, 
                               content: str, 
                               version: str, 
                               change_type: str, 
                               change_author: str) -> None:
        """
        Notify all interested agents about a file change
        
        Args:
            file_path: Path to the file that changed
            content: New content of the file
            version: Version identifier for the new file state
            change_type: Type of change (create, update, delete)
            change_author: ID of the agent that made the change
        """
        # Update the last modified timestamp
        self.last_modified[file_path] = time.time()
        
        # Create notification data
        notification_data = {
            "type": "file_changed",
            "path": file_path,
            "content": content,
            "version": version,
            "change_type": change_type,
            "author": change_author,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        }
        
        # Collect all agents that need to be notified
        agents_to_notify = set(self.project_watchers)
        
        if file_path in self.file_watchers:
            agents_to_notify.update(self.file_watchers[file_path])
        
        # Don't notify the author of the change
        if change_author in agents_to_notify:
            agents_to_notify.remove(change_author)
        
        # Send notifications
        notification_tasks = []
        
        # First, check if there's a specific callback for file changes
        if "file_changed" in self.event_callbacks:
            try:
                await self.event_callbacks["file_changed"](notification_data)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error in file_changed callback: {str(e)}")
        
        # Use team manager to notify agents if available
        if self.team_manager:
            for agent_id in agents_to_notify:
                if agent_id in self.team_manager.agents:
                    try:
                        agent = self.team_manager.agents[agent_id]
                        notification_tasks.append(
                            agent.receive_message({
                                "sender": "notification_service",
                                "message_type": "file_changed_notification",
                                "content": json.dumps(notification_data),
                                "context_tags": ["#file_change", f"#{change_type}"],
                                "thread_id": f"file_change_{file_path}_{int(time.time())}"
                            })
                        )
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"Error preparing notification for agent {agent_id}: {str(e)}")
        
        # Use message bus for notification if available
        elif self.message_bus:
            for agent_id in agents_to_notify:
                try:
                    notification_tasks.append(
                        self.message_bus.send_message(
                            sender="notification_service",
                            recipients=[agent_id],
                            message_type="file_changed_notification",
                            content=json.dumps(notification_data),
                            context_tags=["#file_change", f"#{change_type}"],
                            thread_id=f"file_change_{file_path}_{int(time.time())}"
                        )
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Error preparing notification via message bus for agent {agent_id}: {str(e)}")
        
        # Otherwise, queue notifications for later delivery
        else:
            for agent_id in agents_to_notify:
                self.pending_notifications.append({
                    "agent_id": agent_id,
                    "data": notification_data
                })
            logger.warning("No team manager or message bus available. Notifications queued for later delivery.")
            return
        
        # Send all notifications concurrently
        if notification_tasks:
            try:
                await asyncio.gather(*notification_tasks)
                logger.info(f"Notified {len(notification_tasks)} agents about change to {file_path}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error sending notifications: {str(e)}")
    
    async def notify_review_created(self, review_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """
        Notify the code reviewer agent about a new review
        
        Args:
            review_data: Data about the review
        """
        notification_data = {
            "type": "review_created",
            **review_data
        }
        
        # Check if there's a specific callback for review creation
        if "review_created" in self.event_callbacks:
            try:
                await self.event_callbacks["review_created"](notification_data)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error in review_created callback: {str(e)}")
        
        # Always notify the code reviewer agent
        if self.team_manager and "code_reviewer" in self.team_manager.agents:
            try:
                await self.team_manager.agents["code_reviewer"].receive_message({
                    "sender": "notification_service",
                    "message_type": "review_request",
                    "content": json.dumps(notification_data),
                    "context_tags": ["#code_review", "#new_review"],
                    "thread_id": f"review_{review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}"
                })
                logger.info(f"Notified code reviewer about new review: {review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error notifying code reviewer: {str(e)}")
        elif self.message_bus:
            try:
                await self.message_bus.send_message(
                    sender="notification_service",
                    recipients=["code_reviewer"],
                    message_type="review_request",
                    content=json.dumps(notification_data),
                    context_tags=["#code_review", "#new_review"],
                    thread_id=f"review_{review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}"
                )
                logger.info(f"Notified code reviewer via message bus about new review: {review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error notifying code reviewer via message bus: {str(e)}")
        else:
            self.pending_notifications.append({
                "agent_id": "code_reviewer",
                "data": notification_data,
                "message_type": "review_request"
            })
            logger.warning("No team manager or message bus available. Notification queued for later delivery.")
    
    async def notify_review_updated(self, review_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """
        Notify relevant agents about a review update
        
        Args:
            review_data: Data about the review update
        """
        notification_data = {
            "type": "review_updated",
            **review_data
        }
        
        # Check if there's a specific callback for review updates
        if "review_updated" in self.event_callbacks:
            try:
                await self.event_callbacks["review_updated"](notification_data)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error in review_updated callback: {str(e)}")
        
        # Notify the code reviewer and the author
        recipients = ["code_reviewer"]
        if "author" in review_data:
            recipients.append(review_data["author"])
        
        if self.team_manager:
            notification_tasks = []
            for agent_id in recipients:
                if agent_id in self.team_manager.agents:
                    try:
                        notification_tasks.append(
                            self.team_manager.agents[agent_id].receive_message({
                                "sender": "notification_service",
                                "message_type": "review_update",
                                "content": json.dumps(notification_data),
                                "context_tags": ["#code_review", "#update"],
                                "thread_id": f"review_{review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}"
                            })
                        )
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"Error preparing notification for agent {agent_id}: {str(e)}")
            
            if notification_tasks:
                try:
                    await asyncio.gather(*notification_tasks)
                    logger.info(f"Notified {len(notification_tasks)} agents about review update: {review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Error sending review update notifications: {str(e)}")
        elif self.message_bus:
            try:
                await self.message_bus.send_message(
                    sender="notification_service",
                    recipients=recipients,
                    message_type="review_update",
                    content=json.dumps(notification_data),
                    context_tags=["#code_review", "#update"],
                    thread_id=f"review_{review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}"
                )
                logger.info(f"Notified agents via message bus about review update: {review_data.get('review_id', 'unknown')}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error notifying agents via message bus: {str(e)}")
        else:
            for agent_id in recipients:
                self.pending_notifications.append({
                    "agent_id": agent_id,
                    "data": notification_data,
                    "message_type": "review_update"
                })
            logger.warning("No team manager or message bus available. Notifications queued for later delivery.")
    
    async def deliver_pending_notifications(self) -> None:
        """
        Deliver any pending notifications that couldn't be sent earlier
        """
        if not self.team_manager and not self.message_bus:
            logger.warning("Still no team manager or message bus available. Cannot deliver pending notifications.")
            return
        
        notification_tasks = []
        delivered_indices = []
        
        for i, notification in enumerate(self.pending_notifications):
            agent_id = notification["agent_id"]
            data = notification["data"]
            message_type = notification.get("message_type", "file_changed_notification")
            
            # Use team manager if available
            if self.team_manager and agent_id in self.team_manager.agents:
                try:
                    notification_tasks.append(
                        self.team_manager.agents[agent_id].receive_message({
                            "sender": "notification_service",
                            "message_type": message_type,
                            "content": json.dumps(data),
                            "context_tags": [f"#{data.get('type', 'notification')}"],
                            "thread_id": f"{data.get('type', 'notification')}_{int(time.time())}"
                        })
                    )
                    delivered_indices.append(i)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Error preparing notification for agent {agent_id}: {str(e)}")
            # Otherwise use message bus
            elif self.message_bus:
                try:
                    notification_tasks.append(
                        self.message_bus.send_message(
                            sender="notification_service",
                            recipients=[agent_id],
                            message_type=message_type,
                            content=json.dumps(data),
                            context_tags=[f"#{data.get('type', 'notification')}"],
                            thread_id=f"{data.get('type', 'notification')}_{int(time.time())}"
                        )
                    )
                    delivered_indices.append(i)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Error preparing notification via message bus for agent {agent_id}: {str(e)}")
        
        # Send all notifications concurrently
        if notification_tasks:
            try:
                await asyncio.gather(*notification_tasks)
                logger.info(f"Delivered {len(notification_tasks)} pending notifications")
                
                # Remove delivered notifications
                self.pending_notifications = [n for i, n in enumerate(self.pending_notifications) if i not in delivered_indices]
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error sending pending notifications: {str(e)}")
    
    async def handle_notification(self, notification_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """
        Process a notification and distribute it to the appropriate handlers
        
        Args:
            notification_data: Data about the notification
        """
        notification_type = notification_data.get("type")
        
        if not notification_type:
            logger.error("Received notification with no type")
            return
        
        # Check if there's a specific callback for this notification type
        if notification_type in self.event_callbacks:
            try:
                await self.event_callbacks[notification_type](notification_data)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error in {notification_type} callback: {str(e)}")
        
        # Handle specific notification types
        if notification_type == "file_changed":
            await self.notify_file_change(
                notification_data.get("path", ""),
                notification_data.get("content", ""),
                notification_data.get("version", "unknown"),
                notification_data.get("change_type", "update"),
                notification_data.get("author", "unknown")
            )
        elif notification_type == "pending_review":
            await self.notify_review_created(notification_data)
        elif notification_type in ["review_added", "commit_approved", "commit_rejected"]:
            await self.notify_review_updated(notification_data)
    
    def get_file_watchers(self, file_path: str) -> List[str]:
        """
        Get the list of agents watching a file
        
        Args:
            file_path: Path to the file
            
        Returns:
            List of agent IDs watching the file
        """
        watchers = list(self.project_watchers)
        
        if file_path in self.file_watchers:
            watchers.extend(list(self.file_watchers[file_path]))
            
        # Remove duplicates
        return list(set(watchers))
    
    def get_last_modified(self, file_path: str) -> Optional[float]:
        """
        Get the timestamp when a file was last modified
        
        Args:
            file_path: Path to the file
            
        Returns:
            Timestamp of last modification, or None if unknown
        """
        return self.last_modified.get(file_path)

import os
import json
import time
import asyncio
import hashlib
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Set
from pathlib import Path
import aiofiles
import shutil

from hive_mind.agent_sdk.base_agent import AgentTool
from hive_mind.agent_sdk.message import Message

class VersionControlTool(AgentTool):
    """
    Tool for version control operations in the agent workspace.
    Manages an embedded representation of the project that agents can access
    and commit changes to, with a review and approval workflow.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, 
                workspace_path: str, 
                embedded_project_path: str,
                notification_callback=None):
        """
        Initialize the VersionControlTool with paths for workspace and embedded project
        
        Args:
            workspace_path: Base directory for agent workspace operations
            embedded_project_path: Directory for the embedded project representation
            notification_callback: Optional callback function to notify agents of changes
        """
        super().__init__(
            name="version_control_tool",
            description="Manage version control operations for the embedded project",
            parameters={
                "action": "The action to perform (commit, review, approve, reject, status, fetch)",
                "path": "The path to the file or directory, relative to the embedded project",
                "content": "The content to commit (for commit action only)",
                "message": "Commit message or review comments",
                "agent_id": "ID of the agent performing the action"
            }
        )
        self.workspace_path = Path(workspace_path)
        self.embedded_path = Path(embedded_project_path)
        self.notification_callback = notification_callback
        
        # Tracking structures
        self.pending_reviews = {}  # Maps file paths to pending review data
        self.commit_history = []   # History of all commits
        self.file_versions = {}    # Maps file paths to their latest version hash
        self.file_watchers = {}    # Maps file paths to sets of agent_ids watching them
        
        # Ensure directories exist
        os.makedirs(self.workspace_path, exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(self.embedded_path, exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(self.embedded_path / ".reviews", exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(self.embedded_path / ".history", exist_ok=True)
        
        # Load existing state if available
        self._load_state()
    
    def _load_state(self):
        """Load existing version control state from disk"""
        history_path = self.embedded_path / ".history" / "commit_history.json"
        reviews_path = self.embedded_path / ".reviews" / "pending.json"
        versions_path = self.embedded_path / ".history" / "file_versions.json"
        watchers_path = self.embedded_path / ".history" / "file_watchers.json"
        
        try:
            if history_path.exists():
                with open(history_path, 'r') as f:
                    self.commit_history = json.load(f)
            
            if reviews_path.exists():
                with open(reviews_path, 'r') as f:
                    self.pending_reviews = json.load(f)
            
            if versions_path.exists():
                with open(versions_path, 'r') as f:
                    self.file_versions = json.load(f)
                    
            if watchers_path.exists():
                with open(watchers_path, 'r') as f:
                    watchers_data = json.load(f)
                    # Convert lists back to sets
                    self.file_watchers = {k: set(v) for k, v in watchers_data.items()}
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error loading version control state: {e}")
    
    def _save_state(self):
        """Save current version control state to disk"""
        history_path = self.embedded_path / ".history" / "commit_history.json"
        reviews_path = self.embedded_path / ".reviews" / "pending.json"
        versions_path = self.embedded_path / ".history" / "file_versions.json"
        watchers_path = self.embedded_path / ".history" / "file_watchers.json"
        
        try:
            with open(history_path, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(self.commit_history, f, indent=2)
            
            with open(reviews_path, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(self.pending_reviews, f, indent=2)
            
            with open(versions_path, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(self.file_versions, f, indent=2)
                
            # Convert sets to lists for JSON serialization
            watchers_data = {k: list(v) for k, v in self.file_watchers.items()}
            with open(watchers_path, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(watchers_data, f, indent=2)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error saving version control state: {e}")
    
    def _get_file_hash(self, content: str) -> str:
        """Generate a hash for file content"""
        return hashlib.sha256(content.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
    
    def _get_safe_path(self, path: str, base_path: Path) -> Path:
        """
        Ensure the path doesn't escape the specified base path
        
        Args:
            path: The requested path
            base_path: The base path (workspace or embedded project)
            
        Returns:
            A safe Path object
        
        Raises:
            ValueError: If the path attempts to escape the base path
        """
        # Normalize the path and resolve any symlinks
        full_path = (base_path / path).resolve()
        
        # Check if it's within the base path
        if not str(full_path).startswith(str(base_path.resolve())):
            raise ValueError(f"Path {path} attempts to escape the base path")
            
        return full_path
    
    async def execute(self, 
                    action: str, 
                    path: Optional[str] = None,
                    content: Optional[str] = None,
                    message: Optional[str] = None,
                    agent_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute version control operations
        
        Args:
            action: The action to perform (commit, review, approve, reject, status, fetch)
            path: The path to the file or directory
            content: The content to commit (for commit action only)
            message: Commit message or review comments
            agent_id: ID of the agent performing the action
            
        Returns:
            A dictionary with the operation result
        """
        try:
            if action == "commit":
                return await self._commit_file(path, content, message, agent_id)
            elif action == "review":
                return await self._review_commit(path, message, agent_id)
            elif action == "approve":
                return await self._approve_commit(path, message, agent_id)
            elif action == "reject":
                return await self._reject_commit(path, message, agent_id)
            elif action == "status":
                return await self._get_status(path)
            elif action == "fetch":
                return await self._fetch_file(path)
            elif action == "watch":
                return await self._watch_file(path, agent_id)
            elif action == "unwatch":
                return await self._unwatch_file(path, agent_id)
            else:
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "error": f"Unknown action: {action}"
                }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": str(e)
            }
    
    async def _commit_file(self, path: str, content: str, message: str, agent_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Commit a file to the embedded project (creates a pending review)
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file in the embedded project
            content: New file content
            message: Commit message
            agent_id: ID of the agent committing the file
            
        Returns:
            Status of the operation
        """
        if not path or not content or not message or not agent_id:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Missing required parameters"
            }
        
        # Ensure path is safe
        full_path = self._get_safe_path(path, self.embedded_path)
        
        # Create a content hash
        content_hash = self._get_file_hash(content)
        
        # Check if this exact content is already in the current file (if it exists)
        if full_path.exists() and full_path.is_file():
            async with aiofiles.open(full_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                current_content = await f.read()
                current_hash = self._get_file_hash(current_content)
                
                if current_hash == content_hash:
                    return {
                        "success": False,
                        "error": "No changes detected in file"
                    }
        
        # Create or update the review request
        review_id = f"{agent_id}_{path}_{int(time.time())}"
        review_data = {
            "review_id": review_id,
            "path": path,
            "content": content,
            "content_hash": content_hash,
            "commit_message": message,
            "author": agent_id,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "status": "pending",
            "reviews": [],
            "is_approved": False
        }
        
        # Store the review request
        self.pending_reviews[path] = review_data
        
        # Save the pending review to disk for persistence
        reviews_dir = self.embedded_path / ".reviews"
        os.makedirs(reviews_dir, exist_ok=True)
        review_path = reviews_dir / f"{review_id}.json"
        
        async with aiofiles.open(review_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            await f.write(json.dumps(review_data, indent=2))
        
        # Update pending reviews index
        self._save_state()
        
        # Notify about the new pending review
        if self.notification_callback:
            await self.notification_callback({
                "type": "pending_review",
                "path": path,
                "review_id": review_id,
                "author": agent_id,
                "message": message
            })
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "review_id": review_id,
            "status": "pending_review",
            "message": f"Changes committed and pending review for {path}"
        }
    
    async def _review_commit(self, path: str, comments: str, reviewer_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Add review comments to a pending commit
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file with pending review
            comments: Review comments
            reviewer_id: ID of the reviewing agent
            
        Returns:
            Status of the operation
        """
        if path not in self.pending_reviews:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"No pending review found for {path}"
            }
        
        review_data = self.pending_reviews[path]
        
        # Add review comments
        review = {
            "reviewer": reviewer_id,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "comments": comments
        }
        
        review_data["reviews"].append(review)
        
        # Update the review data
        self.pending_reviews[path] = review_data
        
        # Save updated review to disk
        review_path = self.embedded_path / ".reviews" / f"{review_data['review_id']}.json"
        
        async with aiofiles.open(review_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            await f.write(json.dumps(review_data, indent=2))
        
        # Save state
        self._save_state()
        
        # Notify about the review
        if self.notification_callback:
            await self.notification_callback({
                "type": "review_added",
                "path": path,
                "review_id": review_data["review_id"],
                "reviewer": reviewer_id,
                "comments": comments
            })
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"Review added to {path}",
            "review_id": review_data["review_id"]
        }
    
    async def _approve_commit(self, path: str, message: str, approver_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Approve and merge a pending commit
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file with pending review
            message: Approval message
            approver_id: ID of the approving agent
            
        Returns:
            Status of the operation
        """
        if path not in self.pending_reviews:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"No pending review found for {path}"
            }
        
        review_data = self.pending_reviews[path]
        
        # Check if reviewer is not the same as author
        if review_data["author"] == approver_id:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Author cannot approve their own changes"
            }
        
        # Add approval
        approval = {
            "reviewer": approver_id,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "approved": True,
            "message": message
        }
        
        review_data["reviews"].append(approval)
        review_data["is_approved"] = True
        review_data["status"] = "approved"
        review_data["approver"] = approver_id
        review_data["approval_timestamp"] = time.time()
        
        # Get the full path for the file
        full_path = self._get_safe_path(path, self.embedded_path)
        
        # Ensure parent directory exists
        os.makedirs(full_path.parent, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Write the approved content to the file
        async with aiofiles.open(full_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            await f.write(review_data["content"])
        
        # Update file version
        self.file_versions[path] = review_data["content_hash"]
        
        # Add to commit history
        commit = {
            "commit_id": f"{review_data['review_id']}_approved",
            "path": path,
            "content_hash": review_data["content_hash"],
            "author": review_data["author"],
            "approver": approver_id,
            "message": review_data["commit_message"],
            "approval_message": message,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        }
        
        self.commit_history.append(commit)
        
        # Remove from pending reviews
        del self.pending_reviews[path]
        
        # Save state
        self._save_state()
        
        # Move the review file to history
        review_path = self.embedded_path / ".reviews" / f"{review_data['review_id']}.json"
        history_path = self.embedded_path / ".history" / f"{review_data['review_id']}_approved.json"
        
        if review_path.exists():
            # Update the review data first
            async with aiofiles.open(review_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                await f.write(json.dumps(review_data, indent=2))
            
            # Move to history
            shutil.move(str(review_path), str(history_path))
        
        # Notify about the approval and merged changes
        if self.notification_callback:
            await self.notification_callback({
                "type": "commit_approved",
                "path": path,
                "review_id": review_data["review_id"],
                "author": review_data["author"],
                "approver": approver_id,
                "message": message
            })
        
        # Notify watching agents about file changes
        await self._notify_file_watchers(path)
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"Changes to {path} approved and merged",
            "commit_id": commit["commit_id"]
        }
    
    async def _reject_commit(self, path: str, message: str, reviewer_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Reject a pending commit
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file with pending review
            message: Rejection message with feedback
            reviewer_id: ID of the reviewer agent
            
        Returns:
            Status of the operation
        """
        if path not in self.pending_reviews:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"No pending review found for {path}"
            }
        
        review_data = self.pending_reviews[path]
        
        # Add rejection
        rejection = {
            "reviewer": reviewer_id,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "approved": False,
            "message": message
        }
        
        review_data["reviews"].append(rejection)
        review_data["is_approved"] = False
        review_data["status"] = "rejected"
        review_data["rejection_timestamp"] = time.time()
        
        # Update the review data
        self.pending_reviews[path] = review_data
        
        # Save updated review to disk
        review_path = self.embedded_path / ".reviews" / f"{review_data['review_id']}.json"
        
        async with aiofiles.open(review_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            await f.write(json.dumps(review_data, indent=2))
        
        # Save state
        self._save_state()
        
        # Notify about the rejection
        if self.notification_callback:
            await self.notification_callback({
                "type": "commit_rejected",
                "path": path,
                "review_id": review_data["review_id"],
                "author": review_data["author"],
                "reviewer": reviewer_id,
                "message": message
            })
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"Changes to {path} rejected with feedback",
            "review_id": review_data["review_id"]
        }
    
    async def _get_status(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Get status of files in the embedded project
        
        Args:
            path: Optional path to check status for a specific file
            
        Returns:
            Status information
        """
        if path:
            # Get status for a specific file
            full_path = self._get_safe_path(path, self.embedded_path)
            
            if not full_path.exists():
                return {
                    "success": True,
                    "exists": False,
                    "message": f"File {path} does not exist in the embedded project"
                }
            
            # Check if it has a pending review
            pending_review = self.pending_reviews.get(path, None)
            
            # Get version info
            version = self.file_versions.get(path, "unknown")
            
            return {
                "success": True,
                "exists": True,
                "is_file": full_path.is_file(),
                "is_directory": full_path.is_dir(),
                "pending_review": pending_review is not None,
                "review_data": pending_review,
                "version": version
            }
        else:
            # Get overall status
            return {
                "success": True,
                "pending_reviews": list(self.pending_reviews.keys()),
                "total_commits": len(self.commit_history),
                "last_commit": self.commit_history[-1] if self.commit_history else None
            }
    
    async def _fetch_file(self, path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Fetch a file from the embedded project
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file
            
        Returns:
            File content if successful
        """
        if not path:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Path is required"
            }
        
        full_path = self._get_safe_path(path, self.embedded_path)
        
        if not full_path.exists():
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"File {path} does not exist in the embedded project"
            }
        
        if not full_path.is_file():
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"{path} is a directory, not a file"
            }
        
        try:
            async with aiofiles.open(full_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                content = await f.read()
            
            return {
                "success": True,
                "path": path,
                "content": content,
                "version": self.file_versions.get(path, "unknown")
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": f"Error reading file: {str(e)}"
            }
    
    async def _watch_file(self, path: str, agent_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Add an agent to the watchers list for a file
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file to watch
            agent_id: ID of the agent that wants to watch the file
            
        Returns:
            Success status
        """
        if path not in self.file_watchers:
            self.file_watchers[path] = set()
            
        self.file_watchers[path].add(agent_id)
        self._save_state()
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"Agent {agent_id} is now watching {path}",
            "watchers_count": len(self.file_watchers[path])
        }
    
    async def _unwatch_file(self, path: str, agent_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Remove an agent from the watchers list for a file
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file to unwatch
            agent_id: ID of the agent that wants to stop watching
            
        Returns:
            Success status
        """
        if path in self.file_watchers and agent_id in self.file_watchers[path]:
            self.file_watchers[path].remove(agent_id)
            self._save_state()
            
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"Agent {agent_id} is no longer watching {path}",
            "watchers_count": len(self.file_watchers.get(path, set()))
        }
    
    async def _notify_file_watchers(self, path: str) -> None:
        """
        Notify all agents watching a file that it has changed
        
        Args:
            path: Path to the file that changed
        """
        if not self.notification_callback or path not in self.file_watchers:
            return
        
        watchers = self.file_watchers[path]
        if not watchers:
            return
            
        # Get the file content
        file_data = await self._fetch_file(path)
        
        if not file_data["success"]:
            return
            
        for agent_id in watchers:
            await self.notification_callback({
                "type": "file_changed",
                "path": path,
                "content": file_data["content"],
                "version": file_data["version"],
                "agent_id": agent_id
            })

--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\hive-mind\ui\README.md ---
# Hive Mind UI

The Hive Mind UI is built with React and Tauri, providing a modern, responsive interface for the Hive Mind AI Agent Teams platform.

## Features

- Dashboard for team and task management
- Team creation with agent role selection
- Workspace file browser and agent conversation interface
- Cost management and budget visualization
- Settings and user preferences

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 16+ and npm
- Rust (for Tauri desktop app builds)

## Getting Started

### Installation

1. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

2. Set up environment variables:
   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env
   # Edit .env with your API endpoint and other settings
   ```

### Development

1. Start the development server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```
   This will start the React application at http://localhost:3000

2. To run the Tauri desktop app in development mode:
   ```bash
   npm run tauri dev
   ```

### Building for Production

1. Build the web version:
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```

2. Build the desktop application:
   ```bash
   npm run tauri build
   ```
   This will create platform-specific installers in the `src-tauri/target/release/bundle` directory.

## Project Structure

```
ui/
├── public/              # Static assets
├── src/                 # Source code
│   ├── components/      # Reusable UI components
│   ├── contexts/        # React context providers
│   ├── hooks/           # Custom React hooks
│   ├── pages/           # Page components
│   ├── services/        # API service layer
│   ├── styles/          # CSS and style files
│   ├── types/           # TypeScript type definitions
│   ├── App.tsx          # Main App component
│   └── main.tsx         # Entry point
├── .env.example         # Example environment variables
├── index.html           # HTML template
├── package.json         # Node.js dependencies and scripts
├── tsconfig.json        # TypeScript configuration
└── vite.config.ts       # Vite configuration
```

## API Communication

The UI communicates with the Hive Mind API endpoints for all data operations:

- REST API for CRUD operations
- WebSockets for real-time updates
- Authentication using JWT tokens

## Contributing

1. Follow the code style and conventions in the existing files
2. Use TypeScript for all new components
3. Add appropriate tests for new features
4. Update this README as needed when adding significant features

## Technologies Used

- React for UI components
- TypeScript for type safety
- Vite for fast development and building
- React Router for navigation
- Socket.io for WebSocket communication
- Tauri for desktop application wrapping

import ProjectWorkmode from './pages/ProjectWorkmode';

export default function App() {

  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarMinimized, setSidebarMinimized] = useState(false);

    <AppShell

          <Burger

          />

      </AppShell.Header>

import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { MantineProvider, createTheme } from '@mantine/core';
import '@mantine/core/styles.css';
import App from './App';
import './styles/global.css';

// Error boundary component to catch rendering errors
class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component<{ children: React.ReactNode }, { hasError: boolean, error: Error | null }> {
  constructor(props: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('React error boundary caught an error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div style={{ 
          padding: '20px', 
          backgroundColor: '#202939', 
          color: 'white',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          margin: '20px',
          fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif'
        }}>
          <h1 style={{ color: '#EF4444' }}>Something went wrong</h1>
          <p>The application encountered an error:</p>
          <pre style={{ 
            backgroundColor: '#121926', 
            padding: '10px', 
            borderRadius: '4px',
            overflowX: 'auto'
          }}>
            {this.state.error?.message || 'Unknown error'}
          </pre>
          <p>Please check the console for more details.</p>
          <button 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: '#3C5CFE',
              color: 'white',
              border: 'none',
              padding: '10px 20px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              marginTop: '10px'
            }}
            onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
          >
            Reload Application
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

const theme = createTheme({
  primaryColor: 'indigo',
  primaryShade: 6,
  colors: {
    indigo: [
      '#E0E8FF',
      '#C0D0FF',

      '#5D79FF',

      '#0029C7',
      '#0020A0',
      '#001779',
    ],
    gray: [
      '#F8FAFC',
      '#EEF2F6',
      '#E3E8EF',
      '#CDD5DF',
      '#9AA5B4',
      '#697586',
      '#4B5565',
      '#364152',
      '#202939',
      '#121926',
    ],
  },
  components: {
    Button: {
      defaultProps: {
        radius: 'md',
      },
    },
    Card: {
      defaultProps: {
        radius: 'md',
        shadow: 'sm',
      },
    },
  },
  fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif',
  fontSizes: {
    xs: '0.75rem',
    sm: '0.875rem',
    md: '1rem',
    lg: '1.125rem',
    xl: '1.25rem',
  },
  radius: {
    xs: '0.125rem',
    sm: '0.25rem',
    md: '0.5rem',
    lg: '1rem',
    xl: '2rem',
  },
});

try {
  ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
    <React.StrictMode>
      <ErrorBoundary>
        <MantineProvider theme={theme} defaultColorScheme="dark">
          <BrowserRouter>
            <App />
          </BrowserRouter>
        </MantineProvider>
      </ErrorBoundary>
    </React.StrictMode>
  );
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Failed to render the application:', error);
  document.body.innerHTML = `
    <div style="padding: 20px; background-color: #202939; color: white; border-radius: 8px; margin: 20px; font-family: sans-serif;">
      <h1 style="color: #EF4444;">Fatal Error</h1>
      <p>The application failed to start:</p>
      <pre style="background-color: #121926; padding: 10px; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto;">
        ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}
      </pre>
      <p>Please check the console for more details.</p>
      <button 
        style="background-color: #3C5CFE; color: white; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 10px;"
        onclick="window.location.reload()"
      >
        Reload Application

      <a 
        href="/debug.html" 
        style="display: inline-block; margin-left: 10px; background-color: #364152; color: white; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px;"
      >
        Go to Debug Page
      </a>
    </div>
  `;
}
