--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\hive-mind\ui\src\components\EmbeddedProject.tsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Box, Tabs, Paper, Text, Group, Title, Loader, Button, Code, Alert, Divider, Textarea, ScrollArea } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconAlertCircle } from './layout/icons';
import { 
  GitPullRequest as IconGitPullRequest, 
  Code as IconCode, 
  Refresh as IconRefresh, 
  FileCode as IconFileCode,
  Check as IconCheck,
  X as IconX 
} from 'tabler-icons-react';
import axios from 'axios';

interface FileNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'file' | 'directory';
  path: string;
  children?: FileNode[];
}

interface ReviewComment {
  reviewer: string;
  timestamp: number;
  comments: string;
  approved?: boolean;
}

interface PendingReview {
  review_id: string;
  path: string;
  author: string;
  timestamp: number;
  commit_message: string;
  content: string;
  content_hash: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected';
  reviews: ReviewComment[];
  is_approved: boolean;
}

export default function EmbeddedProject() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<FileNode[]>([]);
  const [pendingReviews, setPendingReviews] = useState<PendingReview[]>([]);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fileContent, setFileContent] = useState<string>('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string | null>('files');
  const [selectedReview, setSelectedReview] = useState<PendingReview | null>(null);
  const [reviewComment, setReviewComment] = useState('');
  const [originalContent, setOriginalContent] = useState<string>('');
  const [lastUpdate, setLastUpdate] = useState<Date>(new Date());
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Connect to websocket for real-time updates
  useEffect(() => {
    const wsUrl = `ws://${window.location.host}/api/embedded-project/events`;
    const newSocket = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
    
    newSocket.onopen = () => {
      console.log('Connected to embedded project events');
    };
    
    newSocket.onmessage = (event) => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
        
        if (data.type === 'file_changed') {
          // Refresh file list
          fetchFiles();
          
          // If the changed file is currently selected, update its content
          if (data.path === selectedFile) {
            setFileContent(data.content);
          }
          
          // Update last change timestamp
          setLastUpdate(new Date());
        } else if (data.type === 'review_created' || data.type === 'review_updated') {
          // Refresh pending reviews
          fetchPendingReviews();
          
          // If the updated review is currently selected, refresh it
          if (selectedReview && data.review_id === selectedReview.review_id) {
            fetchReviewDetails(data.review_id);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error processing websocket message:', e);
      }
    };
    
    newSocket.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
      setError('Error connecting to real-time updates');
    };
    
    return () => {
      if (newSocket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
        newSocket.close();
      }
    };
  }, [selectedFile, selectedReview]);

  // Fetch files and pending reviews on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFiles();
    fetchPendingReviews();
  }, []);

  const fetchFiles = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const response = await axios.get('/api/embedded-project/files');
      setFiles(response.data);
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching embedded project files:', err);
      setError('Failed to load embedded project files');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchPendingReviews = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get('/api/embedded-project/reviews/pending');
      setPendingReviews(response.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching pending reviews:', err);
    }
  };

  const fetchFileContent = async (path: string) => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const response = await axios.get(`/api/embedded-project/files/${encodeURIComponent(path)}/content`);
      setSelectedFile(path);
      setFileContent(response.data.content);
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching file content:', err);
      setError(`Failed to load content for ${path}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchReviewDetails = async (reviewId: string) => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const response = await axios.get(`/api/embedded-project/reviews/${reviewId}`);
      setSelectedReview(response.data);
      
      // Also fetch the original file content if it exists
      if (response.data.path) {
        try {
          const originalResponse = await axios.get(`/api/embedded-project/files/${encodeURIComponent(response.data.path)}/content`);
          setOriginalContent(originalResponse.data.content);
        } catch (err) {
          // File might not exist yet, so set original content to empty
          setOriginalContent('');
        }
      }
      
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching review details:', err);
      setError(`Failed to load details for review ${reviewId}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFileSelect = (path: string) => {
    fetchFileContent(path);
  };

  const handleReviewSelect = (review: PendingReview) => {
    fetchReviewDetails(review.review_id);
  };

  const handleAddComment = async () => {
    if (!selectedReview || !reviewComment.trim()) return;
    
    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      await axios.post(`/api/embedded-project/reviews/${selectedReview.review_id}/comment`, {
        comments: reviewComment
      });
      
      // Refresh the review details
      fetchReviewDetails(selectedReview.review_id);
      setReviewComment('');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error adding comment:', err);
      setError('Failed to add comment');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleApproveReview = async () => {
    if (!selectedReview) return;
    
    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      await axios.post(`/api/embedded-project/reviews/${selectedReview.review_id}/approve`, {
        message: reviewComment || 'Approved'
      });
      
      // Refresh reviews
      fetchPendingReviews();
      setSelectedReview(null);
      setReviewComment('');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error approving review:', err);
      setError('Failed to approve review');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRejectReview = async () => {
    if (!selectedReview) return;
    
    if (!reviewComment.trim()) {
      setError('Please provide a reason for rejection');
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      await axios.post(`/api/embedded-project/reviews/${selectedReview.review_id}/reject`, {
        message: reviewComment
      });
      
      // Refresh reviews
      fetchPendingReviews();
      setSelectedReview(null);
      setReviewComment('');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error rejecting review:', err);
      setError('Failed to reject review');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const renderFileTree = (nodes: FileNode[], depth = 0) => {
    return nodes.map(node => (
      <Box key={node.id} ml={depth * 16} mb={8}>
        <Box 
          key={`box-${node.id}`}
          className={selectedFile === node.path ? 'selected-file-item' : 'file-item'}
          onClick={() => node.type === 'file' ? handleFileSelect(node.path) : null}
          style={{ cursor: node.type === 'file' ? 'pointer' : 'default', padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: '4px' }}
        >
          {node.type === 'directory' ? '📁 ' : '📄 '} {node.name}
        </Box>
        {node.children && node.children.length > 0 && renderFileTree(node.children, depth + 1)}
      </Box>
    ));
  };

  const formatTimestamp = (timestamp: number) => {
    return new Date(timestamp * 1000).toLocaleString();
  };

  // Compute a simple diff display
  const renderDiff = () => {
    if (!selectedReview) return null;
    
    // Split the content into lines
    const originalLines = originalContent.split('\n');
    const newLines = selectedReview.content.split('\n');
    
    // Simple line-by-line comparison
    const diffLines = [];
    const maxLines = Math.max(originalLines.length, newLines.length);
    
    for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
      const originalLine = i < originalLines.length ? originalLines[i] : '';
      const newLine = i < newLines.length ? newLines[i] : '';
      
      if (originalLine !== newLine) {
        if (originalLine) {
          diffLines.push(<div key={`removed-${i}`} style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1)' }}>- {originalLine}</div>);
        }
        if (newLine) {
          diffLines.push(<div key={`added-${i}`} style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.1)' }}>+ {newLine}</div>);
        }
      } else {
        diffLines.push(<div key={`unchanged-${i}`}> {originalLine}</div>);
      }
    }
    
    return (
      <ScrollArea h={300}>
        <Code block>
          {diffLines}
        </Code>
      </ScrollArea>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Box>
      <Group mb="md" position="apart">
        <Title order={2}>Embedded Project</Title>
        <Group>
          <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
            Last updated: {lastUpdate.toLocaleString()}
          </Text>
          <Button
            leftIcon={<IconRefresh size={16} />}
            variant="light"
            onClick={() => {
              fetchFiles();
              fetchPendingReviews();
              setLastUpdate(new Date());
            }}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Group>

      {error && (
        <Alert icon={<IconAlertCircle size={16} />} title="Error" color="red" mb="md" withCloseButton onClose={() => setError(null)}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Tabs value={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab}>
        <Tabs.List>
          <Tabs.Tab value="files" leftSection={<IconFileCode size={14} />}>Files</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab 
            value="reviews" 
            leftSection={<IconGitPullRequest size={14} />}
            rightSection={
              pendingReviews.length > 0 ? (
                <Box 
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: '#228be6',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    height: 18,
                    width: 18,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center'
                  }}
                >
                  <Text size="xs" c="white">
                    {pendingReviews.length}
                  </Text>
                </Box>
              ) : null
            }
          >
            Pending Reviews
          </Tabs.Tab>
        </Tabs.List>

        <Tabs.Panel value="files" pt="md">
          <Paper withBorder p="md">
            <Group mb="md" justify="apart">
              <Title order={3}>Project Files</Title>
            </Group>
            <Divider mb="md" />
            
            <Box style={{ display: 'flex', height: '70vh' }}>
              <Paper 
                withBorder 
                p="md" 
                style={{ 
                  width: '30%', 
                  maxHeight: '100%', 
                  overflowY: 'auto',
                  marginRight: '16px'
                }}
              >
                {isLoading && files.length === 0 ? (
                  <Box style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '20px' }}>
                    <Loader />
                  </Box>
                ) : files.length === 0 ? (
                  <Text c="dimmed">No files in the embedded project</Text>
                ) : (
                  renderFileTree(files)
                )}
              </Paper>
              
              <Paper 
                withBorder 
                p="md"
                style={{ 
                  flexGrow: 1, 
                  maxHeight: '100%', 
                  overflowY: 'auto'
                }}
              >
                {selectedFile ? (
                  <>
                    <Group mb="md">
                      <Title order={4}>{selectedFile}</Title>
                    </Group>
                    <Divider mb="md" />
                    {isLoading ? (
                      <Box style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '20px' }}>
                        <Loader />
                      </Box>
                    ) : (
                      <Code block>{fileContent}</Code>
                    )}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <Box style={{ 
                    display: 'flex', 
                    justifyContent: 'center', 
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    height: '100%'
                  }}>
                    <Text c="dimmed">Select a file to view its content</Text>
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Paper>
            </Box>
          </Paper>
        </Tabs.Panel>

        <Tabs.Panel value="reviews" pt="md">
          {!selectedReview ? (
            <Paper withBorder p="md">
              <Group mb="md">
                <Title order={3}>Pending Reviews</Title>
              </Group>
              <Divider mb="md" />
              
              {isLoading ? (
                <Box style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '20px' }}>
                  <Loader />
                </Box>
              ) : pendingReviews.length === 0 ? (
                <Text c="dimmed">No pending reviews</Text>
              ) : (
                <Box>
                  {pendingReviews.map(review => (
                    <Paper 
                      key={review.review_id}
                      withBorder
                      p="md"
                      mb="md"
                      className="review-item"
                      style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                      onClick={() => handleReviewSelect(review)}
                    >
                      <Group justify="apart">
                        <div>
                          <Text fw={500}>{review.path}</Text>
                          <Text size="sm">Author: {review.author}</Text>
                          <Text size="sm">Created: {formatTimestamp(review.timestamp)}</Text>
                          <Text size="sm">Message: {review.commit_message}</Text>
                        </div>
                        <Group>
                          <Button color="blue">View Details</Button>
                        </Group>
                      </Group>
                    </Paper>
                  ))}
                </Box>
              )}
            </Paper>
          ) : (
            <Paper withBorder p="md">
              <Group mb="md">
                <div>
                  <Title order={3}>Review: {selectedReview.path}</Title>
                  <Text>Author: {selectedReview.author}</Text>
                  <Text>Created: {formatTimestamp(selectedReview.timestamp)}</Text>
                </div>
                <Button 
                  variant="subtle" 
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedReview(null);
                    setReviewComment('');
                  }}
                  ml="auto"
                >
                  Back to Reviews
                </Button>
              </Group>
              <Divider mb="md" />

              <Paper withBorder p="md" mb="md">
                <Title order={4} mb="sm">Commit Message</Title>
                <Text>{selectedReview.commit_message}</Text>
              </Paper>

              <Paper withBorder p="md" mb="md">
                <Title order={4} mb="sm">Changes</Title>
                {isLoading ? (
                  <Box style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '20px' }}>
                    <Loader />
                  </Box>
                ) : (
                  renderDiff()
                )}
              </Paper>

              <Paper withBorder p="md" mb="md">
                <Title order={4} mb="sm">Comments</Title>
                {selectedReview.reviews.length === 0 ? (
                  <Text c="dimmed" mb="md">No comments yet</Text>
                ) : (
                  <Box mb="md">
                    {selectedReview.reviews.map((review, index) => (
                      <Paper 
                        key={index} 
                        withBorder 
                        p="md" 
                        mb="md"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: review.approved !== undefined
                            ? (review.approved 
                              ? 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.05)' 
                              : 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.05)')
                            : 'transparent'
                        }}
                      >
                        <Group mb="xs">
                          <Text fw={500}>{review.reviewer}</Text>
                          <Text size="sm" ml="auto">{formatTimestamp(review.timestamp)}</Text>
                        </Group>
                        <Text mb="xs">{review.comments}</Text>
                        {review.approved !== undefined && (
                          <Text fw={700} c={review.approved ? 'green' : 'red'}>
                            {review.approved ? 'APPROVED' : 'REJECTED'}
                          </Text>
                        )}
                      </Paper>
                    ))}
                  </Box>
                )}

                <Textarea
                  placeholder="Add your comment or feedback..."
                  label="Your Comment"
                  value={reviewComment}
                  onChange={(e) => setReviewComment(e.currentTarget.value)}
                  minRows={3}
                  mb="md"
                />

                <Group justify="flex-end">
                  <Button 
                    leftSection={<IconCheck size={16} />} 
                    color="green"
                    onClick={handleApproveReview}
                    loading={isSubmitting}
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                  >
                    Approve
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    leftSection={<IconX size={16} />} 
                    color="red"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={handleRejectReview}
                    loading={isSubmitting}
                    disabled={isSubmitting || !reviewComment.trim()}
                  >
                    Reject
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    onClick={handleAddComment}
                    loading={isSubmitting}
                    disabled={isSubmitting || !reviewComment.trim()}
                  >
                    Add Comment
                  </Button>
                </Group>
              </Paper>
            </Paper>
          )}
        </Tabs.Panel>
      </Tabs>
    </Box>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { NavLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Box, Divider, Stack, Text, Button, ActionIcon } from '@mantine/core';
import { 
  IconDashboard, 
  IconUsersGroup, 
  IconWorkspace, 
  IconMoneybag, 
  IconSettings,
  IconChartLine,
  IconChevronLeft,
  IconChevronRight,
  IconFolders,
  IconClipboardList,
  IconBrain,
  IconTag
} from './icons';

interface NavItemProps {
  to: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  minimized?: boolean;
}

const NavItem = ({ to, icon, label, minimized }: NavItemProps) => (
  <NavLink
    to={to}
    className={({ isActive }) => `
      nav-item
      ${isActive ? 'nav-item-active' : ''}
    `}
    style={({ isActive }) => ({
      display: 'flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      padding: minimized ? '0.75rem 0.5rem' : '0.75rem 1rem',
      borderRadius: '0.5rem',
      color: isActive ? '#F8FAFC' : '#9AA5B4',
      backgroundColor: isActive ? '#1A3FE4' : 'transparent',
      textDecoration: 'none',
      transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
      marginBottom: '0.25rem',
      fontWeight: isActive ? 500 : 400,
      justifyContent: minimized ? 'center' : 'flex-start',
    })}
    title={minimized ? label : undefined}
  >
    <Box mr={minimized ? 0 : "xs"} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
      {icon}
    </Box>
    {!minimized && <Text size="sm">{label}</Text>}
  </NavLink>
);

interface SectionTitleProps {
  title: string;
  minimized?: boolean;
}

const SectionTitle = ({ title, minimized }: SectionTitleProps) => (
  minimized ? null : (
    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" fw={600} mb="xs" tt="uppercase" pl="md">
      {title}
    </Text>
  )
);

interface AppSidebarProps {
  onMinimizeChange?: (minimized: boolean) => void;
}

export default function AppSidebar({ onMinimizeChange }: AppSidebarProps) {
  const [minimized, setMinimized] = React.useState(false);

  // Notify parent when minimized state changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (onMinimizeChange) {
      onMinimizeChange(minimized);
    }
  }, [minimized, onMinimizeChange]);

  const handleToggleMinimize = () => {
    setMinimized(prev => !prev);
  };

  // Use existing icons for navigation items
  const navigationItems = [
    { label: 'Dashboard', icon: <IconDashboard size={20} />, link: '/' },
    { label: 'Workspaces', icon: <IconFolders size={20} />, link: '/workspaces' },
    { label: 'Teams', icon: <IconUsersGroup size={20} />, link: '/teams' },
    { label: 'Analytics', icon: <IconChartLine size={20} />, link: '/analytics' },
    { label: 'Cost Management', icon: <IconMoneybag size={20} />, link: '/cost-management' },
    { label: 'Settings', icon: <IconSettings size={20} />, link: '/settings' },
  ];

  // Workmode navigation items
  const workmodeItems = [
    { label: 'Workspace Workmode', icon: <IconWorkspace size={20} />, link: '/workspace-workmode' },
    { label: 'Project Workmode', icon: <IconBrain size={20} />, link: '/project-workmode' },
  ];

  return (
    <Box 
      style={{ 
        height: '100%', 
        padding: minimized ? '1rem 0.25rem' : '1rem', 
        backgroundColor: '#202939', 
        borderRight: '1px solid #364152',
        overflow: 'auto',
        width: minimized ? '60px' : '100%',
        transition: 'width 0.3s ease, padding 0.3s ease',
        position: 'relative',
      }}
    >
      <ActionIcon 
        variant="filled" 
        size="lg"
        color="blue"
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          right: minimized ? '50%' : '0.5rem',
          top: '0.5rem',
          zIndex: 100,
          transform: minimized ? 'translateX(50%)' : 'none',
          borderRadius: '50%',
          backgroundColor: '#1A3FE4',
          boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
          transition: 'all 0.3s ease',
        }}
        onClick={handleToggleMinimize}
        title={minimized ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      >
        {minimized ? <IconChevronRight size={16} /> : <IconChevronLeft size={16} />}
      </ActionIcon>
      
      <Stack mt={minimized ? '2rem' : 0}>
        <SectionTitle title="Main" minimized={minimized} />
        {navigationItems.map((item, index) => (
          <NavItem key={index} to={item.link} icon={item.icon} label={item.label} minimized={minimized} />
        ))}

        <Divider my="md" color="#364152" />

        <SectionTitle title="Workmode" minimized={minimized} />
        {workmodeItems.map((item, index) => (
          <NavItem key={`workmode-${index}`} to={item.link} icon={item.icon} label={item.label} minimized={minimized} />
        ))}

        <Divider my="md" color="#364152" />

        <SectionTitle title="Analytics" minimized={minimized} />
        <NavItem to="/analytics" icon={<IconChartLine size={20} />} label="Analytics" minimized={minimized} />
        <NavItem to="/cost-management" icon={<IconMoneybag size={20} />} label="Cost Management" minimized={minimized} />

        <Divider my="md" color="#364152" />

        <SectionTitle title="Other" minimized={minimized} />
        <NavItem to="/settings" icon={<IconSettings size={20} />} label="Settings" minimized={minimized} />
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  );
}

--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\hive-mind\ui\src\components\tasks\AgentTaskAwareness.tsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Box, 
  Title, 
  Text, 
  Group, 
  Paper, 
  Badge, 
  Progress, 
  Card, 
  Avatar, 
  Button, 
  Textarea, 
  Modal,
  Divider,
  Grid,
  Select,
  ActionIcon
} from '@mantine/core';
import { 
  IconBrain, 
  IconMessage, 
  IconCalendarDue,
  IconClipboardList,
  IconArrowMoveHorizontal
} from '../layout/icons';

interface TaskComment {
  id: string;
  author: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  content: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  assignee: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  priority: string;
  status: string;
  dueDate: string;
  timeEstimate: number;
  progress: number;
  tags: string[];
  comments: TaskComment[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface AgentTaskAwarenessProps {
  agentId: string;
  agentName: string;
  agentType: 'human' | 'agent';
  managerRole: boolean;
  assignedTasks: Task[];
  statusOptions: string[];
  onStatusChange: (taskId: string, newStatus: string) => void;
  onProgressUpdate: (taskId: string, progress: number) => void;
  onAddComment: (taskId: string, comment: string) => void;
}

const AgentTaskAwareness: React.FC<AgentTaskAwarenessProps> = ({ 
  agentId,
  agentName,
  agentType,
  managerRole,
  assignedTasks,
  statusOptions,
  onStatusChange,
  onProgressUpdate,
  onAddComment
}) => {
  const [selectedTask, setSelectedTask] = useState<Task | null>(null);
  const [updateModalOpened, setUpdateModalOpened] = useState(false);
  const [progressValue, setProgressValue] = useState(0);
  const [statusValue, setStatusValue] = useState('');
  const [commentValue, setCommentValue] = useState('');

  const handleOpenUpdateModal = (task: Task) => {
    setSelectedTask(task);
    setProgressValue(task.progress);
    setStatusValue(task.status);
    setCommentValue('');
    setUpdateModalOpened(true);
  };

  const handleSubmitUpdate = () => {
    if (!selectedTask) return;

    if (progressValue !== selectedTask.progress) {
      onProgressUpdate(selectedTask.id, progressValue);
    }

    if (statusValue !== selectedTask.status) {
      onStatusChange(selectedTask.id, statusValue);
    }

    if (commentValue.trim()) {
      onAddComment(selectedTask.id, commentValue);
    }

    setUpdateModalOpened(false);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const getDueStatus = (dueDate: string) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const due = new Date(dueDate);
    const diffTime = due.getTime() - now.getTime();
    const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    if (diffDays < 0) return 'overdue';
    if (diffDays <= 2) return 'due-soon';
    return 'on-track';
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'High': return '#ea4335';
      case 'Medium': return '#fbbc05';
      case 'Low': return '#4285f4';
      default: return '#1a73e8';
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'To Do': return '#4285f4';
      case 'In Progress': return '#fbbc05';
      case 'Testing': return '#9c27b0';
      case 'Done': return '#34a853';
      default: return '#1a73e8';
    }
  };

  const getProgressColor = (progress: number) => {
    if (progress < 25) return '#ea4335';
    if (progress < 50) return '#fbbc05';
    if (progress < 75) return '#4285f4';
    return '#34a853';
  };

  return (
    <Box>
      <Paper p="md" radius="md" style={{ backgroundColor: '#202124', border: '1px solid #333', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
        <Group justify="apart" mb="md">
          <Group>
            {agentType === 'agent' ? (
              <IconBrain size={24} color="#9c27b0" />
            ) : (
              <Avatar radius="xl" size="sm">{agentName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</Avatar>
            )}
            <Title order={4} style={{ color: 'white' }}>
              {agentName}'s Tasks {managerRole && '(Manager)'}
            </Title>
          </Group>
          
          <Badge size="lg" style={{ backgroundColor: agentType === 'agent' ? '#9c27b0' : '#4285f4', color: 'white' }}>
            {agentType === 'agent' ? 'AI Agent' : 'Human'}
          </Badge>
        </Group>
        
        <Box>
          <Text fw={500} size="lg" style={{ color: 'white', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            <IconClipboardList size={18} style={{ marginRight: '8px', verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
            Assigned Tasks ({assignedTasks.length})
          </Text>
          
          <Grid>
            {assignedTasks.length > 0 ? (
              assignedTasks.map(task => (
                <Grid.Col span={6} key={task.id}>
                  <Card 
                    padding="md" 
                    radius="md"
                    style={{ 
                      backgroundColor: '#2d2d2d', 
                      border: '1px solid #444',
                      height: '100%',
                      position: 'relative',
                      overflow: 'visible'
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      top: 0,
                      left: 0,
                      width: '4px',
                      height: '100%',
                      backgroundColor: getPriorityColor(task.priority),
                      borderTopLeftRadius: '8px',
                      borderBottomLeftRadius: '8px'
                    }} />
                    
                    <Box mb="md">
                      <Group justify="apart">
                        <Badge style={{ backgroundColor: getStatusColor(task.status), color: 'white' }}>
                          {task.status}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge 
                          style={{ 
                            backgroundColor: 
                              getDueStatus(task.dueDate) === 'overdue' ? '#ea4335' : 
                              getDueStatus(task.dueDate) === 'due-soon' ? '#fbbc05' : '#34a853',
                            color: 'white'
                          }}
                        >
                          {getDueStatus(task.dueDate) === 'overdue' ? 'Overdue' : 
                           getDueStatus(task.dueDate) === 'due-soon' ? 'Due Soon' : 'On Track'}
                        </Badge>
                      </Group>
                      
                      <Text fw={600} size="md" style={{ color: 'white', margin: '12px 0' }}>
                        {task.title}
                      </Text>
                      
                      <Text size="sm" lineClamp={2} style={{ color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                        {task.description}
                      </Text>
                      
                      <Group mt="md" mb="md">
                        {task.tags.slice(0, 3).map(tag => (
                          <Badge key={tag} size="sm" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a3464', color: '#a8c7fa' }}>
                            {tag}
                          </Badge>
                        ))}
                        {task.tags.length > 3 && (
                          <Badge size="sm" style={{ backgroundColor: '#3c3c3c', color: '#b0b0b0' }}>
                            +{task.tags.length - 3}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </Group>
                    </Box>
                    
                    <Divider my="sm" color="#444" />
                    
                    <Box my="md">
                      <Group mb="xs">
                        <Text size="sm" style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>Progress:</Text>
                        <Text size="sm" style={{ color: 'white', fontWeight: 500 }}>{task.progress}%</Text>
                      </Group>
                      <Progress 
                        value={task.progress} 
                        size="md"
                        radius="xl"
                        color={getProgressColor(task.progress)}
                      />
                    </Box>
                    
                    <Group justify="apart" mt="md">
                      <Group>
                        <IconCalendarDue size={16} color="#aaa" />
                        <Text size="xs" style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>
                          Due: {formatDate(task.dueDate)}
                        </Text>
                      </Group>
                      
                      <Group>
                        <IconMessage size={16} color="#aaa" />
                        <Text size="xs" style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>
                          {task.comments.length} comment{task.comments.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                        </Text>
                      </Group>
                    </Group>
                    
                    <Button 
                      fullWidth 
                      variant="outline" 
                      mt="md"
                      onClick={() => handleOpenUpdateModal(task)}
                      style={{ borderColor: '#4285f4', color: '#4285f4' }}
                    >
                      Update Progress
                    </Button>
                  </Card>
                </Grid.Col>
              ))
            ) : (
              <Grid.Col span={12}>
                <Paper p="xl" radius="md" style={{ backgroundColor: '#2d2d2d', border: '1px solid #444', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>No tasks assigned yet.</Text>
                </Paper>
              </Grid.Col>
            )}
          </Grid>
        </Box>
      </Paper>
      
      <Modal
        opened={updateModalOpened}
        onClose={() => setUpdateModalOpened(false)}
        title={selectedTask ? `Update: ${selectedTask.title}` : 'Update Task'}
        size="lg"
        styles={{
          root: {

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Text, Stack, ScrollArea, Table } from '@mantine/core';
import { useDrop } from 'react-dnd';
import TaskCard from './TaskCard';

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  assignee: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  priority: string;
  status: string;
  dueDate: string;
  timeEstimate: number;
  tags: string[];
  comments: {
    id: string;
    author: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      type: 'human' | 'agent';
    };
    content: string;
    timestamp: string;
  }[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface BoardColumnProps {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  tasks: Task[];
  onDrop: (taskId: string, columnId: string) => void;
  onTaskClick: (task: Task) => void;
}

const BoardColumn: React.FC<BoardColumnProps> = ({ id, title, tasks, onDrop, onTaskClick }) => {
  const [{ isOver }, drop] = useDrop({
    accept: 'task',
    drop: (item: { id: string }) => {
      onDrop(item.id, id);
    },
    collect: (monitor) => ({
      isOver: !!monitor.isOver(),
    }),
  });

  // Get column header color based on status
  const getColumnHeaderColor = () => {
    switch (title) {
      case 'To Do':
        return '#4285f4'; // Blue
      case 'In Progress':
        return '#fbbc05'; // Yellow/Orange
      case 'Testing':
        return '#9c27b0'; // Purple
      case 'Done':
        return '#34a853'; // Green
      default:
        return '#1a73e8'; // Default blue
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box
      ref={drop}
      style={{
        width: 300,
        minWidth: 300,
        backgroundColor: isOver 
          ? '#2c2c2c'
          : '#202124',
        padding: '16px',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        border: '1px solid #333',
        transition: 'background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease',
        height: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
        margin: '0 10px',
      }}
    >
      <Box 
        mb="md" 
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          backgroundColor: getColumnHeaderColor(),
          color: 'white',
          padding: '10px 16px',
          borderRadius: '10px',
          boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
        }}
      >
        <Text fw={600} size="md" c="white">{title}</Text>
        <Text size="sm" c="white" fw={500}>{tasks.length}</Text>
      </Box>

      <ScrollArea h="calc(100vh - 180px)" type="auto" offsetScrollbars>
        <Table 
          style={{ 
            border: 'none', 
            borderCollapse: 'separate', 
            borderSpacing: '0 10px' 
          }}
        >
          <Table.Tbody>
            {tasks.map((task) => (
              <Table.Tr key={task.id} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none' }}>
                <Table.Td style={{ padding: '4px 0', border: 'none' }}>
                  <TaskCard 
                    task={task} 
                    onClick={() => onTaskClick(task)}
                  />
                </Table.Td>
              </Table.Tr>
            ))}
          </Table.Tbody>
        </Table>
      </ScrollArea>
    </Box>
  );
};

--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\hive-mind\ui\src\components\tasks\TaskAssignmentSystem.tsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Box, 
  Title, 
  Text, 
  Paper, 
  Group, 
  Badge, 
  Button, 
  Select, 
  MultiSelect, 
  Table, 
  Avatar, 
  Tooltip,
  ActionIcon,
  Modal,
  Stack,
  ScrollArea,
  Switch,
  Card,
  Divider
} from '@mantine/core';
import { IconUsers, IconTag, IconCheck, IconX, IconBrain, IconUserSearch } from '../layout/icons';

interface Agent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'human' | 'agent';
  skills: string[];
  availability: number; // 0-100%
  role: string;
  assignedTasks: number;
}

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  assignee?: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  priority: string;
  status: string;
  dueDate: string;
  timeEstimate: number;
  tags: string[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface TaskAssignmentSystemProps {
  workspaceId: string;
  onAssignTask: (taskId: string, agentId: string) => void;
  availableTasks: Task[];
  availableAgents: Agent[];
}

const TaskAssignmentSystem: React.FC<TaskAssignmentSystemProps> = ({ 
  workspaceId, 
  onAssignTask, 
  availableTasks, 
  availableAgents 
}) => {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTask, setSelectedTask] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedAgent, setSelectedAgent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterTags, setFilterTags] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [useAI, setUseAI] = useState(true);
  const [suggestedAgents, setSuggestedAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  
  // Get all unique tags from tasks
  const allTags = Array.from(new Set((availableTasks || []).flatMap(task => task.tags || [])));
  
  // Filter unassigned tasks
  const unassignedTasks = (availableTasks || []).filter(task => !task.assignee);
  
  // Filter tasks based on selected tags
  const filteredTasks = filterTags.length > 0 
    ? unassignedTasks.filter(task => 
        filterTags.some(tag => task.tags.includes(tag))
      )
    : unassignedTasks;

  // When a task is selected, suggest agents based on tags
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedTask && useAI) {
      const task = availableTasks.find(t => t.id === selectedTask);
      if (task) {
        // Algorithm to match agents with task tags
        const rankedAgents = availableAgents.map(agent => {
          // Calculate match score based on skills matching task tags
          const matchingSkills = agent.skills.filter(skill => 
            task.tags.includes(skill)
          );
          
          // Score is based on matching skills, availability and current workload
          const score = (matchingSkills.length / task.tags.length) * 
                        (agent.availability / 100) * 
                        (1 - (agent.assignedTasks / 10)); // Assuming 10 tasks is "full" workload
                        
          return {
            agent,
            score
          };
        });
        
        // Sort by score and get top agents
        const sortedAgents = rankedAgents
          .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
          .map(item => item.agent)
          .slice(0, 3);
          
        setSuggestedAgents(sortedAgents);
      }
    } else {
      setSuggestedAgents([]);
    }
  }, [selectedTask, availableAgents, availableTasks, useAI]);
  
  const handleAssign = () => {
    if (selectedTask && selectedAgent) {
      onAssignTask(selectedTask, selectedAgent);
      setSelectedTask(null);
      setSelectedAgent(null);
      setOpened(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleAutoAssign = () => {
    // Find unassigned tasks
    const tasksToAssign = unassignedTasks;
    
    // For each task, find the best matching agent
    tasksToAssign.forEach(task => {
      const matchedAgents = (availableAgents || []).map(agent => {
        const matchingSkills = (agent.skills || []).filter(skill => 
          (task.tags || []).includes(skill)
        );
        
        const score = (matchingSkills.length / task.tags.length) * 
                      (agent.availability / 100) * 
                      (1 - (agent.assignedTasks / 10));
                      
        return {
          agentId: agent.id,
          score
        };
      });
      
      // Sort and get best match
      const bestMatch = matchedAgents.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0];
      
      if (bestMatch && bestMatch.score > 0) {
        onAssignTask(task.id, bestMatch.agentId);
      }
    });
  };
  
  return (
    <>
      <Paper p="md" radius="md" style={{ backgroundColor: '#202124', border: '1px solid #333', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
        <Group justify="apart" mb="md">
          <Group>
            <IconUserSearch size={24} color="#4285f4" />
            <Title order={4} style={{ color: 'white' }}>Task Assignment System</Title>
          </Group>
          <Group>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setOpened(true)}
              style={{ borderColor: '#4285f4', color: '#4285f4' }}
            >
              Assign Task
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleAutoAssign}
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#4285f4' }}
            >
              Auto-Assign All
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Group>
        
        <Box>
          <Text size="sm" fw={500} style={{ color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
            {unassignedTasks.length} Unassigned Tasks
          </Text>
          
          <ScrollArea.Autosize mah={200}>
            <Table style={{ backgroundColor: '#2d2d2d', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
              <Table.Thead style={{ backgroundColor: '#383838' }}>
                <Table.Tr>
                  <Table.Th style={{ color: '#ddd' }}>Task</Table.Th>
                  <Table.Th style={{ color: '#ddd' }}>Priority</Table.Th>
                  <Table.Th style={{ color: '#ddd' }}>Tags</Table.Th>
                  <Table.Th style={{ color: '#ddd' }}>Due Date</Table.Th>
                </Table.Tr>
              </Table.Thead>
              <Table.Tbody>
                {unassignedTasks.length > 0 ? (
                  unassignedTasks.slice(0, 5).map((task) => (
                    <Table.Tr key={task.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #444' }}>
                      <Table.Td style={{ color: 'white' }}>{task.title}</Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Badge 
                          color={task.priority === 'High' ? 'red' : task.priority === 'Medium' ? 'yellow' : 'blue'}
                        >
                          {task.priority}
                        </Badge>
                      </Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Group gap={4}>
                          {task.tags.slice(0, 2).map(tag => (
                            <Badge key={tag} size="xs" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a3464', color: '#a8c7fa' }}>
                              {tag}
                            </Badge>
                          ))}
                          {task.tags.length > 2 && (
                            <Badge size="xs" style={{ backgroundColor: '#3c3c3c', color: '#b0b0b0' }}>
                              +{task.tags.length - 2}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </Group>
                      </Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td style={{ color: 'white' }}>
                        {new Date(task.dueDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </Table.Td>
                    </Table.Tr>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <Table.Tr>
                    <Table.Td colSpan={4} style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#aaa' }}>
                      No unassigned tasks
                    </Table.Td>
                  </Table.Tr>
                )}
              </Table.Tbody>
            </Table>
          </ScrollArea.Autosize>
        </Box>
      </Paper>
      
      <Modal
        opened={opened}
        onClose={() => setOpened(false)}
        title="Assign Task"
        size="lg"
        styles={{
          root: {
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)',
          },
          content: {
            backgroundColor: '#202124',
            color: 'white',
          },
          header: {
            backgroundColor: '#202124',
            color: 'white',
            borderBottom: '1px solid #333',
          },
          title: {
            color: 'white',
            fontWeight: 'bold',
          },
          close: {
            color: 'white',
            '&:hover': {
              backgroundColor: '#333',
            },
          },
        }}
      >
        <Stack gap="md">
          <Box>
            <Text size="sm" fw={500} style={{ color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              Filter Tasks by Tags
            </Text>
            <MultiSelect
              data={allTags.map(tag => ({ value: tag, label: tag }))}
              value={filterTags}
              onChange={setFilterTags}
              placeholder="Select tags to filter tasks"
              searchable
              clearable
              styles={{
                input: {
                  backgroundColor: '#333',
                  color: 'white',
                  border: '1px solid #444',
                }
              }}
            />
          </Box>
          
          <Box>
            <Text size="sm" fw={500} style={{ color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              Select Task
            </Text>
            <Select
              data={filteredTasks.map(task => ({ 
                value: task.id, 
                label: task.title,
                group: task.priority
              }))}
              value={selectedTask}
              onChange={setSelectedTask}
              placeholder="Select a task to assign"
              searchable
              clearable
              styles={{
                input: {
                  backgroundColor: '#333',
                  color: 'white',
                  border: '1px solid #444',
                }
              }}
            />
          </Box>
          
          <Group>
            <Switch
              checked={useAI}
              onChange={(event) => setUseAI(event.currentTarget.checked)}
              label="Use AI to suggest agents"
              styles={{
                label: {
                  color: 'white'
                }
              }}
            />
          </Group>
          
          {suggestedAgents.length > 0 && (
            <Box>
              <Text size="sm" fw={500} style={{ color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                Suggested Agents
              </Text>
              <Group>
                {suggestedAgents.map(agent => (
                  <Card 
                    key={agent.id} 
                    style={{ 
                      backgroundColor: '#2d2d2d', 
                      border: selectedAgent === agent.id ? '2px solid #4285f4' : '1px solid #444',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      width: '32%'
                    }}
                    p="sm"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedAgent(agent.id)}
                  >
                    <Group>
                      <Avatar color={agent.type === 'agent' ? 'violet' : 'blue'} radius="xl">
                        {agent.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </Avatar>
                      <Box>
                        <Text fw={500} style={{ color: 'white' }}>{agent.name}</Text>
                        <Text size="xs" style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>{agent.role}</Text>
                      </Box>
                    </Group>
                    <Divider my="sm" color="#444" />
                    <Group justify="apart" mt="xs">
                      <Text size="xs" style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>Skills:</Text>
                      <Group gap={4}>
                        {agent.skills.slice(0, 2).map(skill => (
                          <Badge key={skill} size="xs" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a3464', color: '#a8c7fa' }}>
                            {skill}
                          </Badge>
                        ))}
                        {agent.skills.length > 2 && (
                          <Badge size="xs" style={{ backgroundColor: '#3c3c3c', color: '#b0b0b0' }}>
                            +{agent.skills.length - 2}
                          </Badge>

                    </Group>

                      <Text size="xs" style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>Tasks:</Text>
                      <Text size="xs" style={{ color: 'white' }}>{agent.assignedTasks}</Text>
                    </Group>
                  </Card>

import React from 'react';
import { Card, Text, Group, Badge, Avatar, Box, Tooltip, Grid } from '@mantine/core';
import { useDrag } from 'react-dnd';
import { IconCalendarDue, IconMessage, IconPriority, IconTag } from '../layout/icons';

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  assignee: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  priority: string;
  status: string;
  dueDate: string;
  timeEstimate: number;
  tags: string[];
  comments: {
    id: string;
    author: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      type: 'human' | 'agent';
    };
    content: string;
    timestamp: string;
  }[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface TaskCardProps {
  task: Task;
  onClick: () => void;
}

const TaskCard: React.FC<TaskCardProps> = ({ task, onClick }) => {
  const [{ isDragging }, drag] = useDrag({
    type: 'task',
    item: { id: task.id },
    collect: (monitor) => ({
      isDragging: !!monitor.isDragging(),
    }),
  });

  // Updated priority colors to match theme
  const priorityColors = {
    High: '#ea4335', // Google red
    Medium: '#fbbc05', // Google yellow
    Low: '#4285f4',   // Google blue
  };

  // Format date to display as "Jul 15" or "Yesterday" etc.
  const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const isToday = date.toDateString() === now.toDateString();
    const isYesterday = new Date(now.setDate(now.getDate() - 1)).toDateString() === date.toDateString();
    
    if (isToday) return 'Today';
    if (isYesterday) return 'Yesterday';
    
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  };

  // Get status color based on task status
  const getStatusColor = () => {
    switch (task.status) {
      case 'To Do':
        return '#4285f4'; // Blue
      case 'In Progress':
        return '#fbbc05'; // Yellow/Orange
      case 'Testing':
        return '#9c27b0'; // Purple  
      case 'Done':
        return '#34a853'; // Green
      default:
        return '#1a73e8'; // Default blue
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card
      ref={drag}
      shadow="sm"
      padding="sm"
      radius="lg"
      onClick={onClick}
      withBorder
      style={{
        opacity: isDragging ? 0.5 : 1,
        cursor: 'pointer',
        transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
        backgroundColor: '#2d2d2d',
        position: 'relative',
        overflow: 'visible',
        boxShadow: '0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
        transform: 'translateY(0)',
        border: `1px solid ${getStatusColor()}50`,
        '&:hover': {
          transform: 'translateY(-2px)',
          boxShadow: '0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
          borderColor: getStatusColor(),
        }
      }}
    >
      {/* Priority indicator */}
      <div style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        width: '4px',
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: priorityColors[task.priority as keyof typeof priorityColors],
        borderTopLeftRadius: '8px',
        borderBottomLeftRadius: '8px'
      }} />

      <Grid align="center" gutter="xs">
        <Grid.Col span={8}>
          <Text fw={600} lineClamp={2} style={{ marginLeft: '8px', color: '#ffffff' }}>{task.title}</Text>
        </Grid.Col>
        
        <Grid.Col span={4} style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
          {task.assignee && (
            <Tooltip label={`Assigned to: ${task.assignee.name}`}>
              <Avatar 
                size="sm" 
                radius="xl" 
                color={task.assignee.type === 'agent' ? 'violet' : 'blue'}
                style={{ border: '2px solid #2d2d2d', boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' }}
              >
                {task.assignee.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </Avatar>
            </Tooltip>
          )}
        </Grid.Col>
      </Grid>

      <Box mt="xs">
        {task.tags.length > 0 && (
          <Group gap="xs" mb="xs" ml="xs">
            <IconTag size={14} color="#a0a0a0" />
            {task.tags.slice(0, 2).map((tag) => (
              <Badge 
                key={tag} 
                size="xs" 
                variant="light" 
                color="blue" 
                radius="xl" 
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a3464', color: '#a8c7fa' }}
              >
                {tag}
              </Badge>
            ))}
            {task.tags.length > 2 && (
              <Badge 
                size="xs" 
                variant="light" 
                color="gray" 
                radius="xl"
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#3c3c3c', color: '#b0b0b0' }}

                  {task.priority}
                </Text>

            {task.comments && task.comments.length > 0 && (

                </Group>
              </Tooltip>
            )}
          </Group>

                <Group gap={4}>
                  <IconCalendarDue size={14} color="#a0a0a0" />
                  <Text size="xs" c="gray.4">{formatDate(task.dueDate)}</Text>
                </Group>
              </Tooltip>
            )}
          </Group>
        </Group>
      </Box>
    </Card>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Modal, 
  TextInput, 
  Textarea, 
  Button, 
  Group, 
  Select, 
  MultiSelect, 
  Box, 
  Text, 
  Avatar, 
  ActionIcon,
  Divider,
  Stack,
  NumberInput
} from '@mantine/core';
import { IconCalendarDue, IconPriority, IconTag } from '../layout/icons';

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  assignee: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  priority: string;
  status: string;
  dueDate: string;
  timeEstimate: number;
  tags: string[];
  comments: {
    id: string;
    author: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      type: 'human' | 'agent';
    };
    content: string;
    timestamp: string;
  }[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface Member {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'human' | 'agent';
  role?: string;
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

interface TaskModalProps {
  opened: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  task?: Task;
  onSave: (task: Partial<Task>) => void;
  statusOptions: { value: string; label: string }[];
  tagOptions: { value: string; label: string }[];
  members: Member[];
}

const TaskModal: React.FC<TaskModalProps> = ({ 
  opened, 
  onClose, 
  task, 
  onSave, 
  statusOptions,
  tagOptions,
  members
}) => {
  // Ensure task has all required properties before using it
  const safeTask = task ? {
    ...task,
    title: task.title || '',
    description: task.description || '',
    priority: task.priority || 'Medium',
    status: task.status || '',
    assignee: task.assignee || { id: '', name: '', type: 'human' },
    dueDate: task.dueDate || '',
    timeEstimate: task.timeEstimate || 0,
    tags: task.tags || [],
    comments: task.comments || []
  } : undefined;
  
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [priority, setPriority] = useState('Medium');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [assigneeId, setAssigneeId] = useState('');
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState('');
  const [timeEstimate, setTimeEstimate] = useState(0);
  const [selectedTags, setSelectedTags] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');

  // Load task data into form when task changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (safeTask) {
      setTitle(safeTask.title);
      setDescription(safeTask.description);
      setPriority(safeTask.priority);
      setStatus(safeTask.status || statusOptions[0]?.value || 'To Do');
      setAssigneeId(safeTask.assignee?.id || '');
      setDueDate(safeTask.dueDate ? new Date(safeTask.dueDate).toISOString().split('T')[0] : '');
      setTimeEstimate(safeTask.timeEstimate);
      setSelectedTags(safeTask.tags);
    } else {
      // Default values for new task
      setTitle('');
      setDescription('');
      setPriority('Medium');
      setStatus(statusOptions[0]?.value || 'To Do');
      setAssigneeId('');
      setDueDate('');
      setTimeEstimate(0);
      setSelectedTags([]);
    }
    setNewComment('');
  }, [safeTask, statusOptions]);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    const updatedTask: Partial<Task> = {
      title,
      description,
      priority,
      status,
      dueDate: dueDate ? new Date(dueDate).toISOString() : undefined,
      timeEstimate,
      tags: selectedTags,
      ...(assigneeId && {
        assignee: members.find(m => m.id === assigneeId)
      }),
    };

    if (safeTask?.id) {
      updatedTask.id = safeTask.id;
    }

    onSave(updatedTask);
    onClose();
  };

  const isFormValid = title.trim().length > 0;

  return (
    <Modal 
      opened={opened} 
      onClose={onClose} 
      title={safeTask ? "Edit Task" : "Create New Task"} 
      size="lg"
      radius="md"
    >
      <Stack>
        <TextInput
          label="Title"
          placeholder="Task title"
          value={title}
          onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          required
          radius="md"
        />

        <Textarea
          label="Description"
          placeholder="Task description"
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
          minRows={3}
          radius="md"
        />

        <Group grow>
          <Select
            label="Priority"
            placeholder="Select priority"
            value={priority}
            onChange={(value) => setPriority(value || 'Medium')}
            data={[
              { value: 'High', label: 'High' },
              { value: 'Medium', label: 'Medium' },
              { value: 'Low', label: 'Low' },
            ]}
            leftSection={<IconPriority size={16} />}
            radius="md"
          />

          <Select
            label="Status"
            placeholder="Select status"
            value={status}
            onChange={(value) => setStatus(value || statusOptions[0]?.value || 'To Do')}
            data={statusOptions}
            radius="md"
          />
        </Group>

        <Group grow>
          <Select
            label="Assignee"
            placeholder="Assign to"
            value={assigneeId}
            onChange={(value) => setAssigneeId(value || '')}
            data={(members || []).map(member => ({
              value: member.id,
              label: member.name,
              group: member.type === 'human' ? 'Team Members' : 'Agents'
            }))}
            clearable
            radius="md"
          />

          <NumberInput
            label="Time Estimate (hours)"
            placeholder="Time estimate"
            value={timeEstimate}
            onChange={(value) => setTimeEstimate(value || 0)}
            min={0}
            radius="md"
          />
        </Group>

        <TextInput
          label="Due Date"
          placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD"
          type="date"
          value={dueDate}
          onChange={(e) => setDueDate(e.target.value)}
          leftSection={<IconCalendarDue size={16} />}
          radius="md"
        />

        <MultiSelect
          label="Tags"
          placeholder="Select tags"
          value={selectedTags}
          onChange={setSelectedTags}
          data={tagOptions}
          searchable
          creatable
          leftSection={<IconTag size={16} />}
          getCreateLabel={(query) => `+ Create "${query}"`}
          onCreate={(query) => {
            const item = { value: query, label: query };
            return item;
          }}
          radius="md"
        />

        {safeTask && safeTask.comments && safeTask.comments.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <Divider my="md" label="Comments" labelPosition="center" />
            
            <Stack>
              {safeTask.comments.map((comment) => (
                <Box key={comment.id} p="xs" style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
                  <Group mb="xs">
                    <Avatar 
                      size="sm" 
                      radius="xl"
                      color={comment.author.type === 'agent' ? 'indigo' : 'blue'}
                    >
                      {comment.author.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </Avatar>
                    <Box>
                      <Text size="sm" fw={500}>{comment.author.name}</Text>
                      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
                        {new Date(comment.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                      </Text>
                    </Box>
                  </Group>
                  <Text size="sm">{comment.content}</Text>
                </Box>
              ))}

              <Textarea
                placeholder="Add a comment..."
                value={newComment}
                onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                minRows={2}
                radius="md"
              />
            </Stack>
          </>
        )}

        <Group justify="flex-end" mt="md">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} radius="md">Cancel</Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleSubmit} 
            disabled={!isFormValid}
            radius="md"
            style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a73e8' }}
          >
            {safeTask ? 'Update Task' : 'Create Task'}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default TaskModal;
