                  createdAt: "2023-06-30T11:00:00Z",
                  updatedAt: "2023-07-05T09:20:00Z"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              id: "column-4",
              title: "Done",
              tasks: [
                {
                  id: "task-5",
                  title: "Implement user authentication API",
                  description: "Create APIs for user registration, login, and authentication.",
                  assignee: { id: "usr-003", name: "Alex Johnson", type: "human" },
                  priority: "High",
                  status: "Done",
                  dueDate: "2023-06-25T00:00:00Z",
                  timeEstimate: 20,
                  tags: ["API", "Backend", "Security"],
                  comments: [],
                  createdAt: "2023-06-15T09:00:00Z",
                  updatedAt: "2023-06-24T15:45:00Z"
                }
              ]
            }
          ]);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error in task board data handling:', err);
        setError('Failed to load tasks. Please try again later.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchTasks();
  }, [workspaceId]);

  // Enhance tasks with progress value
  useEffect(() => {
    const newColumns = columns.map(column => {
      const newTasks = column.tasks.map(task => ({
        ...task,
        progress: task.status === 'Done' ? 100 : 
                 task.status === 'Testing' ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 70 : 
                 task.status === 'In Progress' ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 30 : 
                 Math.floor(Math.random() * 20)
      }));
      return { ...column, tasks: newTasks };
    });
    
    if (columns.length > 0 && newColumns[0].tasks.length > 0 && !('progress' in newColumns[0].tasks[0])) {
      setColumns(newColumns);
    }
  }, [columns]);

  const handleCreateTask = (newTask: Partial<Task>) => {
    // In a real app, this would call an API to create the task
    const taskId = `task-${Date.now()}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    
    const fullTask: Task = {
      id: taskId,
      title: newTask.title || '',
      description: newTask.description || '',
      assignee: newTask.assignee || {
        id: '',
        name: '',
        type: 'human'
      },
      priority: newTask.priority || 'Medium',
      status: newTask.status || 'To Do',
      dueDate: newTask.dueDate || now,
      timeEstimate: newTask.timeEstimate || 0,
      tags: newTask.tags || [],
      comments: [],
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now
    };

    // Find the column that matches the task status
    const targetColumnIndex = columns.findIndex(column => column.title === fullTask.status);
    if (targetColumnIndex >= 0) {
      const newColumns = [...columns];
      newColumns[targetColumnIndex].tasks.push(fullTask);
      setColumns(newColumns);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateTask = (updatedTask: Partial<Task>) => {
    if (!updatedTask.id) return;

    // Find the task in the columns
    let found = false;
    const newColumns = columns.map(column => {
      const taskIndex = column.tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === updatedTask.id);
      if (taskIndex >= 0) {
        found = true;
        
        // Create updated task
        const updatedTaskFull = {
          ...column.tasks[taskIndex],
          ...updatedTask,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        
        // If status has changed, we need to move the task to a different column
        if (updatedTask.status && updatedTask.status !== column.tasks[taskIndex].status) {
          // Remove from current column
          const newTasks = [...column.tasks];
          newTasks.splice(taskIndex, 1);
          
          return {
            ...column,
            tasks: newTasks
          };
        }
        
        // Update in current column
        const newTasks = [...column.tasks];
        newTasks[taskIndex] = updatedTaskFull;
        
        return {
          ...column,
          tasks: newTasks
        };
      }
      return column;
    });
    
    // If status has changed, add the task to the new column
    if (found && updatedTask.status) {
      const targetColumnIndex = newColumns.findIndex(column => column.title === updatedTask.status);
      if (targetColumnIndex >= 0) {
        // Find the original task
        const originalTask = columns
          .flatMap(column => column.tasks)
          .find(task => task.id === updatedTask.id);
        
        if (originalTask) {
          // Create the updated task
          const updatedTaskFull = {
            ...originalTask,
            ...updatedTask,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };
          
          // Add to new column
          newColumns[targetColumnIndex].tasks.push(updatedTaskFull);
        }
      }
    }
    
    setColumns(newColumns);
  };

  const handleDragDrop = (taskId: string, targetColumnId: string) => {
    // Find the task
    let taskToMove: Task | undefined;
    let sourceColumnIndex = -1;
    let sourceTaskIndex = -1;

    columns.forEach((column, colIndex) => {
      const taskIndex = column.tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === taskId);
      if (taskIndex >= 0) {
        taskToMove = column.tasks[taskIndex];
        sourceColumnIndex = colIndex;
        sourceTaskIndex = taskIndex;
      }
    });

    if (!taskToMove) return;

    // Find the target column
    const targetColumnIndex = columns.findIndex(column => column.id === targetColumnId);
    if (targetColumnIndex < 0) return;

    // Update task status
    const updatedTask = {
      ...taskToMove,
      status: columns[targetColumnIndex].title,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    // Remove from source column
    const newColumns = [...columns];
    newColumns[sourceColumnIndex].tasks.splice(sourceTaskIndex, 1);

    // Add to target column
    newColumns[targetColumnIndex].tasks.push(updatedTask);

    setColumns(newColumns);
  };

  const handleTaskClick = (task: Task) => {
    setCurrentTask(task);
    setViewTaskModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditTaskClick = () => {
    setViewTaskModalOpen(false);
    setEditTaskModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCreateTaskClick = () => {
    setCurrentTask(undefined);
    setCreateTaskModalOpen(true);
  };

  const getFilteredColumns = () => {
    return columns.map(column => {
      const filteredTasks = column.tasks.filter(task => {
        // Apply search filter
        const matchesSearch = searchQuery === '' || 
          task.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          task.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

        // Apply priority filter
        const matchesPriority = !filterPriority || 
          task.priority === filterPriority;

        // Apply assignee filter
        const matchesAssignee = !filterAssignee || 
          task.assignee?.id === filterAssignee;

        // Apply tag filter
        const matchesTag = !filterTag || 
          task.tags.includes(filterTag);

        return matchesSearch && matchesPriority && matchesAssignee && matchesTag;
      });

      return {
        ...column,
        tasks: filteredTasks
      };
    });
  };

  const filteredColumns = getFilteredColumns();

  // Get all tasks (flattened from columns)
  const allTasks = columns.flatMap(column => column.tasks);
  
  // Get tasks assigned to selected agent
  const getAssignedTasks = (agentId: string) => {
    return allTasks.filter(task => task.assignee && task.assignee.id === agentId);
  };

  // Handle task status change
  const handleStatusChange = (taskId: string, newStatus: string) => {
    const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
    if (task) {
      handleUpdateTask({
        ...task,
        status: newStatus,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle task progress update
  const handleProgressUpdate = (taskId: string, progress: number) => {
    const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
    if (task) {
      handleUpdateTask({
        ...task,
        progress,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle adding comment to task
  const handleAddComment = (taskId: string, comment: string) => {
    const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
    if (task) {
      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      const newComment = {
        id: `comment-${Date.now()}`,
        author: {
          id: currentUserId,
          name: enhancedMembers.find(m => m.id === currentUserId)?.name || 'Current User',
          type: enhancedMembers.find(m => m.id === currentUserId)?.type || 'human'
        },
        content: comment,
        timestamp: now
      };
      
      handleUpdateTask({
        ...task,
        comments: [...task.comments, newComment],
        updatedAt: now
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle task assignment
  const handleAssignTask = (taskId: string, agentId: string) => {
    const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
    const agent = enhancedMembers.find(m => m.id === agentId);
    
    if (task && agent) {
      handleUpdateTask({
        ...task,
        assignee: {
          id: agent.id,
          name: agent.name,
          type: agent.type
        },
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }
  };

  // Get status options
  const taskStatusOptions = columns.map(column => column.title);

  if (loading) {
    return <div>Loading task board...</div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div>{error}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Group mb="lg" style={{ justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <Group>
          <IconClipboardList size={24} />
          <Title order={3}>Tasks</Title>
        </Group>
        
        <Group>
          {currentUserIsManager && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setShowAgentView(!showAgentView)}
              style={{ 
                borderColor: showAgentView ? '#34a853' : '#1a73e8',
                color: showAgentView ? '#34a853' : '#1a73e8',
                borderRadius: '20px',
                padding: '0 20px'
              }}
            >
              {showAgentView ? 'Show Task Board' : 'Show Agent Tasks'}
            </Button>
          )}
          
          <Button
            leftSection={<IconPlus size={16} />}
            onClick={handleCreateTaskClick}
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: '#1a73e8',
              color: 'white',
              borderRadius: '20px',
              padding: '0 20px'
            }}
          >
            New Task
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Group>
      
      {!showAgentView ? (
        <>
          <Paper p="md" mb="md" shadow="xs" style={{ borderRadius: '12px', backgroundColor: '#202124', border: '1px solid #333' }}>
            <Group>
              <TextInput
                placeholder="Search tasks..."
                leftSection={<IconSearch size={16} />}
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                style={{ flex: 1 }}
                radius="xl"
                styles={{
                  input: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white',
                    '&::placeholder': {
                      color: '#aaa'
                    }
                  }
                }}
              />
              
              <Select
                placeholder="Priority"
                clearable
                data={[
                  { value: 'High', label: 'High' },
                  { value: 'Medium', label: 'Medium' },
                  { value: 'Low', label: 'Low' },
                ]}
                value={filterPriority}
                onChange={setFilterPriority}
                style={{ width: 150 }}
                radius="xl"
                styles={{
                  input: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  },
                  dropdown: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  }
                }}
              />
              
              <Select
                placeholder="Assignee"
                clearable
                data={formattedMembers.map(member => ({
                  value: member.id,
                  label: member.name
                }))}
                value={filterAssignee}
                onChange={setFilterAssignee}
                style={{ width: 150 }}
                radius="xl"
                styles={{
                  input: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  },
                  dropdown: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  }
                }}
              />
              
              <Select
                placeholder="Tag"
                clearable
                data={tagOptions}
                value={filterTag}
                onChange={setFilterTag}
                style={{ width: 150 }}
                radius="xl"
                styles={{
                  input: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  },
                  dropdown: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  }
                }}
              />
            </Group>
          </Paper>

          {currentUserIsManager && (
            <TaskAssignmentSystem 
              workspaceId={workspaceId}
              onAssignTask={handleAssignTask}
              availableTasks={allTasks}
              availableAgents={enhancedMembers}
            />
          )}
          
          <ScrollArea.Autosize mah={600} offsetScrollbars>
            <DndProvider backend={HTML5Backend}>
              <Group align="flex-start" style={{ gap: '1rem', flexWrap: 'nowrap' }}>
                {filteredColumns.map(column => (
                  <BoardColumn
                    key={column.id}
                    id={column.id}
                    title={column.title}
                    tasks={column.tasks}
                    onDrop={handleDragDrop}
                    onTaskClick={handleTaskClick}
                  />
                ))}
              </Group>
            </DndProvider>
          </ScrollArea.Autosize>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Paper p="md" mb="md" shadow="xs" style={{ borderRadius: '12px', backgroundColor: '#202124', border: '1px solid #333' }}>
            <Group>
              <Select
                placeholder="Select Agent"
                data={enhancedMembers.map(member => ({
                  value: member.id,
                  label: member.name,
                  group: member.type === 'human' ? 'Human Team Members' : 'AI Agents'
                }))}
                value={selectedAgent}
                onChange={setSelectedAgent}
                style={{ flex: 1 }}
                searchable
                clearable
                radius="xl"
                styles={{
                  input: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  },
                  dropdown: {
                    backgroundColor: '#333',
                    color: 'white'
                  }
                }}
              />
            </Group>
          </Paper>
          
          {selectedAgent ? (
            <AgentTaskAwareness
              agentId={selectedAgent}
              agentName={enhancedMembers.find(m => m.id === selectedAgent)?.name || 'Agent'}
              agentType={enhancedMembers.find(m => m.id === selectedAgent)?.type || 'agent'}
              managerRole={false}
              assignedTasks={getAssignedTasks(selectedAgent)}
              statusOptions={taskStatusOptions}
              onStatusChange={handleStatusChange}
              onProgressUpdate={handleProgressUpdate}
              onAddComment={handleAddComment}
            />
          ) : (
            <Paper p="xl" radius="md" style={{ backgroundColor: '#202124', border: '1px solid #333', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <Text style={{ color: '#aaa' }}>Select an agent to view their tasks</Text>
            </Paper>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      
      {/* Create Task Modal */}
      <TaskModal
        opened={createTaskModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateTaskModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={handleCreateTask}
        statusOptions={statusOptions}
        tagOptions={tagOptions}
        members={formattedMembers}
      />
      
      {/* View Task Detail Modal */}
      {currentTask && (
        <TaskDetailView
          task={currentTask}
          opened={viewTaskModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setViewTaskModalOpen(false)}
          onEditClick={handleEditTaskClick}
        />
      )}
      
      {/* Edit Task Modal */}
      {currentTask && (
        <TaskModal
          opened={editTaskModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setEditTaskModalOpen(false)}
          task={currentTask}
          onSave={handleUpdateTask}
          statusOptions={statusOptions}
          tagOptions={tagOptions}
          members={formattedMembers}
        />
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default WorkspaceTaskBoard;

        setGrafanaStatus('connected');
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error connecting to Grafana:', err);
        // Even if the fetch fails, we'll still try to show dashboards
        // as the iframe might still work depending on configuration
        setGrafanaStatus('connected');

    checkGrafanaConnection();

  return (

          {error || 'Unable to connect to Grafana. Please check your configuration.'}
        </Alert>
      )}

      {grafanaStatus === 'connected' && (
        <Tabs value={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} mb="lg">
          <Tabs.List>
            <Tabs.Tab value="dashboards">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                <IconChartLine size={14} />
                <span>Dashboards</span>
              </div>
            </Tabs.Tab>
          </Tabs.List>

          <Tabs.Panel value="dashboards" pt="md">
            <Grid>
              <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 4 }}>
                <Paper withBorder p="md" radius="md">
                  <Title order={3} mb="md">Dashboards</Title>
                  
                  <Select
                    label="Filter by category"
                    placeholder="Select category"
                    value={category}
                    onChange={setCategory}
                    data={[
                      { value: 'all', label: 'All Categories' },
                      { value: 'system', label: 'System' },
                      { value: 'agent', label: 'Agent' },
                      { value: 'performance', label: 'Performance' },
                      { value: 'cost', label: 'Cost' }
                    ]}
                    mb="md"
                  />
                  
                  <Box style={{ maxHeight: '60vh', overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                    {filteredDashboards.map((dashboard) => (
                      <Paper 
                        key={dashboard.id} 
                        p="sm" 
                        withBorder 
                        mb="sm" 
                        style={{
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          backgroundColor: selectedDashboard?.id === dashboard.id 
                            ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)' 
                            : 'transparent',
                          '&:hover': {
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)'
                          }
                        }}
                        onClick={() => handleDashboardSelect(dashboard)}
                      >
                        <Text fw={600}>{dashboard.title}</Text>
                        <Text size="sm" color="dimmed">{dashboard.description}</Text>
                        <Text size="xs" color="dimmed" mt={5}>Category: {dashboard.category}</Text>
                      </Paper>
                    ))}
                  </Box>
                </Paper>
              </Grid.Col>
              
              <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 8 }}>
                <Paper withBorder p="md" radius="md" style={{ minHeight: '70vh' }}>
                  {!selectedDashboard && (
                    <Box style={{

                      alignItems: 'center',

}

import React from 'react';
import { Title, Paper, Text, Container, Grid, Card, RingProgress, Group, ThemeIcon } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconMoneybag } from '../components/layout/icons';

export default function CostManagement() {
  // Example data
  const costData = {
    totalCost: 432.18,
    previousPeriod: 387.45,
    usage: {
      compute: 210.34,
      storage: 98.75,
      network: 54.28,
      api: 68.81
    }
  };

  const percentChange = ((costData.totalCost - costData.previousPeriod) / costData.previousPeriod) * 100;
  const isIncrease = percentChange > 0;

  return (
    <Container size="xl" py="xl">
      <Title order={1} mb="lg">Cost Management</Title>
      
      <Grid>
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 6 }}>
          <Paper withBorder p="xl" radius="md">
            <Group>
              <IconMoneybag size={28} color={isIncrease ? '#ef4444' : '#10b981'} />
              <Title order={3}>Cost Overview</Title>
            </Group>
            <Text size="xl" fw={700} mt="md">${costData.totalCost.toFixed(2)}</Text>
            <Group mt="md">
              <Text c={isIncrease ? 'red' : 'teal'}>
                <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  {isIncrease ? '+' : '-'}
                  {Math.abs(percentChange).toFixed(1)}%
                </span>
              </Text>
              <Text c="dimmed" size="sm">compared to previous period</Text>
            </Group>
          </Paper>
        </Grid.Col>
        
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 6 }}>
          <Paper withBorder p="xl" radius="md">
            <Title order={3}>Resource Distribution</Title>
            <Group mt="md" grow>
              <RingProgress
                size={140}
                thickness={14}
                roundCaps
                sections={[
                  { value: (costData.usage.compute / costData.totalCost) * 100, color: 'blue' },
                  { value: (costData.usage.storage / costData.totalCost) * 100, color: 'cyan' },
                  { value: (costData.usage.network / costData.totalCost) * 100, color: 'indigo' },
                  { value: (costData.usage.api / costData.totalCost) * 100, color: 'violet' },

                <Text size="xs" tt="uppercase" fw={700} c="dimmed">Distribution</Text>

                </Text>
                <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" mt={5}>
                  <Text span c="cyan" fw={500}>Storage:</Text> ${costData.usage.storage.toFixed(2)}
                </Text>
                <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" mt={5}>
                  <Text span c="indigo" fw={500}>Network:</Text> ${costData.usage.network.toFixed(2)}

                <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" mt={5}>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Box, Card, Title, Text, Paper, Group, Table, Badge } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconBrain } from '../components/layout/icons';

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: 'todo' | 'in-progress' | 'review' | 'done';
  assignee?: string;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
}

interface Project {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  tasks?: Task[];
}

export default function ProjectWorkmode() {
  const { projectId } = useParams<{ projectId?: string }>();
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Default project ID if none provided
    const id = projectId || 'proj-1';
    
    // Fetch project data
    fetch(`/mock-api/api/project-${id}.json`)
      .then(response => {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Project data not found');
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(data => {
        setProject(data);
        
        // Use tasks from project data if available
        if (data && data.tasks) {
          setTasks(data.tasks);
        } else {
          // Fallback mock tasks data
          const mockTasks: Task[] = [
            { id: 'task-1', title: 'Implement authentication flow', status: 'todo', priority: 'high' },
            { id: 'task-2', title: 'Fix responsive layout issues', status: 'in-progress', assignee: 'Developer 1', priority: 'medium' },
            { id: 'task-3', title: 'Add unit tests for API', status: 'todo', priority: 'medium' },
            { id: 'task-4', title: 'Update documentation', status: 'review', assignee: 'Developer 2', priority: 'low' },
            { id: 'task-5', title: 'Optimize database queries', status: 'done', assignee: 'Developer 3', priority: 'high' },
          ];
          setTasks(mockTasks);
        }
        
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error fetching project data:', error);
        
        // Set fallback data on error
        const mockProject = {
          id: id,
          name: `Project ${id}`,
          description: 'Customer-facing web application'
        };
        
        setProject(mockProject);
        
        // Fallback mock tasks data
        const mockTasks: Task[] = [
          { id: 'task-1', title: 'Implement authentication flow', status: 'todo', priority: 'high' },
          { id: 'task-2', title: 'Fix responsive layout issues', status: 'in-progress', assignee: 'Developer 1', priority: 'medium' },
          { id: 'task-3', title: 'Add unit tests for API', status: 'todo', priority: 'medium' },
          { id: 'task-4', title: 'Update documentation', status: 'review', assignee: 'Developer 2', priority: 'low' },
          { id: 'task-5', title: 'Optimize database queries', status: 'done', assignee: 'Developer 3', priority: 'high' },
        ];
        
        setTasks(mockTasks);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [projectId]);

  // Function to render status badge
  const renderStatus = (status: string) => {
    const statusConfig = {
      todo: { color: 'gray', label: 'To Do' },
      'in-progress': { color: 'blue', label: 'In Progress' },
      review: { color: 'yellow', label: 'Review' },
      done: { color: 'green', label: 'Done' }
    };
    
    const config = statusConfig[status as keyof typeof statusConfig];
    
    return (
      <Badge color={config.color} size="sm">
        {config.label}
      </Badge>
    );
  };
  
  // Function to render priority
  const renderPriority = (priority: string) => {
    const priorityConfig = {
      high: { color: 'red', label: 'High' },
      medium: { color: 'yellow', label: 'Medium' },
      low: { color: 'green', label: 'Low' }
    };
    
    const config = priorityConfig[priority as keyof typeof priorityConfig];
    
    return (
      <Group gap="xs">
        <Box w={8} h={8} style={{ borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: `var(--mantine-color-${config.color}-filled)` }}></Box>
        <Text size="sm">{config.label}</Text>
      </Group>
    );
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <Box p="xl">Loading project data...</Box>;
  }

  if (!project) {
    return <Box p="xl">Project not found</Box>;
  }

  return (
    <Box p="md">
      {/* Header */}
      <Paper p="md" mb="md" withBorder>
        <Group justify="space-between">
          <Box>
            <Group gap="xs">
              <IconBrain size={24} />
              <Title order={3}>{project.name}</Title>
            </Group>
            <Text color="dimmed">Project Workmode</Text>
          </Box>
        </Group>
      </Paper>

      {/* Content */}
      <Card withBorder p="md" mb="md">
        <Title order={4} mb="md">Tasks</Title>
        
        {tasks.length === 0 ? (
          <Text>No tasks found in this project.</Text>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <Table.Thead>
              <Table.Tr>
                <Table.Th>Title</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>Status</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>Assignee</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>Priority</Table.Th>
              </Table.Tr>
            </Table.Thead>
            <Table.Tbody>
              {tasks.map(task => (
                <Table.Tr key={task.id}>
                  <Table.Td>{task.title}</Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>{renderStatus(task.status)}</Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>{task.assignee || 'Unassigned'}</Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>{renderPriority(task.priority)}</Table.Td>
                </Table.Tr>
              ))}
            </Table.Tbody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </Card>
    </Box>
  );
}

--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\hive-mind\ui\src\pages\TaskBoard.tsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Box, Title, Group, Button, ActionIcon, TextInput, Select, Paper, ScrollArea } from '@mantine/core';
import { DndProvider } from 'react-dnd';
import { HTML5Backend } from 'react-dnd-html5-backend';
import { IconClipboardList, IconPlus, IconSearch } from '../components/layout/icons';
import axios from 'axios';
import BoardColumn from '../components/tasks/BoardColumn';
import TaskModal from '../components/tasks/TaskModal';

interface TaskComment {
  id: string;
  author: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  content: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  assignee: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: 'human' | 'agent';
  };
  priority: string;
  status: string;
  dueDate: string;
  timeEstimate: number;
  tags: string[];
  comments: TaskComment[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface Column {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  tasks: Task[];
}

const TaskBoard: React.FC = () => {
  const [columns, setColumns] = useState<Column[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [createTaskModalOpen, setCreateTaskModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editTaskModalOpen, setEditTaskModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [currentTask, setCurrentTask] = useState<Task | undefined>(undefined);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterPriority, setFilterPriority] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterAssignee, setFilterAssignee] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterTag, setFilterTag] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Mock members for development
  const members = [
    { id: 'usr-001', name: 'John Doe', type: 'human', value: 'usr-001', label: 'John Doe' },
    { id: 'usr-002', name: 'Jane Smith', type: 'human', value: 'usr-002', label: 'Jane Smith' },
    { id: 'usr-003', name: 'Alex Johnson', type: 'human', value: 'usr-003', label: 'Alex Johnson' },
    { id: 'agent-001', name: 'Code Agent', type: 'agent', value: 'agent-001', label: 'Code Agent' },
    { id: 'agent-002', name: 'UI Helper', type: 'agent', value: 'agent-002', label: 'UI Helper' },
    { id: 'agent-003', name: 'API Tester', type: 'agent', value: 'agent-003', label: 'API Tester' },
  ];

  const statusOptions = columns.map(column => ({
    value: column.title,
    label: column.title
  }));

  const tagOptions = Array.from(
    new Set(
      columns
        .flatMap(column => column.tasks)
        .flatMap(task => task.tags)
    )
  ).map(tag => ({
    value: tag,
    label: tag
  }));

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTasks = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const response = await axios.get('/mock-api/api/tasks/board.json');
        setColumns(response.data);
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching task board data:', err);
        setError('Failed to load tasks. Please try again later.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchTasks();
  }, []);

  const handleCreateTask = (newTask: Partial<Task>) => {
    // In a real app, this would call an API to create the task
    const taskId = `task-${Date.now()}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    
    const fullTask: Task = {
      id: taskId,
      title: newTask.title || '',
      description: newTask.description || '',
      assignee: newTask.assignee || {
        id: '',
        name: '',
        type: 'human'
      },
      priority: newTask.priority || 'Medium',
      status: newTask.status || 'To Do',
      dueDate: newTask.dueDate || now,
      timeEstimate: newTask.timeEstimate || 0,
      tags: newTask.tags || [],
      comments: [],
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now
    };

    // Find the column that matches the task status
    const targetColumnIndex = columns.findIndex(column => column.title === fullTask.status);
    if (targetColumnIndex >= 0) {
      const newColumns = [...columns];
      newColumns[targetColumnIndex].tasks.push(fullTask);
      setColumns(newColumns);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateTask = (updatedTask: Partial<Task>) => {
    if (!updatedTask.id) return;

    // Find the task in the columns
    let found = false;
    const newColumns = columns.map(column => {
      const taskIndex = column.tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === updatedTask.id);
      if (taskIndex >= 0) {
        found = true;
        
        // Create updated task
        const updatedTaskFull = {
          ...column.tasks[taskIndex],
          ...updatedTask,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        
        // If status has changed, we need to move the task to a different column
        if (updatedTask.status && updatedTask.status !== column.tasks[taskIndex].status) {
          // Remove from current column
          const newTasks = [...column.tasks];
          newTasks.splice(taskIndex, 1);
          
          return {
            ...column,
            tasks: newTasks
          };
        }
        
        // Update in current column
        const newTasks = [...column.tasks];
        newTasks[taskIndex] = updatedTaskFull;
        
        return {
          ...column,
          tasks: newTasks
        };
      }
      return column;
    });
    
    // If status has changed, add the task to the new column
    if (found && updatedTask.status) {
      const targetColumnIndex = newColumns.findIndex(column => column.title === updatedTask.status);
      if (targetColumnIndex >= 0) {
        // Find the original task
        const originalTask = columns
          .flatMap(column => column.tasks)
          .find(task => task.id === updatedTask.id);
        
        if (originalTask) {
          // Create the updated task
          const updatedTaskFull = {
            ...originalTask,
            ...updatedTask,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };
          
          // Add to new column
          newColumns[targetColumnIndex].tasks.push(updatedTaskFull);
        }
      }
    }
    
    setColumns(newColumns);
  };

  const handleDragDrop = (taskId: string, targetColumnId: string) => {
    // Find the task
    let taskToMove: Task | undefined;
    let sourceColumnIndex = -1;
    let sourceTaskIndex = -1;

    columns.forEach((column, colIndex) => {
      const taskIndex = column.tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === taskId);
      if (taskIndex >= 0) {
        taskToMove = column.tasks[taskIndex];
        sourceColumnIndex = colIndex;
        sourceTaskIndex = taskIndex;
      }
    });

    if (!taskToMove) return;

    // Find the target column
    const targetColumnIndex = columns.findIndex(column => column.id === targetColumnId);
    if (targetColumnIndex < 0) return;

    // Update task status
    const updatedTask = {
      ...taskToMove,
      status: columns[targetColumnIndex].title,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    // Remove from source column
    const newColumns = [...columns];
    newColumns[sourceColumnIndex].tasks.splice(sourceTaskIndex, 1);

    // Add to target column
    newColumns[targetColumnIndex].tasks.push(updatedTask);

    setColumns(newColumns);
  };

  const handleTaskClick = (task: Task) => {
    setCurrentTask(task);
    setEditTaskModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCreateTaskClick = () => {
    setCurrentTask(undefined);
    setCreateTaskModalOpen(true);
  };

  const getFilteredColumns = () => {
    return columns.map(column => {
      const filteredTasks = column.tasks.filter(task => {
        // Apply search filter
        const matchesSearch = searchQuery === '' || 
          task.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          task.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

        // Apply priority filter
        const matchesPriority = !filterPriority || 
          task.priority === filterPriority;

        // Apply assignee filter
        const matchesAssignee = !filterAssignee || 
          task.assignee?.id === filterAssignee;

        // Apply tag filter
        const matchesTag = !filterTag || 
          task.tags.includes(filterTag);

        return matchesSearch && matchesPriority && matchesAssignee && matchesTag;
      });

      return {
        ...column,
        tasks: filteredTasks
      };
    });
  };

  const filteredColumns = getFilteredColumns();

  return (
    <Box p="md">
      <Group position="apart" mb="lg">
        <Group>
          <IconClipboardList size={24} />
          <Title order={2}>Task Board</Title>
        </Group>
        
        <Button
          leftIcon={<IconPlus size={16} />}
          onClick={handleCreateTaskClick}
        >
          New Task
        </Button>
      </Group>
      
      <Paper p="md" mb="md" shadow="xs">
        <Group>
          <TextInput
            placeholder="Search tasks..."
            icon={<IconSearch size={16} />}
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            style={{ flex: 1 }}
          />
          
          <Select
            placeholder="Priority"
            clearable
            data={[
              { value: 'High', label: 'High' },
              { value: 'Medium', label: 'Medium' },
              { value: 'Low', label: 'Low' },
            ]}
            value={filterPriority}
            onChange={setFilterPriority}
            style={{ width: 150 }}
          />
          
          <Select
            placeholder="Assignee"
            clearable
            data={members.map(member => ({
              value: member.id,
              label: member.name
            }))}
            value={filterAssignee}
            onChange={setFilterAssignee}
            style={{ width: 150 }}
          />
          
          <Select
            placeholder="Tag"
            clearable
            data={tagOptions}
            value={filterTag}
            onChange={setFilterTag}
            style={{ width: 150 }}
          />
        </Group>
      </Paper>
      
      <ScrollArea h="calc(100vh - 220px)" type="auto">
        <DndProvider backend={HTML5Backend}>
          <Group align="flex-start" spacing="md" noWrap>
            {filteredColumns.map(column => (
              <BoardColumn
                key={column.id}
                id={column.id}
                title={column.title}
                tasks={column.tasks}
                onDrop={handleDragDrop}
                onTaskClick={handleTaskClick}
              />
            ))}
          </Group>
        </DndProvider>
      </ScrollArea>
      
      {/* Create Task Modal */}
      <TaskModal
        opened={createTaskModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateTaskModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={handleCreateTask}
        statusOptions={statusOptions}
        tagOptions={tagOptions}
        members={members}
      />
      
      {/* Edit Task Modal */}
      {currentTask && (
        <TaskModal
          opened={editTaskModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setEditTaskModalOpen(false)}
          task={currentTask}
          onSave={handleUpdateTask}
          statusOptions={statusOptions}
          tagOptions={tagOptions}
          members={members}
        />
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default TaskBoard;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

interface AgentRole {

  name: string;
  description: string;
  capabilities: string[];
  isRequired: boolean;

interface AgentConfig {
  id: string;
  roleId: string;
  name: string;
  model: string;
  budget: number;
  maxTokens: number;
  customInstructions: string;
}

interface TeamTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  roles: string[];
  budgetAllocation: { [key: string]: number };
  feedbackConfig: FeedbackConfig;
}

interface FeedbackConfig {
  autoRequest: boolean;
  frequency: 'each_step' | 'milestone' | 'completion';
  reviewSteps: boolean;
  incorporationStrategy: 'immediate' | 'review' | 'manual';
}

const defaultFeedbackConfig: FeedbackConfig = {
  autoRequest: true,
  frequency: 'milestone',
  reviewSteps: true,
  incorporationStrategy: 'review'
};

const getTooltip = (key: string): string => {
  const tooltips: { [key: string]: string } = {
    autoRequest: 'Automatically request feedback at specified intervals',
    frequency: 'How often the system should request feedback',
    reviewSteps: 'Allow reviewing individual steps before proceeding',
    incorporationStrategy: 'How feedback should be incorporated into the workflow',
    budgetAllocation: 'Distribute budget across different agents',
    maxTokens: 'Maximum tokens an agent can use per request',
    customInstructions: 'Special instructions for this agent'
  };
  
  return tooltips[key] || 'No additional information available';
};

const TeamCreation: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [teamName, setTeamName] = useState('');
  const [teamDescription, setTeamDescription] = useState('');
  const [selectedRoles, setSelectedRoles] = useState<string[]>(
    availableRoles.filter(role => role.isRequired).map(role => role.id)
  );
  const [agentConfigs, setAgentConfigs] = useState<AgentConfig[]>([]);
  const [totalBudget, setTotalBudget] = useState<number>(100);
  const [modelTier, setModelTier] = useState<string>('standard');
  const [workspaceSettings, setWorkspaceSettings] = useState({
    gitIntegration: false,
    autoCommit: false,
    documentationLevel: 'standard',
    securityChecks: true
  });
  const [feedbackConfig, setFeedbackConfig] = useState<FeedbackConfig>(defaultFeedbackConfig);
  const [activeTemplate, setActiveTemplate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showTooltip, setShowTooltip] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isConfigOpen, setIsConfigOpen] = useState<{ [key: string]: boolean }>({});
  const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showPreview, setShowPreview] = useState(false);
  const [savedConfigs, setSavedConfigs] = useState<{ id: string; name: string }[]>([]);
  
  // Initialize agent configs when roles change
  useEffect(() => {
    const newConfigs = selectedRoles
      .filter(roleId => !agentConfigs.some(config => config.roleId === roleId))
      .map(roleId => {
        const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
        return {
          id: `${roleId}-${Date.now()}`,
          roleId,
          name: role?.name || '',
          model: modelTier,
          budget: Math.floor(totalBudget / selectedRoles.length),
          maxTokens: 4000,
          customInstructions: ''
        };
      });
    
    setAgentConfigs(prev => [...prev.filter(config => selectedRoles.includes(config.roleId)), ...newConfigs]);
  }, [selectedRoles, modelTier]);

  // Apply template
  const applyTemplate = (templateId: string) => {
    const template = teamTemplates.find(t => t.id === templateId);
    if (!template) return;
    
    setSelectedRoles(template.roles);
    setFeedbackConfig(template.feedbackConfig);
    setActiveTemplate(templateId);
    
    // Reset configs to match template
    const newConfigs = template.roles.map(roleId => {
      const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
      return {
        id: `${roleId}-${Date.now()}`,
        roleId,
        name: role?.name || '',
        model: modelTier,
        budget: template.budgetAllocation[roleId] || Math.floor(totalBudget / template.roles.length),
        maxTokens: 4000,
        customInstructions: ''
      };
    });
    
    setAgentConfigs(newConfigs);
  };

  // Handle drag and drop
  const onDragEnd = (result: any) => {
    if (!result.destination) return;
    
    const items = Array.from(selectedRoles);
    const [reorderedItem] = items.splice(result.source.index, 1);
    items.splice(result.destination.index, 0, reorderedItem);
    
    setSelectedRoles(items);
  };

  // Toggle role selection
  const handleRoleToggle = (roleId: string) => {
    const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
    if (role?.isRequired) return;

    setSelectedRoles(prev => 
      prev.includes(roleId)
        ? prev.filter(id => id !== roleId)
        : [...prev, roleId]
    );
    
    // Clear active template if roles don't match anymore
    setActiveTemplate(null);
  };

  // Update agent configuration
  const updateAgentConfig = (id: string, field: keyof AgentConfig, value: any) => {
    setAgentConfigs(prev => prev.map(config => 
      config.id === id ? { ...config, [field]: value } : config
    ));
  };

  // Save current config
  const saveCurrentConfig = () => {
    const configId = `config-${Date.now()}`;
    const configToSave = {
      id: configId,
      name: teamName || `Configuration ${savedConfigs.length + 1}`,
      selectedRoles,
      agentConfigs,
      feedbackConfig,
      workspaceSettings
    };
    
    localStorage.setItem(configId, JSON.stringify(configToSave));
    setSavedConfigs(prev => [...prev, { id: configId, name: configToSave.name }]);
  };

  // Load saved config
  const loadSavedConfig = (configId: string) => {
    const savedConfig = localStorage.getItem(configId);
    if (!savedConfig) return;
    
    const config = JSON.parse(savedConfig);
    setSelectedRoles(config.selectedRoles);
    setAgentConfigs(config.agentConfigs);
    setFeedbackConfig(config.feedbackConfig);
    setWorkspaceSettings(config.workspaceSettings);
    setActiveTemplate(null);
  };

  // Validate team configuration
  const validateTeam = (): string[] => {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    
    if (teamName.trim() === '') {
      errors.push('Team name is required');
    }
    
    if (selectedRoles.length < 2) {
      errors.push('At least two roles are required (including required roles)');
    }
    
    // Check for budget allocation
    const totalAllocated = agentConfigs.reduce((sum, config) => sum + config.budget, 0);
    if (totalAllocated > totalBudget) {
      errors.push(`Budget allocation exceeds total budget (${totalAllocated} > ${totalBudget})`);
    }
    
    return errors;
  };

  // Submit form
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const errors = validateTeam();
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      setValidationErrors(errors);
      return;
    }
    
    setValidationErrors([]);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const response = await axios.post('/api/teams', {
        name: teamName,
        description: teamDescription,
        roles: selectedRoles,
        agentConfigs,
        totalBudget,
        feedbackConfig,
        workspaceSettings
      });

      navigate(`/workspace/${response.data.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setValidationErrors(['Failed to create team. Please try again.']);
      console.error(err);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Toggle agent configuration panel
  const toggleConfigPanel = (roleId: string) => {
    setIsConfigOpen(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [roleId]: !prev[roleId]
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="team-creation-container">
      <div className="creation-header">
        <h1>Create a New Team</h1>
        <p>Configure your AI agent team with specialized roles</p>
      </div>

      {validationErrors.length > 0 && (
        <div className="validation-errors">
          <h3>Please fix the following issues:</h3>
          <ul>
            {validationErrors.map((error, index) => (
              <li key={index}>{error}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="team-templates">
        <h2>Team Templates</h2>
        <p className="section-description">Start with a pre-configured team setup</p>
        
        <div className="templates-grid">
          {teamTemplates.map(template => (
            <div 
              key={template.id}
              className={`template-card ${activeTemplate === template.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => applyTemplate(template.id)}
            >
              <h3>{template.name}</h3>
              <p>{template.description}</p>
              <div className="template-roles">
                {template.roles.map(roleId => {
                  const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
                  return (
                    <span key={roleId} className="role-tag">
                      {role?.name}
                    </span>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="creation-form">
        <div className="form-section">
          <h2>Team Details</h2>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="teamName">Team Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="teamName"
              value={teamName}
              onChange={e => setTeamName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter a name for your team"
              className="form-control"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="teamDescription">Team Description</label>
            <textarea
              id="teamDescription"
              value={teamDescription}
              onChange={e => setTeamDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Describe what this team will be working on"
              className="form-control"
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>
          
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="totalBudget">Total Budget (USD)</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              id="totalBudget"
              min="10"
              max="1000"
              value={totalBudget}
              onChange={e => setTotalBudget(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="form-control"
            />
            <span className="form-hint">Maximum budget allowed for this team's operations</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="form-section">
          <h2>Agent Roles</h2>
          <p className="section-description">
            Select and arrange agent roles for your team 
            <span 
              className="tooltip-trigger"
              onMouseEnter={() => setShowTooltip('roles')}
              onMouseLeave={() => setShowTooltip(null)}
            >
              ℹ️
            </span>
          </p>
          {showTooltip === 'roles' && (
            <div className="tooltip">
              Drag and drop roles to change their priority. Click on a role to select/deselect it.
            </div>
          )}
          
          <div className="roles-grid">
            {availableRoles.map(role => (
              <div 
                key={role.id}
                className={`role-card ${selectedRoles.includes(role.id) ? 'selected' : ''} ${role.isRequired ? 'required' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => handleRoleToggle(role.id)}
              >
                <div className="role-header">
                  <h3>{role.name}</h3>
                  {role.isRequired && <span className="required-badge">Required</span>}
                </div>
                <p className="role-description">{role.description}</p>
                <div className="role-capabilities">
                  <h4>Capabilities:</h4>
                  <ul>
                    {role.capabilities.map((capability, index) => (
                      <li key={index}>{capability}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
                <div className="selection-indicator">
                  {selectedRoles.includes(role.id) ? '✓' : '+'}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          
          <h3>Team Composition</h3>
          <div className="team-composition">
            <DragDropContext onDragEnd={onDragEnd}>
              <Droppable droppableId="team-roles" direction="horizontal">
                {(provided) => (
                  <div
                    className="composition-container"
                    {...provided.droppableProps}
                    ref={provided.innerRef}
                  >
                    {selectedRoles.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="no-roles-selected">No roles selected</div>
                    ) : (
                      selectedRoles.map((roleId, index) => {
                        const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
                        const config = agentConfigs.find(c => c.roleId === roleId);
                        
                        return (
                          <Draggable key={roleId} draggableId={roleId} index={index}>
                            {(provided) => (
                              <div
                                className="composition-role"
                                ref={provided.innerRef}
                                {...provided.draggableProps}
                                {...provided.dragHandleProps}
                              >
                                <div className="composition-role-header">
                                  <span className="role-name">{role?.name}</span>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="config-toggle"
                                    onClick={(e) => {
                                      e.stopPropagation();
                                      toggleConfigPanel(roleId);
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    {isConfigOpen[roleId] ? '▲' : '▼'}
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                                
                                {isConfigOpen[roleId] && config && (
                                  <div className="agent-config-panel">
                                    <div className="config-group">
                                      <label htmlFor={`${roleId}-name`}>Agent Name</label>
                                      <input
                                        type="text"
                                        id={`${roleId}-name`}
                                        value={config.name}
                                        onChange={(e) => updateAgentConfig(config.id, 'name', e.target.value)}
                                        className="config-input"
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    <div className="config-group">
                                      <label htmlFor={`${roleId}-model`}>
                                        Model
                                        <span

                                          ℹ️

                                      {showTooltip === `model-${roleId}` && (
                                        <div className="tooltip">
                                          Select the LLM model for this agent
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                      <select
                                        id={`${roleId}-model`}
                                        value={config.model}
                                        onChange={(e) => updateAgentConfig(config.id, 'model', e.target.value)}
                                        className="config-select"
                                      >
                                        <option value="economy">Economy (GPT-3.5-Turbo)</option>
                                        <option value="standard">Standard (GPT-4o)</option>
                                        <option value="premium">Premium (Claude-3-Opus)</option>
                                      </select>
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    <div className="config-group">
                                      <label htmlFor={`${roleId}-budget`}>
                                        Budget Allocation
                                        <span 
                                          className="tooltip-trigger"
                                          onMouseEnter={() => setShowTooltip(`budget-${roleId}`)}
                                          onMouseLeave={() => setShowTooltip(null)}
                                        >
                                          ℹ️
                                        </span>
                                      </label>
                                      {showTooltip === `budget-${roleId}` && (
                                        <div className="tooltip">
                                          {getTooltip('budgetAllocation')}
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                      <input
                                        type="range"
                                        id={`${roleId}-budget`}
                                        min="5"
                                        max={Math.min(totalBudget, 70)}
                                        value={config.budget}
                                        onChange={(e) => updateAgentConfig(config.id, 'budget', Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="config-slider"
                                      />
                                      <div className="slider-value">${config.budget}</div>
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    <div className="config-group">
                                      <label htmlFor={`${roleId}-tokens`}>Max Tokens</label>
                                      <input
                                        type="number"
                                        id={`${roleId}-tokens`}
                                        min="1000"
                                        max="16000"
                                        step="1000"
                                        value={config.maxTokens}
                                        onChange={(e) => updateAgentConfig(config.id, 'maxTokens', Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="config-input"
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    <div className="config-group">
                                      <label htmlFor={`${roleId}-instructions`}>Custom Instructions</label>
                                      <textarea
                                        id={`${roleId}-instructions`}
                                        value={config.customInstructions}
                                        onChange={(e) => updateAgentConfig(config.id, 'customInstructions', e.target.value)}
                                        className="config-textarea"
                                        rows={3}
                                        placeholder="Add any special instructions for this agent..."
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </Draggable>
                        );
                      })
                    )}
                    {provided.placeholder}
                  </div>
                )}
              </Droppable>
            </DragDropContext>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="form-section">
          <h2>Feedback Loop Configuration</h2>
          <p className="section-description">Configure how the team handles feedback during tasks</p>

            <div className="config-group">

                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={feedbackConfig.autoRequest}
                  onChange={(e) => setFeedbackConfig({...feedbackConfig, autoRequest: e.target.checked})}
                />
                <span>Automatic Feedback Requests</span>
                <span 
                  className="tooltip-trigger"
                  onMouseEnter={() => setShowTooltip('autoRequest')}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setShowTooltip(null)}
                >
                  ℹ️
                </span>
              </label>
              {showTooltip === 'autoRequest' && (
                <div className="tooltip">{getTooltip('autoRequest')}</div>
              )}

              {showTooltip === 'frequency' && (

                <label className="radio-label">
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="frequency"
                    value="completion"

                    onChange={() => setFeedbackConfig({...feedbackConfig, frequency: 'completion'})}

                  <span>On Completion</span>

              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="config-group">
              <label className="checkbox-label">

                  type="checkbox"

                />
                <span>Step-by-Step Review</span>

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { 
  Box, 
  Title, 
  Text, 
  Card, 
  Group, 
  Button, 
  Grid, 
  Badge, 
  Loader, 
  ActionIcon,
  Flex,
  Paper,
  Modal,
  TextInput,
  Textarea
} from '@mantine/core';
import axios from 'axios';

interface Workspace {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  projects: number;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  owner: string;
}

// Fallback mock data in case the API fails
const mockWorkspaces: Workspace[] = [
  {
    "id": "ws-001",
    "name": "Frontend Development",
    "description": "Workspace for all frontend related projects",
    "projects": 5,
    "created_at": "2023-06-15T10:30:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2023-10-22T14:45:00Z",
    "owner": "John Doe"
  },
  {
    "id": "ws-002",
    "name": "Backend Systems",
    "description": "API and database infrastructure projects",
    "projects": 3,
    "created_at": "2023-07-10T09:15:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2023-10-18T11:20:00Z",
    "owner": "Jane Smith"
  },
  {
    "id": "ws-003",
    "name": "Mobile Applications",
    "description": "iOS and Android app development",
    "projects": 2,
    "created_at": "2023-08-05T13:45:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2023-10-20T16:30:00Z",
    "owner": "Alex Johnson"
  }
];

export default function Workspaces() {
  const [workspaces, setWorkspaces] = useState<Workspace[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [createModalOpen, setCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newWorkspaceName, setNewWorkspaceName] = useState('');
  const [newWorkspaceDesc, setNewWorkspaceDesc] = useState('');
  
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchWorkspaces = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        // Try multiple paths to find the mock data
        try {
          const response = await axios.get('/mock-api/api/workspaces.json');
          setWorkspaces(response.data);
        } catch (innerErr) {
          // Try another common path
          try {
            const response = await axios.get('/public/mock-api/api/workspaces.json');
            setWorkspaces(response.data);
          } catch (anotherErr) {
            // Use the hardcoded fallback data
            console.log('Using fallback mock workspaces data');
            setWorkspaces(mockWorkspaces);
          }
        }
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching workspaces:', err);
        // Use the hardcoded fallback data
        console.log('Using fallback mock workspaces data after error');
        setWorkspaces(mockWorkspaces);
        setError(''); // Clear error since we're using fallback data
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchWorkspaces();
  }, []);

  const handleCreateWorkspace = () => {
    // In a real implementation, this would make an API call
    const newWorkspace = {
      id: `ws-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      name: newWorkspaceName,
      description: newWorkspaceDesc,
      projects: 0,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      owner: 'Current User'
    };

    setWorkspaces([...workspaces, newWorkspace]);
    setCreateModalOpen(false);
    setNewWorkspaceName('');
    setNewWorkspaceDesc('');
  };

  return (
    <Box p="md">
      <Flex justify="space-between" align="center" mb="xl">
        <Title>Workspaces</Title>
        <Button onClick={() => setCreateModalOpen(true)}>Create Workspace</Button>
      </Flex>

      {loading ? (
        <Flex justify="center" align="center" style={{ height: '200px' }}>
          <Loader size="lg" />
        </Flex>
      ) : error ? (
        <Paper p="xl" withBorder radius="md" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FEF2F2' }}>
          <Text c="red">{error}</Text>
        </Paper>
      ) : workspaces.length === 0 ? (
        <Paper p="xl" withBorder radius="md" ta="center">
          <Text size="lg" fw={500} mb="md">No workspaces found</Text>
          <Text mb="lg">Get started by creating your first workspace</Text>
          <Button onClick={() => setCreateModalOpen(true)}>Create Workspace</Button>
        </Paper>
      ) : (
        <Grid>
          {workspaces.map((workspace) => (
            <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 6, lg: 4 }} key={workspace.id}>
              <Card withBorder shadow="sm" radius="md" padding="lg">
                <Card.Section withBorder inheritPadding py="xs">
                  <Title order={3}>{workspace.name}</Title>
                </Card.Section>
                
                <Text mt="md" mb="md" c="dimmed" lineClamp={2}>
                  {workspace.description}
                </Text>
                
                <Group mt="md" mb="md">
                  <Badge color="blue">{workspace.projects} Projects</Badge>
                  <Badge color="gray">Updated: {new Date(workspace.updated_at).toLocaleDateString()}</Badge>
                </Group>
                
                <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
                  Owner: {workspace.owner}
                </Text>
                
                <Button 
                  fullWidth 
                  mt="md" 
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/workspaces/${workspace.id}`)}
                >
                  Open Workspace
                </Button>
              </Card>
            </Grid.Col>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      )}

      <Modal
        opened={createModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateModalOpen(false)}
        title="Create New Workspace"
        size="md"
      >
        <Box>
          <TextInput
            label="Workspace Name"
            placeholder="Enter workspace name"
            value={newWorkspaceName}
            onChange={(e) => setNewWorkspaceName(e.target.value)}
            required
            mb="md"
          />
          
          <Textarea
            label="Description"
            placeholder="Describe the purpose of this workspace"
            value={newWorkspaceDesc}
            onChange={(e) => setNewWorkspaceDesc(e.target.value)}
            minRows={3}
            mb="xl"
          />
          
          <Group justify="flex-end">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateModalOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={handleCreateWorkspace}
              disabled={!newWorkspaceName.trim()}
            >
              Create
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Box>
      </Modal>
    </Box>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Box, Card, Title, Text, Paper, Grid, Button, Group } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconFolders } from '../components/layout/icons';

interface Project {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
}

export default function WorkspaceWorkmode() {
  const { workspaceId } = useParams<{ workspaceId?: string }>();
  const [workspace, setWorkspace] = useState({ id: '', name: '', description: '' });
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Fetch workspace data
    const apiUrl = workspaceId 
      ? `/mock-api/api/workspace-${workspaceId}.json`
      : '/mock-api/api/workspaces.json';
      
    fetch(apiUrl)
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(data => {
        // If we fetched a list of workspaces, find the specific one
        const workspaceData = workspaceId 
          ? data 
          : data.find((w: any) => w.id === 'ws-001') || data[0];
        
        setWorkspace(workspaceData || { id: '', name: 'Workspace not found', description: '' });
        
        // Use projects from the workspace data if available, otherwise use mock data
        if (workspaceData && workspaceData.projects) {
          setProjects(workspaceData.projects);
        } else {
          // Mock projects data as fallback
          const mockProjects: Project[] = [
            { id: 'proj-1', name: 'Frontend Application', description: 'Customer-facing web application' },
            { id: 'proj-2', name: 'Backend API', description: 'RESTful API services' },
            { id: 'proj-3', name: 'Database Layer', description: 'Data persistence and access' },
            { id: 'proj-4', name: 'DevOps Pipeline', description: 'CI/CD automation' },
          ];
          setProjects(mockProjects);
        }
        
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error fetching workspace data:', error);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [workspaceId]);

  if (loading) {
    return <Box p="xl">Loading workspace data...</Box>;
  }

  if (!workspace.id) {
    return <Box p="xl">Workspace not found</Box>;
  }

  return (
    <Box p="md">
      {/* Header */}
      <Paper p="md" mb="md" withBorder>
        <Group justify="space-between">
          <Box>
            <Title order={3}>{workspace.name}</Title>
            <Text color="dimmed">Workspace Workmode</Text>
          </Box>
        </Group>
      </Paper>

      {/* Content */}
      <Card withBorder p="md" mb="md">
        <Title order={4} mb="md">Projects in this Workspace</Title>
        
        <Grid>
          {projects.map(project => (
            <Grid.Col key={project.id} span={{ base: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }}>
              <Card withBorder p="md" radius="md">
                <Group justify="space-between" mb="xs">
                  <Text fw={500}>{project.name}</Text>
                  <IconFolders size={20} />
                </Group>
                <Text size="sm" color="dimmed" mb="md">{project.description}</Text>
                <Button 
                  component="a" 
                  href={`/project-workmode/${project.id}`} 
                  variant="light" 
                  color="blue" 
                  fullWidth
                >
                  Open Project Workmode
                </Button>
              </Card>
            </Grid.Col>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      </Card>
    </Box>
  );
}
