import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';

interface Collaborator {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  avatar: string;
  status: 'active' | 'idle' | 'offline';
  cursor?: {
    file: string;
    position: { line: number; column: number };
  };
  lastActive: string;
}

interface Comment {
  id: string;
  author: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    avatar: string;
  };
  content: string;
  file: string;
  line: number;
  timestamp: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  replies: Comment[];
}

interface CollaborationPanelProps {
  projectId: string;
  currentFile: string | null;
}

const CollaborationPanel: React.FC<CollaborationPanelProps> = ({
  projectId,
  currentFile
}) => {
  const [collaborators, setCollaborators] = useState<Collaborator[]>([]);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<Comment[]>([]);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'collaborators' | 'comments'>('collaborators');
  const [socket, setSocket] = useState<Socket | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const commentInputRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  // Connect to WebSocket when component mounts
  useEffect(() => {
    const socketUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_WS_URL || 'ws://localhost:8000/ws';
    const newSocket = io(socketUrl, {
      query: { projectId }
    });

    newSocket.on('connect', () => {
      console.log('Connected to collaboration server');
    });

    newSocket.on('disconnect', () => {
      console.log('Disconnected from collaboration server');
    });

    newSocket.on('collaborator_joined', (collaborator: Collaborator) => {
      setCollaborators(prevCollaborators => {
        if (prevCollaborators.some(c => c.id === collaborator.id)) {
          return prevCollaborators.map(c => 
            c.id === collaborator.id ? { ...c, status: 'active' } : c
          );
        } else {
          return [...prevCollaborators, collaborator];
        }
      });
    });

    newSocket.on('collaborator_left', (collaboratorId: string) => {
      setCollaborators(prevCollaborators => 
        prevCollaborators.map(c => 
          c.id === collaboratorId ? { ...c, status: 'offline' } : c
        )
      );
    });

    newSocket.on('cursor_moved', (data: { userId: string; file: string; position: { line: number; column: number } }) => {
      setCollaborators(prevCollaborators => 
        prevCollaborators.map(c => 
          c.id === data.userId 
            ? { 
                ...c, 
                cursor: { 
                  file: data.file, 
                  position: data.position 
                },
                lastActive: new Date().toISOString()
              } 
            : c
        )
      );
    });

    newSocket.on('comment_added', (comment: Comment) => {
      setComments(prevComments => [...prevComments, comment]);
    });

    newSocket.on('comment_updated', (updatedComment: Comment) => {
      setComments(prevComments => 
        prevComments.map(c => 
          c.id === updatedComment.id ? updatedComment : c
        )
      );
    });

    setSocket(newSocket);

    return () => {
      newSocket.disconnect();
    };
  }, [projectId]);

  // Fetch initial collaborators and comments data
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchCollaborationData = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const [collaboratorsResponse, commentsResponse] = await Promise.all([
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/collaborators`),
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/comments`)
        ]);
        
        setCollaborators(collaboratorsResponse.data);
        setComments(commentsResponse.data);
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load collaboration data');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchCollaborationData();
  }, [projectId]);

  // Update cursor position
  const updateCursorPosition = (position: { line: number; column: number }) => {
    if (socket && currentFile) {
      socket.emit('cursor_move', {
        file: currentFile,
        position
      });
    }
  };

  // Add new comment
  const handleAddComment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!newComment.trim() || !currentFile) return;
    
    try {
      const response = await axios.post(`/api/projects/${projectId}/comments`, {
        content: newComment,
        file: currentFile,
        line: 1, // This should be the actual line number where the comment is being added
      });
      
      setComments(prevComments => [...prevComments, response.data]);
      setNewComment('');
      
      // Also emit via socket for real-time updates
      if (socket) {
        socket.emit('comment_add', response.data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to add comment');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Toggle comment resolution
  const handleToggleResolution = async (commentId: string, resolved: boolean) => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.patch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/comments/${commentId}`, {
        resolved: !resolved
      });
      
      setComments(prevComments => 
        prevComments.map(c => 
          c.id === commentId ? response.data : c
        )
      );
      
      // Also emit via socket for real-time updates
      if (socket) {
        socket.emit('comment_update', response.data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to update comment');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Filter comments by current file
  const currentFileComments = currentFile 
    ? comments.filter(comment => comment.file === currentFile)
    : comments;

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading collaboration data...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="collaboration-panel">
      <div className="tabs">
        <button 
          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'collaborators' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('collaborators')}
        >
          Collaborators ({collaborators.filter(c => c.status === 'active').length})
        </button>
        <button 
          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'comments' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('comments')}
        >
          Comments ({currentFileComments.length})
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error-message">{error}</div>}

      <div className="tab-content">
        {activeTab === 'collaborators' && (
          <div className="collaborators-list">
            {collaborators.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="empty-message">No collaborators yet</p>
            ) : (
              collaborators.map(collaborator => (
                <div 
                  key={collaborator.id} 
                  className={`collaborator-item ${collaborator.status}`}
                >
                  <div className="collaborator-avatar">
                    <img src={collaborator.avatar} alt={collaborator.name} />
                    <span className={`status-indicator ${collaborator.status}`}></span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="collaborator-info">
                    <div className="collaborator-name">{collaborator.name}</div>
                    <div className="collaborator-status">
                      {collaborator.status === 'active' && collaborator.cursor ? (
                        <span>
                          Editing {collaborator.cursor.file} at line {collaborator.cursor.position.line}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span>
                          {collaborator.status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 
                           collaborator.status === 'idle' ? 'Idle' : 'Offline'}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="collaborator-time">
                    {collaborator.lastActive && 
                      `Last active: ${new Date(collaborator.lastActive).toLocaleTimeString()}`}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'comments' && (
          <div className="comments-container">
            <div className="comments-list">
              {currentFileComments.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="empty-message">No comments for this file</p>
              ) : (
                currentFileComments.map(comment => (
                  <div 
                    key={comment.id} 
                    className={`comment-item ${comment.resolved ? 'resolved' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <div className="comment-header">
                      <div className="comment-author">
                        <img src={comment.author.avatar} alt={comment.author.name} />
                        <span>{comment.author.name}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="comment-time">
                        {new Date(comment.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="comment-content">{comment.content}</div>
                    <div className="comment-actions">
                      <button 
                        className={`btn btn-sm ${comment.resolved ? 'btn-success' : 'btn-outline-success'}`}
                        onClick={() => handleToggleResolution(comment.id, comment.resolved)}
                      >
                        {comment.resolved ? 'Resolved' : 'Resolve'}
                      </button>
                      <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">
                        Reply
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    {comment.replies.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="comment-replies">
                        {comment.replies.map(reply => (
                          <div key={reply.id} className="reply-item">
                            <div className="reply-header">
                              <div className="reply-author">
                                <img src={reply.author.avatar} alt={reply.author.name} />
                                <span>{reply.author.name}</span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="reply-time">
                                {new Date(reply.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="reply-content">{reply.content}</div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            {currentFile && (
              <form className="add-comment-form" onSubmit={handleAddComment}>
                <textarea
                  ref={commentInputRef}
                  className="comment-input"
                  placeholder="Add a comment..."
                  value={newComment}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                ></textarea>
                <button 
                  type="submit" 
                  className="btn btn-primary"
                  disabled={!newComment.trim()}
                >
                  Add Comment
                </button>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\src\components\FileManager.tsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { Prism as SyntaxHighlighter } from 'react-syntax-highlighter';
import { vscDarkPlus } from 'react-syntax-highlighter/dist/esm/styles/prism';
import ReactDiffViewer from 'react-diff-viewer';

interface FileNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'file' | 'directory';
  path: string;
  children?: FileNode[];
}

interface FileVersion {
  id: string;
  version: number;
  commit_hash: string;
  commit_message: string;
  author: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

interface FileManagerProps {
  projectId: string;
  onFileSelect?: (filePath: string, content: string) => void;
}

const FileManager: React.FC<FileManagerProps> = ({ projectId, onFileSelect }) => {
  const [fileTree, setFileTree] = useState<FileNode[]>([]);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fileContent, setFileContent] = useState<string>('');
  const [fileVersions, setFileVersions] = useState<FileVersion[]>([]);
  const [selectedVersion, setSelectedVersion] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [compareVersion, setCompareVersion] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [versionContent, setVersionContent] = useState<string>('');
  const [compareContent, setCompareContent] = useState<string>('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'code' | 'diff'>('code');

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchFileTree = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const response = await axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/files`);
        setFileTree(response.data);
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load file structure');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchFileTree();
  }, [projectId]);

  const handleFileSelect = async (filePath: string, fileType: string) => {
    if (fileType === 'directory') return;
    
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      
      // Fetch current file content
      const contentResponse = await axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/files/${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}/content`);
      setFileContent(contentResponse.data.content);
      setSelectedFile(filePath);
      
      // Fetch file version history
      const versionsResponse = await axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/files/${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}/versions`);
      setFileVersions(versionsResponse.data);
      
      // Reset version selections
      setSelectedVersion(null);
      setCompareVersion(null);
      setVersionContent('');
      setCompareContent('');
      
      // Set view mode back to code
      setViewMode('code');
      
      // Call the onFileSelect callback if provided
      if (onFileSelect) {
        onFileSelect(filePath, contentResponse.data.content);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load file content');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVersionSelect = async (versionId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/files/${encodeURIComponent(selectedFile!)}/versions/${versionId}/content`);
      setSelectedVersion(versionId);
      setVersionContent(response.data.content);
      
      if (compareVersion) {
        setViewMode('diff');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load version content');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handleCompareVersionSelect = async (versionId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/files/${encodeURIComponent(selectedFile!)}/versions/${versionId}/content`);
      setCompareVersion(versionId);
      setCompareContent(response.data.content);
      
      if (selectedVersion) {
        setViewMode('diff');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load compare version content');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const getFileExtension = (filename: string): string => {
    const parts = filename.split('.');
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      return parts[parts.length - 1].toLowerCase();
    }
    return '';
  };

  const getLanguageFromExtension = (extension: string): string => {
    const languageMap: { [key: string]: string } = {
      'js': 'javascript',
      'jsx': 'jsx',
      'ts': 'typescript',
      'tsx': 'tsx',
      'py': 'python',
      'rb': 'ruby',
      'go': 'go',
      'java': 'java',
      'c': 'c',
      'cpp': 'cpp',
      'cs': 'csharp',
      'html': 'html',
      'css': 'css',
      'scss': 'scss',
      'json': 'json',
      'md': 'markdown',
      'yml': 'yaml',
      'yaml': 'yaml',
      'sh': 'bash',
      'bash': 'bash',
      'php': 'php',
      'sql': 'sql',
      'txt': 'text',
    };
    
    return languageMap[extension] || 'text';
  };

  const renderFileTree = (nodes: FileNode[], depth = 0) => {
    return nodes.map((node) => (
      <div key={node.id}>
        <div 
          className={`file-item ${node.type} ${selectedFile === node.path ? 'active' : ''}`}
          style={{ marginLeft: `${depth * 16}px` }}
          onClick={() => handleFileSelect(node.path, node.type)}
        >
          {node.type === 'directory' ? '📁' : '📄'} {node.name}
        </div>
        {node.children && node.children.length > 0 && renderFileTree(node.children, depth + 1)}
      </div>
    ));
  };

  if (isLoading && fileTree.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading files...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const getFileLanguage = () => {
    if (!selectedFile) return 'text';
    const extension = getFileExtension(selectedFile);
    return getLanguageFromExtension(extension);
  };

  return (
    <div className="file-manager">
      <div className="file-manager-container">
        <div className="file-tree-panel">
          <div className="panel-header">
            <h3>Files</h3>
          </div>
          <div className="file-tree">
            {fileTree.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="empty-message">No files</p>
            ) : (
              renderFileTree(fileTree)
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="file-content-panel">
          {selectedFile ? (
            <>
              <div className="file-content-header">
                <h3>{selectedFile}</h3>
                <div className="view-controls">
                  <button 
                    className={`btn ${viewMode === 'code' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}`}
                    onClick={() => setViewMode('code')}
                  >
                    Code
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    className={`btn ${viewMode === 'diff' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}`}
                    onClick={() => setViewMode('diff')}
                    disabled={!selectedVersion || !compareVersion}
                  >
                    Diff
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {error && <div className="error-message">{error}</div>}

              <div className="file-content-wrapper">
                {viewMode === 'code' ? (
                  <SyntaxHighlighter 
                    language={getFileLanguage()} 
                    style={vscDarkPlus}
                    showLineNumbers={true}
                    wrapLines={true}
                  >
                    {selectedVersion ? versionContent : fileContent}
                  </SyntaxHighlighter>
                ) : (
                  <ReactDiffViewer
                    oldValue={compareContent}
                    newValue={versionContent}
                    splitView={true}
                    useDarkTheme={true}
                    showLineNumbers={true}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="empty-state">
              <p>Select a file to view its content</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {selectedFile && (
          <div className="version-history-panel">
            <div className="panel-header">
              <h3>Version History</h3>
            </div>
            
            {fileVersions.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="empty-message">No version history available</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="versions-list">
                <div className="version-select-controls">
                  <div className="version-select">
                    <label>Version 1:</label>
                    <select 
                      value={selectedVersion || ''} 
                      onChange={(e) => handleVersionSelect(e.target.value)}
                    >
                      <option value="">Current</option>
                      {fileVersions.map(version => (
                        <option key={version.id} value={version.id}>
                          v{version.version} - {new Date(version.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="version-select">
                    <label>Version 2:</label>
                    <select 
                      value={compareVersion || ''} 
                      onChange={(e) => handleCompareVersionSelect(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={!selectedVersion}
                    >
                      <option value="">Select version to compare</option>
                      {fileVersions
                        .filter(version => version.id !== selectedVersion)
                        .map(version => (
                          <option key={version.id} value={version.id}>
                            v{version.version} - {new Date(version.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </option>
                        ))
                      }
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div className="versions-history-list">
                  {fileVersions.map(version => (
                    <div 
                      key={version.id} 
                      className={`version-item ${selectedVersion === version.id ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => handleVersionSelect(version.id)}
                    >
                      <div className="version-header">
                        <span className="version-number">v{version.version}</span>
                        <span className="version-date">
                          {new Date(version.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="version-author">{version.author}</div>
                      <div className="version-message">{version.commit_message}</div>
                      <div className="version-hash">{version.commit_hash.substring(0, 7)}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default FileManager;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';

interface Agent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  description: string;
  model: string;
  capabilities: string[];
  active: boolean;
}

interface TeamMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'admin' | 'editor' | 'viewer';
  avatar: string;
}

interface ProjectConfigProps {
  projectId: string;
  onUpdate?: () => void;
}

const ProjectConfig: React.FC<ProjectConfigProps> = ({ projectId, onUpdate }) => {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [teamMembers, setTeamMembers] = useState<TeamMember[]>([]);
  const [availableAgents, setAvailableAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [newMemberEmail, setNewMemberEmail] = useState('');
  const [newMemberRole, setNewMemberRole] = useState<'editor' | 'viewer'>('editor');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'agents' | 'team'>('agents');
  const [modelTier, setModelTier] = useState('standard');
  const [budgetLimit, setBudgetLimit] = useState(100);

  // Fetch project configuration data
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchProjectConfig = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const [
          agentsResponse, 
          teamResponse, 
          availableAgentsResponse,
          projectResponse
        ] = await Promise.all([
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/agents`),
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/team`),
          axios.get('/api/available-agents'),
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}`)
        ]);
        
        setAgents(agentsResponse.data);
        setTeamMembers(teamResponse.data);
        setAvailableAgents(availableAgentsResponse.data);
        setModelTier(projectResponse.data.model_tier);
        setBudgetLimit(projectResponse.data.budget_limit);
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load project configuration');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchProjectConfig();
  }, [projectId]);

  // Toggle agent activation
  const handleToggleAgent = async (agentId: string, currentlyActive: boolean) => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.patch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/agents/${agentId}`, {
        active: !currentlyActive
      });
      
      setAgents(prevAgents => 
        prevAgents.map(agent => 
          agent.id === agentId ? response.data : agent
        )
      );
      
      if (onUpdate) {
        onUpdate();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to update agent configuration');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Add a new agent to the project
  const handleAddAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.post(`/api/projects/${projectId}/agents`, {
        agent_id: agentId
      });
      
      setAgents(prevAgents => [...prevAgents, response.data]);
      
      if (onUpdate) {
        onUpdate();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to add agent to project');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Remove an agent from the project
  const handleRemoveAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      await axios.delete(`/api/projects/${projectId}/agents/${agentId}`);
      
      setAgents(prevAgents => 
        prevAgents.filter(agent => agent.id !== agentId)
      );
      
      if (onUpdate) {
        onUpdate();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to remove agent from project');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Invite a new team member
  const handleInviteTeamMember = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!newMemberEmail.trim()) return;
    
    try {
      const response = await axios.post(`/api/projects/${projectId}/team/invite`, {
        email: newMemberEmail,
        role: newMemberRole
      });
      
      setTeamMembers(prevMembers => [...prevMembers, response.data]);
      setNewMemberEmail('');
      
      if (onUpdate) {
        onUpdate();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to invite team member');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Update team member role
  const handleUpdateMemberRole = async (memberId: string, newRole: 'admin' | 'editor' | 'viewer') => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.patch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/team/${memberId}`, {
        role: newRole
      });
      
      setTeamMembers(prevMembers => 
        prevMembers.map(member => 
          member.id === memberId ? response.data : member
        )
      );
      
      if (onUpdate) {
        onUpdate();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to update team member role');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Remove team member
  const handleRemoveTeamMember = async (memberId: string) => {
    try {
      await axios.delete(`/api/projects/${projectId}/team/${memberId}`);
      
      setTeamMembers(prevMembers => 
        prevMembers.filter(member => member.id !== memberId)
      );
      
      if (onUpdate) {
        onUpdate();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to remove team member');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Update project settings
  const handleUpdateProjectSettings = async () => {
    try {
      await axios.patch(`/api/projects/${projectId}`, {
        model_tier: modelTier,
        budget_limit: budgetLimit
      });
      
      if (onUpdate) {
        onUpdate();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to update project settings');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading project configuration...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="project-config">
      <div className="tabs">
        <button 
          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'agents' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('agents')}
        >
          AI Agents
        </button>
        <button 
          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'team' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('team')}
        >
          Team Members
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error-message">{error}</div>}

      <div className="project-settings">
        <h3>Project Settings</h3>
        <div className="settings-form">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label>Model Tier</label>
            <select 
              value={modelTier} 
              onChange={(e) => setModelTier(e.target.value)}
              className="form-select"
            >
              <option value="basic">Basic</option>
              <option value="standard">Standard</option>
              <option value="premium">Premium</option>
              <option value="enterprise">Enterprise</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          
          <div className="form-group">
            <label>Budget Limit ($)</label>
            <input 
              type="number" 
              value={budgetLimit} 
              onChange={(e) => setBudgetLimit(parseInt(e.target.value))}
              min="0"
              className="form-control"
            />
          </div>
          
          <button 
            className="btn btn-primary"
            onClick={handleUpdateProjectSettings}
          >
            Update Settings
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'agents' && (
        <div className="agents-config">
          <div className="active-agents">
            <h3>Project Agents</h3>
            {agents.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="empty-message">No agents configured for this project</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="agents-list">
                {agents.map(agent => (
                  <div key={agent.id} className="agent-card" onClick={() => window.location.href = `/agents/${agent.id}`} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    <div className="agent-header">
                      <h4>{agent.name}</h4>
                      <div className="agent-actions">
                        <label className="switch">
                          <input 
                            type="checkbox" 
                            checked={agent.active}
                            onChange={() => handleToggleAgent(agent.id, agent.active)}
                          />
                          <span className="slider round"></span>
                        </label>
                        <button 
                          className="btn btn-danger btn-sm"
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            handleRemoveAgent(agent.id);
                          }}
                        >
                          Remove
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="agent-role">{agent.role}</div>
                    <div className="agent-description">{agent.description}</div>
                    <div className="agent-details">
                      <div className="detail-item">
                        <span className="detail-label">Model:</span>
                        <span className="detail-value">{agent.model}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="detail-item">
                        <span className="detail-label">Capabilities:</span>
                        <div className="capabilities-list">
                          {agent.capabilities.map((capability, index) => (
                            <span key={index} className="capability-tag">{capability}</span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="available-agents">
            <h3>Available Agents</h3>
            <div className="available-agents-list">
              {availableAgents
                .filter(availableAgent => !agents.some(agent => agent.id === availableAgent.id))
                .map(agent => (
                  <div key={agent.id} className="available-agent-card">
                    <div className="agent-info">
                      <h4>{agent.name}</h4>
                      <div className="agent-role">{agent.role}</div>
                      <div className="agent-description">{agent.description}</div>
                    </div>
                    <button 
                      className="btn btn-primary"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        handleAddAgent(agent.id);
                      }}
                    >
                      Add to Project
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              }
              
              {availableAgents.length === 0 && (
                <p className="empty-message">No additional agents available</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeTab === 'team' && (
        <div className="team-config">
          <div className="team-members">
            <h3>Team Members</h3>
            {teamMembers.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="empty-message">No team members in this project</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="members-list">
                {teamMembers.map(member => (
                  <div key={member.id} className="member-card">
                    <div className="member-avatar">

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import axios from 'axios';

interface Project {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  template: string;
  created_at: string;
  last_updated: string;
  team_members: number;
  progress: number;
}

interface ProjectDashboardProps {
  workspaceId: string;
}

const ProjectDashboard: React.FC<ProjectDashboardProps> = ({ workspaceId }) => {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'name' | 'last_updated' | 'progress'>('last_updated');
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchProjects = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        
        // Use mock data
        // First try to get workspace-specific data
        const response = await axios.get(`/mock-api/api/workspace-${workspaceId}.json`);
        
        // Transform the project data to match the expected format
        const projectsData = response.data.projects.map((project: any) => ({
          id: project.id,
          name: project.name,
          description: project.description,
          template: project.status || 'Default',
          created_at: project.created_at,
          last_updated: project.updated_at,
          team_members: 3,
          progress: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) // Random progress value for demo
        }));
        
        setProjects(projectsData);
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load projects');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchProjects();
  }, [workspaceId]);

  const handleCreateProject = () => {
    navigate(`/workspaces/${workspaceId}/projects/new`);
  };

  const handleProjectClick = (projectId: string) => {
    navigate(`/workspaces/${workspaceId}/projects/${projectId}`);
  };

  const filteredProjects = projects.filter(project => 
    project.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    project.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const sortedProjects = [...filteredProjects].sort((a, b) => {
    if (sortBy === 'name') {
      return sortOrder === 'asc' 
        ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) 
        : b.name.localeCompare(a.name);
    } else if (sortBy === 'progress') {
      return sortOrder === 'asc' 
        ? a.progress - b.progress 
        : b.progress - a.progress;
    } else {
      return sortOrder === 'asc' 
        ? new Date(a.last_updated).getTime() - new Date(b.last_updated).getTime() 
        : new Date(b.last_updated).getTime() - new Date(a.last_updated).getTime();
    }
  });

  const handleSort = (column: 'name' | 'last_updated' | 'progress') => {
    if (sortBy === column) {
      setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortBy(column);
      setSortOrder('desc');
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading projects...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="project-dashboard">
      <div className="dashboard-header">
        <h2>Projects</h2>
        <div className="dashboard-actions">
          <div className="search-container">
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search projects..."
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              className="search-input"
            />
          </div>
          <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateProject}>
            Create New Project
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="error-message">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {!isLoading && sortedProjects.length === 0 && (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <h3>No projects yet</h3>
          <p>Create your first project to get started</p>
          <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateProject}>
            Create Project
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {sortedProjects.length > 0 && (
        <div className="projects-grid">
          <div className="projects-header">
            <div 
              className={`header-cell ${sortBy === 'name' ? 'active' : ''}`} 
              onClick={() => handleSort('name')}
            >
              Name {sortBy === 'name' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
            </div>
            <div className="header-cell">Template</div>
            <div className="header-cell">Team Size</div>
            <div 
              className={`header-cell ${sortBy === 'progress' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => handleSort('progress')}
            >
              Progress {sortBy === 'progress' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
            </div>
            <div 
              className={`header-cell ${sortBy === 'last_updated' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => handleSort('last_updated')}
            >
              Last Updated {sortBy === 'last_updated' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
            </div>
          </div>

          {sortedProjects.map((project) => (
            <div 
              key={project.id} 
              className="project-card" 
              onClick={() => handleProjectClick(project.id)}
            >
              <div className="project-cell project-name">{project.name}</div>
              <div className="project-cell project-template">{project.template}</div>
              <div className="project-cell project-team-size">{project.team_members}</div>
              <div className="project-cell project-progress">
                <div className="progress-bar">
                  <div 
                    className="progress-fill" 
                    style={{ width: `${project.progress}%` }}
                  ></div>
                </div>
                <span>{project.progress}%</span>
              </div>
              <div className="project-cell project-updated">
                {new Date(project.last_updated).toLocaleDateString()}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProjectDashboard;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { Line, Bar, Doughnut } from 'react-chartjs-2';
import {
  Chart as ChartJS,
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  PointElement,
  LineElement,
  BarElement,
  ArcElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
} from 'chart.js';

// Register Chart.js components
ChartJS.register(
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  PointElement,
  LineElement,
  BarElement,
  ArcElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend
);

interface CostData {
  date: string;
  amount: number;
  model: string;
}

interface TaskData {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: 'completed' | 'in_progress' | 'pending' | 'failed';
  created_at: string;
  completed_at: string | null;
  assigned_to: string[];
  priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
}

interface ResourceUsage {
  agent: string;
  tokens: number;
  requests: number;
  cost: number;
}

interface ProjectMetricsProps {
  projectId: string;
  timeRange: 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'all';
}

const ProjectMetrics: React.FC<ProjectMetricsProps> = ({ projectId, timeRange }) => {
  const [costData, setCostData] = useState<CostData[]>([]);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<TaskData[]>([]);
  const [resourceUsage, setResourceUsage] = useState<ResourceUsage[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [activeMetric, setActiveMetric] = useState<'cost' | 'tasks' | 'resources'>('cost');

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchMetricsData = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const [costResponse, tasksResponse, resourcesResponse] = await Promise.all([
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/metrics/cost?timeRange=${timeRange}`),
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/metrics/tasks?timeRange=${timeRange}`),
          axios.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/metrics/resources?timeRange=${timeRange}`)
        ]);
        
        setCostData(costResponse.data);
        setTasks(tasksResponse.data);
        setResourceUsage(resourcesResponse.data);
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load metrics data');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchMetricsData();
  }, [projectId, timeRange]);

  // Prepare cost chart data
  const costChartData = {
    labels: costData.map(item => {
      const date = new Date(item.date);
      return date.toLocaleDateString();
    }),
    datasets: [
      {
        label: 'Daily Cost',
        data: costData.map(item => item.amount),
        fill: false,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(75, 192, 192, 0.2)',
        borderColor: 'rgba(75, 192, 192, 1)',
        tension: 0.4,
      },
    ],
  };

  // Prepare task status chart data
  const taskStatusCounts = {
    completed: tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'completed').length,
    in_progress: tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'in_progress').length,
    pending: tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'pending').length,
    failed: tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'failed').length,
  };

  const taskStatusChartData = {
    labels: ['Completed', 'In Progress', 'Pending', 'Failed'],
    datasets: [
      {
        data: [
          taskStatusCounts.completed,
          taskStatusCounts.in_progress,
          taskStatusCounts.pending,
          taskStatusCounts.failed,
        ],
        backgroundColor: [
          'rgba(75, 192, 192, 0.6)',
          'rgba(54, 162, 235, 0.6)',
          'rgba(255, 206, 86, 0.6)',
          'rgba(255, 99, 132, 0.6)',
        ],
        borderColor: [
          'rgba(75, 192, 192, 1)',
          'rgba(54, 162, 235, 1)',
          'rgba(255, 206, 86, 1)',
          'rgba(255, 99, 132, 1)',
        ],
        borderWidth: 1,
      },
    ],
  };

  // Prepare resource usage chart data
  const resourceChartData = {
    labels: resourceUsage.map(item => item.agent),
    datasets: [
      {
        label: 'Resource Usage (Cost)',
        data: resourceUsage.map(item => item.cost),
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(153, 102, 255, 0.6)',
        borderColor: 'rgba(153, 102, 255, 1)',
        borderWidth: 1,
      },
    ],
  };

  // Calculate project completion percentage
  const completionPercentage = tasks.length > 0
    ? Math.round((taskStatusCounts.completed / tasks.length) * 100)
    : 0;

  // Calculate total cost
  const totalCost = costData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading project metrics...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="project-metrics">
      <div className="metrics-header">
        <h3>Project Metrics</h3>
        <div className="metrics-tabs">
          <button 
            className={`tab ${activeMetric === 'cost' ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveMetric('cost')}
          >
            Cost
          </button>
          <button 
            className={`tab ${activeMetric === 'tasks' ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveMetric('tasks')}
          >
            Tasks
          </button>
          <button 
            className={`tab ${activeMetric === 'resources' ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveMetric('resources')}
          >
            Resources
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error-message">{error}</div>}

      <div className="metrics-summary">
        <div className="metric-card">
          <div className="metric-title">Completion</div>
          <div className="metric-value">
            <div className="completion-bar">
              <div 
                className="completion-progress"
                style={{ width: `${completionPercentage}%` }}
              ></div>
            </div>
            <span>{completionPercentage}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="metric-card">
          <div className="metric-title">Total Cost</div>
          <div className="metric-value">${totalCost.toFixed(2)}</div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="metric-card">
          <div className="metric-title">Active Tasks</div>
          <div className="metric-value">{taskStatusCounts.in_progress}</div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="metric-card">
          <div className="metric-title">Completed Tasks</div>
          <div className="metric-value">{taskStatusCounts.completed}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="metrics-content">
        {activeMetric === 'cost' && (
          <div className="cost-metrics">
            <div className="chart-container">
              <h4>Cost Over Time</h4>
              {costData.length > 0 ? (
                <Line 
                  data={costChartData}
                  options={{
                    responsive: true,
                    scales: {
                      y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                        title: {
                          display: true,
                          text: 'Cost ($)'
                        }
                      },
                      x: {
                        title: {
                          display: true,
                          text: 'Date'
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }}
                />
              ) : (
                <p className="empty-message">No cost data available</p>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div className="cost-breakdown">
              <h4>Cost Breakdown</h4>

                    <th>Amount</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {costData.length > 0 ? (

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface Template {

  name: string;

  files_structure: any[];

interface ProjectTemplateSelectorProps {

const ProjectTemplateSelector: React.FC<ProjectTemplateSelectorProps> = ({

                  <span className="detail-label">Workflow:</span>
                  <span className="detail-value">{template.workflow}</span>

              <div className="selected-indicator">✓</div>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useScreenshot } from '../hooks/useScreenshot';

interface ScreenshotToolProps {
  selector?: string;
  onScreenshotTaken?: (path: string) => void;
}

/**
 * A component that provides UI controls for taking screenshots
 * and displays the latest screenshot path when taken
 */
export const ScreenshotTool: React.FC<ScreenshotToolProps> = ({
  selector,
  onScreenshotTaken
}) => {
  const [customSelector, setCustomSelector] = useState<string>(selector || '');
  const {
    captureFullScreen,
    captureElement,
    lastScreenshotPath,
    isCapturing,
    error
  } = useScreenshot({ includeMetadata: true });
  
  const handleCaptureFullScreen = async () => {
    const path = await captureFullScreen();
    if (path && onScreenshotTaken) {
      onScreenshotTaken(path);
    }
  };
  
  const handleCaptureElement = async () => {
    if (!customSelector) return;
    
    const path = await captureElement(customSelector);
    if (path && onScreenshotTaken) {
      onScreenshotTaken(path);
    }
  };
  
  return (
    <div className="screenshot-tool p-3 border rounded mb-4">
      <h5>UI Screenshot Tool</h5>
      <p className="text-muted small">Capture UI screenshots for agent awareness</p>
      
      <div className="d-flex gap-2 mb-3">
        <button 
          className="btn btn-primary" 
          onClick={handleCaptureFullScreen}
          disabled={isCapturing}
        >
          {isCapturing ? 'Capturing...' : 'Capture Full UI'}
        </button>
      </div>
      
      <div className="mb-3">
        <label htmlFor="element-selector" className="form-label">Element Selector</label>
        <div className="input-group">

            placeholder=".className or #elementId"

        </div>
      )}
    </div>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, Typography, List, ListItem, ListItemText, 
  Divider, Button, TextField, Box, Alert, CircularProgress, Chip, Stack } from '@mui/material';
import CodeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Code';
import SendIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Send';
import DeveloperModeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeveloperMode';
import TerminalIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Terminal';

type FileChange = {
  path: string;
  event: string;
  timestamp: string;
  content?: string;
};

type VSCodeClient = {
  workspace_name: string;
  current_branch: string;
  current_commit: string;
  connected: boolean;
  permission: boolean;
  created_at: number;
  last_seen: number;
  changes_count: number;
};

type ClientUpdate = {
  clientId: string;
  client: VSCodeClient;
  message: string;
  timestamp: string;
  type: 'change' | 'status' | 'response';
};

const WorkMode: React.FC = () => {
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<Record<string, VSCodeClient>>({});
  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [clientUpdates, setClientUpdates] = useState<ClientUpdate[]>([]);
  const [fileChanges, setFileChanges] = useState<FileChange[]>([]);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Poll for clients and updates
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchClients = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/vscode/clients');
        const data = await res.json();
        setClients(data.clients);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to fetch VS Code clients');
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchClients();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchClients, 10000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // Get detailed information for a client
  const selectClient = async (clientId: string) => {
    setSelectedClient(clientId);
    setLoading(true);
    
    try {
      // Fetch client details
      const detailRes = await fetch(`/api/vscode/client/${clientId}`);
      const detailData = await detailRes.json();
      
      // Fetch client file changes
      const changesRes = await fetch(`/api/vscode/file-changes/${clientId}`);
      const changesData = await changesRes.json();
      
      setFileChanges(changesData.changes || []);
      
      // Add client selection to updates
      addClientUpdate({
        clientId,
        client: clients[clientId],
        message: `Selected VS Code client: ${clients[clientId].workspace_name}`,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        type: 'status'
      });
      
      setLoading(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to fetch client details');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Scroll to bottom of updates on new additions
  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [clientUpdates]);

  // Add a new client update to the history
  const addClientUpdate = (update: ClientUpdate) => {
    setClientUpdates(prev => [...prev, update]);
  };

  // Send a message to the client
  const sendMessage = async () => {
    if (!selectedClient || !message.trim()) return;
    
    try {
      // Add message to updates first
      addClientUpdate({
        clientId: selectedClient,
        client: clients[selectedClient],
        message: `You: ${message}`,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        type: 'change'
      });
      
      // Send to backend
      const res = await fetch(`/api/vscode/send-message/${selectedClient}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message,
          actions: ['Acknowledge']
        })
      });
      
      if (res.ok) {
        // Clear message input
        setMessage('');
        
        // Simulate receiving a response from the agent system
        setTimeout(() => {
          addClientUpdate({
            clientId: selectedClient,
            client: clients[selectedClient],
            message: `Agent: I've processed your message and will analyze the changes.`,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            type: 'response'
          });
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to send message');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to send message to client');
    }
  };

  // Format timestamp for display
  const formatTime = (timestamp: string) => {
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString();
  };

  // Format file path to highlight filename
  const formatFilePath = (path: string) => {
    const parts = path.split('/');
    const fileName = parts.pop();
    
    return (
      <span>
        <span className="text-gray-500">{parts.join('/')}/</span>
        <span className="font-bold">{fileName}</span>
      </span>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Card sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <CardHeader 
        title={
          <Box display="flex" alignItems="center">
            <DeveloperModeIcon sx={{ mr: 1 }} />
            <Typography variant="h5">Work Mode</Typography>
          </Box>
        }
        subheader="Real-time collaboration with VS Code clients"
      />
      
      <Divider />
      
      <CardContent sx={{ flexGrow: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
        {loading && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', height: '200px' }}>
            <CircularProgress />
          </Box>
        )}
        
        {error && (
          <Alert severity="error" sx={{ m: 2 }}>{error}</Alert>
        )}
        
        {!loading && !error && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', height: '100%' }}>
            {/* Clients sidebar */}
            <Box sx={{ width: '250px', borderRight: '1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)', overflow: 'auto' }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ p: 2, fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
                Connected Clients
              </Typography>
              
              {Object.keys(clients).length === 0 ? (
                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ p: 2, color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                  No VS Code clients connected
                </Typography>
              ) : (
                <List dense>
                  {Object.entries(clients).map(([id, client]) => (
                    <ListItem 
                      key={id}
                      button 
                      selected={id === selectedClient}
                      onClick={() => selectClient(id)}
                      sx={{ 
                        borderLeft: id === selectedClient ? '3px solid #1976d2' : 'none',
                        backgroundColor: id === selectedClient ? 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.08)' : 'transparent'
                      }}
                    >
                      <ListItemText
                        primary={
                          <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" justifyContent="space-between">
                            <Typography variant="body2" noWrap sx={{ maxWidth: '150px' }}>
                              {client.workspace_name}
                            </Typography>
                            <Chip 
                              size="small" 
                              label={client.connected ? 'Online' : 'Offline'} 
                              color={client.connected ? 'success' : 'default'}
                              sx={{ height: '18px', '& .MuiChip-label': { px: 0.5, fontSize: '0.6rem' } }}
                            />
                          </Box>
                        }
                        secondary={
                          <Typography variant="caption" component="div">
                            Branch: {client.current_branch}
                          </Typography>
                        }
                      />
                    </ListItem>
                  ))}
                </List>
              )}
            </Box>
            
            {/* Main content area */}
            <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}>
              {!selectedClient ? (
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', height: '100%' }}>
                  <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary">
                    Select a VS Code client to view activity
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {/* Updates and messages */}
                  <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, overflowY: 'auto', p: 2 }}>
                    {clientUpdates.filter(update => update.clientId === selectedClient).length === 0 ? (
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ textAlign: 'center', color: 'text.secondary', my: 4 }}>
                        No activity yet with this client
                      </Typography>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        {clientUpdates
                          .filter(update => update.clientId === selectedClient)
                          .map((update, index) => (
                            <Box 
                              key={index} 
                              sx={{ 
                                mb: 2, 
                                p: 1.5, 
                                borderRadius: 1,
                                backgroundColor: update.type === 'response' 
                                  ? 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.08)' 
                                  : (update.type === 'status' ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)' : 'transparent')
                              }}
                            >
                              <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" mb={0.5}>
                                {update.type === 'response' && <CodeIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ mr: 0.5, color: 'primary.main' }} />}
                                {update.type === 'status' && <TerminalIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ mr: 0.5, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
                                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                                  {formatTime(update.timestamp)}
                                </Typography>
                              </Box>
                              <Typography variant="body2">
                                {update.message}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          ))}
                        
                        {fileChanges.length > 0 && (
                          <Box sx={{ mt: 2, p: 1.5, borderRadius: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)' }}>
                            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
                              Recent File Changes
                            </Typography>
                            
                            <List dense sx={{ backgroundColor: 'background.paper', borderRadius: 1 }}>
                              {fileChanges.slice(-5).map((change, index) => (
                                <React.Fragment key={index}>
                                  <ListItem>
                                    <ListItemText
                                      primary={formatFilePath(change.path)}
                                      secondary={
                                        <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between">
                                          <Typography variant="caption" component="span">
                                            {change.event === 'change' ? 'Modified' : 'Deleted'}
                                          </Typography>
                                          <Typography variant="caption" component="span">
                                            {formatTime(change.timestamp)}
                                          </Typography>
                                        </Box>
                                      }
                                    />
                                  </ListItem>
                                  {index < fileChanges.slice(-5).length - 1 && <Divider component="li" />}
                                </React.Fragment>
                              ))}
                            </List>
                          </Box>
                        )}
                        
                        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  
                  {/* Message input */}
                  <Box sx={{ p: 2, borderTop: '1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)' }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex' }}>
                      <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="Send a message to the team..."
                        value={message}
                        onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && sendMessage()}
                      />
                      <Button 
                        variant="contained" 
                        color="primary" 
                        sx={{ ml: 1 }}
                        endIcon={<SendIcon />}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useTagAccess } from '../../hooks/useTagAccess';
import { Tag } from '../../services/tags/types';
import * as tagService from '../../services/tags/tagService';

const TagManagement = () => {
  const { userRole, availableTags } = useTagAccess();
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Tag[]>([]);
  const [newTag, setNewTag] = useState<Omit<Tag, 'id'>>({
    name: '',
    color: '#3182ce', // Default blue color
    type: 'project'
  });
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editTag, setEditTag] = useState<Partial<Tag>>({});

  // Only admins should have access to this component
  const isAdmin = userRole === 'admin';

  useEffect(() => {
    // Load tags when the component mounts
    setTags(availableTags);
  }, [availableTags]);

  const handleCreateTag = () => {
    if (!isAdmin || !newTag.name.trim()) return;
    
    const createdTag = tagService.createTag(newTag);
    setTags([...tags, createdTag]);
    
    // Reset form
    setNewTag({
      name: '',
      color: '#3182ce',
      type: 'project'
    });
  };

  const handleEditClick = (tag: Tag) => {
    setIsEditing(tag.id);
    setEditTag({ ...tag });
  };

  const handleUpdateTag = () => {
    if (!isAdmin || !isEditing || !editTag.name?.trim()) return;
    
    const updatedTag = tagService.updateTag(isEditing, editTag);
    if (updatedTag) {
      setTags(tags.map(tag => tag.id === isEditing ? updatedTag : tag));
    }
    
    // Reset editing state
    setIsEditing(null);
    setEditTag({});
  };

  const handleDeleteTag = (tagId: string) => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    
    const deleted = tagService.deleteTag(tagId);
    if (deleted) {
      setTags(tags.filter(tag => tag.id !== tagId));
    }
  };

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return <div className="p-6">Only administrators can manage tags.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6">
      <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Tag Management</h2>
      
      {/* Create New Tag */}
      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm mb-6">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium mb-3">Create New Tag</h3>
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
              Name
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newTag.name}
              onChange={(e) => setNewTag({...newTag, name: e.target.value})}
              className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
              placeholder="Tag name"
            />
          </div>
          
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
              Color
            </label>
            <input
              type="color"
              value={newTag.color}
              onChange={(e) => setNewTag({...newTag, color: e.target.value})}
              className="w-full p-1 h-10 border rounded cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>
          
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
              Type
            </label>
            <select
              value={newTag.type}
              onChange={(e) => setNewTag({
                ...newTag, 
                type: e.target.value as 'workspace' | 'project' | 'user'
              })}
              className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
            >
              <option value="workspace">Workspace</option>
              <option value="project">Project</option>
              <option value="user">User</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex items-end">
            <button
              onClick={handleCreateTag}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700"
            >
              Create Tag
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Tag List */}
      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium mb-3">Existing Tags</h3>
        
        {tags.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-gray-500">No tags available.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full">
              <thead className="bg-gray-50">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-left">Name</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-left">Color</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-left">Type</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-left">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                {tags.map(tag => (
                  <tr key={tag.id}>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      {isEditing === tag.id ? (
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={editTag.name || ''}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditTag({...editTag, name: e.target.value})}
                          className="w-full p-1 border rounded"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex items-center">
                          <span
                            className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full mr-2"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: tag.color }}
                          ></span>
                          {tag.name}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      {isEditing === tag.id ? (
                        <input
                          type="color"
                          value={editTag.color || '#000000'}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditTag({...editTag, color: e.target.value})}
                          className="w-12 p-0 h-8 border rounded cursor-pointer"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex items-center">
                          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{tag.color}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      {isEditing === tag.id ? (
                        <select
                          value={editTag.type || 'project'}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditTag({
                            ...editTag, 
                            type: e.target.value as 'workspace' | 'project' | 'user'
                          })}
                          className="w-full p-1 border rounded"
                        >
                          <option value="workspace">Workspace</option>
                          <option value="project">Project</option>
                          <option value="user">User</option>
                        </select>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="capitalize">{tag.type}</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      {isEditing === tag.id ? (
                        <div className="flex space-x-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={handleUpdateTag}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-green-600 text-white text-sm rounded hover:bg-green-700"
                          >
                            Save
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => {
                              setIsEditing(null);
                              setEditTag({});
                            }}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-500 text-white text-sm rounded hover:bg-gray-600"
                          >
                            Cancel
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex space-x-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleEditClick(tag)}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-600 text-white text-sm rounded hover:bg-blue-700"
                          >
                            Edit
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteTag(tag.id)}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-red-600 text-white text-sm rounded hover:bg-red-700"
                          >
                            Delete
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TagManagement;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useTagAccess } from '../../hooks/useTagAccess';

interface WorkmodeHeaderProps {
  title: string;
  entityId: string;
  entityType: 'workspace' | 'project';
}

const WorkmodeHeader = ({ title, entityId, entityType }: WorkmodeHeaderProps) => {
  const { userRole, setUserRole } = useTagAccess();
  const [showRoleToggle, setShowRoleToggle] = useState(false);

  const toggleRole = () => {
    if (userRole === 'admin') {
      setUserRole('developer');
    } else {
      setUserRole('admin');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-4 bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{title}</h1>
        <p className="text-gray-500">
          {entityType === 'workspace' ? 'Workspace' : 'Project'} Mode
        </p>
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
        {/* Development mode role toggle */}
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <button 
            onClick={() => setShowRoleToggle(!showRoleToggle)}
            className="text-sm text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800"
          >
            Development Settings
          </button>
          
          {showRoleToggle && (
