--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\src\hooks\useAuth.tsx ---
import { useState, useEffect, createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { mockUser } from '../utils/mockData';
import { AUTH_ENABLED } from '../config';

interface User {
  id: string;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
}

interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  logout: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if user is already logged in
    const checkAuthStatus = async () => {
      // For demo purposes, automatically log in with mock user if auth is disabled
      if (!AUTH_ENABLED || window.localStorage.getItem('USE_MOCK_API') === 'true') {
        setUser(mockUser);
        setIsLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      
      const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
      
      if (token) {
        try {
          const response = await axios.get('/api/auth/me', {
            headers: {
              Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
            }
          });
          
          setUser(response.data);
        } catch (error) {
          localStorage.removeItem('token');
          setUser(null);
        }
      }
      
      setIsLoading(false);
    };
    
    checkAuthStatus();
  }, []);

  const login = async (email: string, password: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    // For demo purposes, bypass real authentication if using mock data
    if (!AUTH_ENABLED || window.localStorage.getItem('USE_MOCK_API') === 'true') {
      // Simple validation for demo
      if (email && password) {
        setUser(mockUser);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    
    try {
      const response = await axios.post('/api/auth/login', { email, password });
      const { token, user } = response.data;
      
      localStorage.setItem('token', token);
      setUser(user);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  };

  const logout = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    setUser(null);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        isAuthenticated: !!user,
        isLoading,
        login,
        logout
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = (): AuthContextType => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  
  return context;
}; 


--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\src\hooks\useScreenshot.ts ---
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { screenshotService } from '../services';

interface UseScreenshotOptions {
  includeMetadata?: boolean;
  quality?: number;
}

interface UseScreenshotResult {
  captureFullScreen: () => Promise<string | null>;
  captureElement: (selector: string) => Promise<string | null>;
  lastScreenshotPath: string | null;
  isCapturing: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
}

/**
 * Hook for capturing screenshots of the UI
 */
export function useScreenshot(options: UseScreenshotOptions = {}): UseScreenshotResult {
  const [lastScreenshotPath, setLastScreenshotPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCapturing, setIsCapturing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);

  const captureFullScreen = useCallback(async (): Promise<string | null> => {
    setIsCapturing(true);
    setError(null);
    
    try {
      const screenshotPath = await screenshotService.captureFullScreen({
        includeMetadata: options.includeMetadata,
        quality: options.quality
      });
      
      if (screenshotPath) {
        setLastScreenshotPath(screenshotPath);
      }
      
      return screenshotPath;
    } catch (err) {
      const error = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
      setError(error);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setIsCapturing(false);
    }
  }, [options.includeMetadata, options.quality]);
  
  const captureElement = useCallback(async (selector: string): Promise<string | null> => {
    setIsCapturing(true);
    setError(null);
    
    try {
      const screenshotPath = await screenshotService.captureElement(selector, {
        includeMetadata: options.includeMetadata,
        quality: options.quality,
        captureActiveElement: true
      });
      
      if (screenshotPath) {
        setLastScreenshotPath(screenshotPath);
      }
      
      return screenshotPath;
    } catch (err) {
      const error = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
      setError(error);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setIsCapturing(false);
    }
  }, [options.includeMetadata, options.quality]);
  
  return {
    captureFullScreen,
    captureElement,
    lastScreenshotPath,
    isCapturing,
    error
  };
}

import { useState, useEffect, useContext, createContext, ReactNode } from 'react';
import * as tagService from '../services/tags/tagService';
import { Tag, UserAccess, UserRole, TaggedEntity } from '../services/tags/types';
import { useAuth } from './useAuth';

interface TagAccessContextType {
  userRole: UserRole | null;
  setUserRole: (role: UserRole) => void;
  hasAccessToEntity: (entityId: string) => boolean;
  getAccessibleEntities: (entityType?: 'workspace' | 'project') => TaggedEntity[];
  availableTags: Tag[];
  assignedTags: string[];
  assignTagToEntity: (entityId: string, entityName: string, entityType: 'workspace' | 'project', tagIds: string[]) => void;
  assignTagsToUser: (tagIds: string[]) => void;
}

const TagAccessContext = createContext<TagAccessContextType | undefined>(undefined);

interface TagAccessProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
}

export const TagAccessProvider = ({ children }: TagAccessProviderProps) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [userAccess, setUserAccess] = useState<UserAccess | null>(null);
  const [availableTags, setAvailableTags] = useState<Tag[]>([]);
  const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = useState(false);

  // Initialize with mock data for development
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      // For development, create a mock user access if it doesn't exist
      const access = tagService.getUserAccess(user.id);
      if (!access) {
        const newAccess: UserAccess = {
          userId: user.id,
          username: user.username || 'User',
          role: 'developer', // default role
          tags: ['tag-1', 'tag-2'] // default tags
        };
        tagService.setUserAccess(newAccess);
        setUserAccess(newAccess);
      } else {
        setUserAccess(access);
      }

      // Load available tags
      setAvailableTags(tagService.getTags());
    }
  }, [user]);

  // Update admin status when userAccess changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsAdmin(userAccess?.role === 'admin');
  }, [userAccess]);

  const setUserRole = (role: UserRole) => {
    if (user && userAccess) {
      const updated = tagService.setUserRole(user.id, role);
      if (updated) {
        setUserAccess({ ...userAccess, role });
      }
    }
  };

  const hasAccessToEntity = (entityId: string): boolean => {
    if (!user) return false;
    return tagService.userHasAccessToEntity(user.id, entityId);
  };

  const getAccessibleEntities = (entityType?: 'workspace' | 'project'): TaggedEntity[] => {
    if (!user) return [];
    
    const allEntities = tagService.getTaggedEntities();
    
    // Filter by entity type if provided
    const typeFilteredEntities = entityType
      ? allEntities.filter(entity => entity.type === entityType)
      : allEntities;
    
    // Admin can see all entities
    if (isAdmin) return typeFilteredEntities;
    
    // Regular users can only see entities with tags they have access to
    return typeFilteredEntities.filter(entity => 
      hasAccessToEntity(entity.id)
    );
  };

  const assignTagToEntity = (
    entityId: string,
    entityName: string,
    entityType: 'workspace' | 'project',
    tagIds: string[]
  ) => {
    if (!isAdmin) return; // Only admins can assign tags
    
    tagService.tagEntity(entityId, entityName, entityType, tagIds);
    setAvailableTags([...tagService.getTags()]); // Refresh available tags
  };

  const assignTagsToUser = (tagIds: string[]) => {
    if (!user || !userAccess || !isAdmin) return;
    
    const updatedAccess: UserAccess = {
      ...userAccess,
      tags: tagIds
    };
    
    tagService.setUserAccess(updatedAccess);
    setUserAccess(updatedAccess);
  };

  const value = {
    userRole: userAccess?.role || null,
    setUserRole,
    hasAccessToEntity,
    getAccessibleEntities,
    availableTags,
    assignedTags: userAccess?.tags || [],
    assignTagToEntity,
    assignTagsToUser
  };

  return (
    <TagAccessContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </TagAccessContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTagAccess = (): TagAccessContextType => {
  const context = useContext(TagAccessContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useTagAccess must be used within a TagAccessProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

  const [isUpdating, setIsUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<'day' | 'week' | 'month'>('week');

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchData = async () => {
      try {
        const [teamsResponse, usageResponse] = await Promise.all([
          axios.get('/api/teams'),
          axios.get(`/api/cost-domain/usage?range=${timeRange}`)
        ]);
        
        setTeams(teamsResponse.data);
        setTokenUsage(usageResponse.data);
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load cost management data');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchData();
  }, [timeRange]);

  const totalBudget = teams.reduce((sum, team) => sum + team.budget_limit, 0);
  const totalUsed = teams.reduce((sum, team) => sum + team.budget_used, 0);
  const percentUsed = totalBudget > 0 ? (totalUsed / totalBudget) * 100 : 0;

  const handleTeamSelect = (teamId: string) => {
    setSelectedTeam(teamId);
    const team = teams.find(t => t.id === teamId);
    
    if (team) {
      setEditBudget(team.budget_limit);
      setEditModelTier(team.model_tier);
    }
  };

  const handleBudgetChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setEditBudget(Number(e.target.value));
  };

  const handleModelTierChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    setEditModelTier(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleUpdateSettings = async () => {
    if (!selectedTeam || editBudget === null || !editModelTier) return;
    
    setIsUpdating(true);
    
    try {
      await axios.patch(`/api/teams/${selectedTeam}/cost-settings`, {
        budget_limit: editBudget,
        model_tier: editModelTier
      });
      
      // Update the local state
      setTeams(teams.map(team => 
        team.id === selectedTeam 
          ? { ...team, budget_limit: editBudget, model_tier: editModelTier }
          : team

      setIsUpdating(false);

          >
            Day
          </button>
          <button 
            className={`btn ${timeRange === 'week' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}`}
            onClick={() => setTimeRange('week')}
          >
            Week

    direction: 'desc'
  });
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('dashboard');

  // Refs
  const wsConnected = useRef(false);

  // Add navigate hook at the beginning of the Dashboard function
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Effects
  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.classList.toggle('dark-mode', darkMode);
    localStorage.setItem('darkMode', darkMode.toString());
  }, [darkMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchDashboardData = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        
        // Fetch all required data
        const [teamsResponse, tasksResponse, workspacesResponse, interactionsResponse, timelineResponse] = await Promise.all([
          axios.get('/api/teams'),
          axios.get('/api/tasks/recent'),
          axios.get('/api/workspaces'),
          axios.get('/api/agent-interactions/recent'),
          axios.get('/api/timeline/recent')
        ]);
        
        setTeams(teamsResponse.data);
        setTasks(tasksResponse.data);
        setWorkspaces(workspacesResponse.data);
        setAgentInteractions(interactionsResponse.data);
        setTimelineEvents(timelineResponse.data);
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load dashboard data');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchDashboardData();
    
    // Setup WebSocket
    if (!wsConnected.current) {
      websocketService.connect();
      
      websocketService.onConnect(() => {
        wsConnected.current = true;
        console.log('WebSocket connected');
      });
      
      // Handle real-time updates
      websocketService.onMessage('team_updated', (data) => {
        setTeams(prev => prev.map(team => 
          team.id === data.id ? { ...team, ...data } : team
        ));
      });
      
      websocketService.onMessage('task_updated', (data) => {
        setTasks(prev => prev.map(task => 
          task.id === data.id ? { ...task, ...data } : task
        ));
      });
      
      websocketService.onMessage('workspace_updated', (data) => {
        setWorkspaces(prev => prev.map(workspace => 
          workspace.id === data.id ? { ...workspace, ...data } : workspace
        ));
      });
      
      websocketService.onMessage('new_interaction', (data) => {
        setAgentInteractions(prev => [data, ...prev].slice(0, 50));
      });
      
      websocketService.onMessage('new_timeline_event', (data) => {
        setTimelineEvents(prev => [data, ...prev].slice(0, 50));
      });
      
      websocketService.onMessage('budget_alert', (data) => {
        // Add budget alert to timeline
        const newEvent: TimelineEvent = {
          id: `budget-alert-${Date.now()}`,
          type: 'budget_alert',
          entityId: data.teamId,
          title: 'Budget Alert',
          description: `Team ${data.teamName} has reached ${data.percentage}% of budget limit`,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        
        setTimelineEvents(prev => [newEvent, ...prev].slice(0, 50));
      });
    }
    
    return () => {
      // No need to disconnect on component unmount to maintain real-time updates
    };
  }, []);

  // Filter tasks based on current filter options
  const filteredTasks = tasks.filter(task => {
    // Filter by status
    if (filterOptions.status !== 'all' && task.status !== filterOptions.status) {
      return false;
    }
    
    // Filter by team
    if (filterOptions.team !== 'all' && task.teamId !== filterOptions.team) {
      return false;
    }
    
    // Filter by date range
    const taskDate = new Date(task.updated_at).getTime();
    const now = new Date().getTime();
    const dayInMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    
    switch (filterOptions.dateRange) {
      case '1d':
        return (now - taskDate) <= dayInMs;
      case '7d':
        return (now - taskDate) <= 7 * dayInMs;
      case '30d':
        return (now - taskDate) <= 30 * dayInMs;
      default:
        return true;
    }
  });
  
  // Sort tasks based on current sort options
  const sortedTasks = [...filteredTasks].sort((a, b) => {
    let aValue = a[sortOptions.field as keyof Task];
    let bValue = b[sortOptions.field as keyof Task];
    
    if (typeof aValue === 'string' && typeof bValue === 'string') {
      if (sortOptions.direction === 'asc') {
        return aValue.localeCompare(bValue as string);
      } else {
        return bValue.localeCompare(aValue as string);
      }
    } else if (typeof aValue === 'number' && typeof bValue === 'number') {
      if (sortOptions.direction === 'asc') {
        return aValue - bValue;
      } else {
        return bValue - aValue;
      }
    }
    
    return 0;
  });

  // Handler for theme toggle
  const toggleDarkMode = () => {
    setDarkMode(prev => !prev);
  };

  // Loading and error states
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading dashboard...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="error-container">
        <h2>Error</h2>
        <p>{error}</p>
        <button 
          className="btn btn-primary" 
          onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
        >
          Retry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Calculate dashboard metrics
  const totalBudget = teams.reduce((sum, team) => sum + (team.config?.budgetLimit || 0), 0);
  const usedBudget = teams.reduce((sum, team) => sum + (team.config?.budgetUsed || 0), 0);
  const budgetPercentage = totalBudget > 0 ? Math.round((usedBudget / totalBudget) * 100) : 0;
  const activeTasks = tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'in_progress').length;
  const completedTasks = tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'completed').length;
  const pendingFeedback = tasks.filter(task => task.feedback?.status === 'pending').length;

  // Dashboard render
  return (
    <div className={`dashboard-container ${darkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}`}>
      <header className="dashboard-header">
        <h1>Hive Mind Dashboard</h1>
        <button 
          className="dark-mode-toggle" 
          onClick={toggleDarkMode}
          aria-label={darkMode ? "Switch to light mode" : "Switch to dark mode"}
        >
          {darkMode ? "☀️" : "🌙"}
        </button>
      </header>

      <nav className="dashboard-nav">
        <ul>
          <li className={activeTab === 'dashboard' ? 'active' : ''}>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('dashboard')}>Dashboard</button>
          </li>
          <li className={activeTab === 'teams' ? 'active' : ''}>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('teams')}>Teams</button>
          </li>
          <li className={activeTab === 'tasks' ? 'active' : ''}>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('tasks')}>Tasks</button>
          </li>
          <li className={activeTab === 'workspaces' ? 'active' : ''}>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('workspaces')}>Workspaces</button>
          </li>
          <li className={activeTab === 'workmode' ? 'active' : ''}>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('workmode')}>Work Mode</button>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </nav>

      {error && (
        <div className="dashboard-error">
          <p>{error}</p>
          <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="dashboard-loading">
          <p>Loading dashboard data...</p>
          <div className="spinner"></div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <main className="dashboard-content">
          {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
            <div className="dashboard-overview">
              <section className="dashboard-stats">
                <div className="stat-card">
                  <h3>Active Teams</h3>
                  <p className="stat-value">{teams.filter(t => t.status === 'active').length}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="stat-card">
                  <h3>Active Tasks</h3>
                  <p className="stat-value">{tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'in_progress').length}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="stat-card">
                  <h3>Workspaces</h3>
                  <p className="stat-value">{workspaces.length}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="stat-card">
                  <h3>Total Agents</h3>
                  <p className="stat-value">{teams.reduce((sum, team) => sum + team.agents, 0)}</p>
                </div>
              </section>

              <div className="dashboard-grid">
                <div className="dashboard-column">
                  <section className="dashboard-recent-tasks">
                    <div className="section-header">
                      <h2>Recent Tasks</h2>
                      <Link to="/tasks" className="view-all">View All</Link>
                    </div>
                    {renderTasks()}
                  </section>
                  
                  <section className="dashboard-workspaces">
                    <div className="section-header">
                      <h2>Workspaces</h2>
                      <Link to="/workspaces" className="view-all">View All</Link>
                    </div>
                    {renderWorkspaces()}
                  </section>
                </div>
                
                <div className="dashboard-column">
                  <section className="dashboard-teams">
                    <div className="section-header">
                      <h2>Teams</h2>
                      <Link to="/teams" className="view-all">View All</Link>
                    </div>
                    {renderTeams()}
                  </section>
                  
                  <section className="dashboard-timeline">
                    <div className="section-header">
                      <h2>Activity Timeline</h2>
                    </div>
                    {renderTimeline()}
                  </section>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'teams' && (
            <div className="teams-section full-width">
              <div className="section-header">
                <h2>Teams</h2>
                <Link to="/team/create" className="create-btn">Create Team</Link>
              </div>
              {renderTeams(true)}
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'tasks' && (
            <div className="tasks-section full-width">
              <div className="section-header">
                <h2>Tasks</h2>
                {renderFilterControls()}
              </div>
              {renderTasks(true)}
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'workspaces' && (
            <div className="workspaces-section full-width">
              <div className="section-header">
                <h2>Workspaces</h2>
                <Link to="/workspaces/create" className="create-btn">Create Workspace</Link>
              </div>
              {renderWorkspaces(true)}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {activeTab === 'workmode' && (
            <div className="workmode-section full-width">
              <WorkMode />
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  // Render workspaces list
  function renderWorkspaces(fullWidth?: boolean) {
    if (workspaces.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <p>No workspaces yet</p>
          <Link to="/workspaces" className="btn btn-primary">
            Manage Workspaces
          </Link>
        </div>
      );
    }

    // Show just the top 3 most recently updated workspaces
    const recentWorkspaces = [...workspaces]
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updated_at).getTime() - new Date(a.updated_at).getTime())
      .slice(0, 3);

    return (
      <div className={`workspaces-list ${fullWidth ? 'full-width' : ''}`}>
        {recentWorkspaces.map(workspace => (

          <option value="in_progress">In Progress</option>
          <option value="completed">Completed</option>

          ))}
        </select>
        
        <select 
          value={filterOptions.dateRange} 
          onChange={(e) => setFilterOptions({...filterOptions, dateRange: e.target.value})}
        >
          <option value="all">All Time</option>
          <option value="1d">Last 24 Hours</option>
          <option value="7d">Last 7 Days</option>
          <option value="30d">Last 30 Days</option>
        </select>
      </>

  // Render tasks list
  function renderTasks(fullWidth?: boolean) {
    if (sortedTasks.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <p>No tasks match your current filters.</p>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className={`tasks-table-container ${fullWidth ? 'full-width' : ''}`}>

          <thead>

              <th>Team</th>
              <th>Status</th>
              <th>Progress</th>
              <th>Budget</th>
              <th>Feedback</th>
              <th>Last Updated</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {sortedTasks.map(task => (
              <tr key={task.id} className="task-row" onClick={() => window.location.href = `/workspace/${task.teamId}?task=${task.id}`}>

                <td>{task.team}</td>
                <td>
                  <span className={`status-badge ${task.status}`}>
                    {task.status.replace('_', ' ')}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div className="progress-container">
                    <div className="progress-bar">
                      <div 
                        className="progress-fill" 
                        style={{ width: `${task.progress}%` }}

                    </div>
                    <span className="progress-text">{task.progress}%</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>${task.budget.toFixed(2)}</td>
                <td>
                  {task.feedback ? (
                    <span className={`feedback-status ${task.feedback.status}`}>
                      {task.feedback.status}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="feedback-status none">None</span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td>{new Date(task.updated_at).toLocaleString()}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Render timeline
  function renderTimeline() {
    if (timelineEvents.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <p>No activities to display.</p>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="timeline">
        {timelineEvents.map((event) => (
          <div key={event.id} className={`timeline-event ${event.type}`}>
            <div className="timeline-marker"></div>
            <div className="timeline-content">
              <div className="timeline-header">
                <h4>{event.title}</h4>
                <span className="timeline-time">
                  {new Date(event.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p>{event.description}</p>
              {event.type === 'task_updated' && (
                <Link to={`/workspace/${event.entityId.split('-')[0]}?task=${event.entityId}`}>
                  View Task
                </Link>
              )}
              {event.type === 'budget_alert' && (
                <Link to="/cost-management">
                  Manage Budget
                </Link>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
};

export default Dashboard;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';

interface LocationState {
  from?: {
    pathname: string;
  };
}

const Login: React.FC = () => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { login } = useAuth();
  
  const locationState = location.state as LocationState;
  const from = locationState?.from?.pathname || '/';

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setIsLoading(true);
    
    try {
      const success = await login(email, password);
      
      if (success) {
        navigate(from, { replace: true });
      } else {
        setError('Invalid email or password');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('An error occurred during login');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login-container">
      <div className="login-card">
        <div className="login-header">
          <div className="logo-container">
            <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M16 2L29.9 26H2.1L16 2Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
              <path d="M16 6L25.9 24H6.1L16 6Z" fill="#FFA500"/>
              <path d="M16 10L21.9 22H10.1L16 10Z" fill="#FF8C00"/>
              <circle cx="16" cy="18" r="3" fill="#000"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h1 className="app-title">Hive Mind</h1>
          <p className="app-description">AI Agent Teams Platform</p>
        </div>
        
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="login-form">
          {error && <div className="error-message">{error}</div>}
          
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
            <input
              type="email"
              id="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              className="form-control"
            />
          </div>
          
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              id="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              className="form-control"
            />
          </div>
          
          <button 
            type="submit" 
            className="btn btn-primary login-btn"
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? 'Logging in...' : 'Log In'}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Login;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import WorkmodeHeader from '../components/workmode/WorkmodeHeader';
import { useTagAccess } from '../hooks/useTagAccess';
import { TaggedEntity } from '../services/tags/types';

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: 'todo' | 'in-progress' | 'review' | 'done';
  assignee?: string;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
}

const ProjectWorkmode = () => {
  const { projectId } = useParams<{ projectId: string }>();
  const { getAccessibleEntities, hasAccessToEntity } = useTagAccess();
  const [project, setProject] = useState<TaggedEntity | null>(null);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!projectId) return;

    // Find the project from tagged entities
    const projects = getAccessibleEntities('project');
    const currentProject = projects.find(p => p.id === projectId) || null;
    setProject(currentProject);

    // TODO: Replace with actual API call to fetch tasks
    // For now, we'll use mock data
    const mockTasks: Task[] = [
      { id: 'task-1', title: 'Implement login page', status: 'todo', priority: 'high' },
      { id: 'task-2', title: 'Fix navigation bug', status: 'in-progress', assignee: 'User 1', priority: 'medium' },
      { id: 'task-3', title: 'Add unit tests', status: 'todo', priority: 'medium' },
      { id: 'task-4', title: 'Update documentation', status: 'review', assignee: 'User 2', priority: 'low' },
      { id: 'task-5', title: 'Performance optimization', status: 'done', assignee: 'User 3', priority: 'high' },
    ];

    setTasks(mockTasks);
    setLoading(false);
  }, [projectId, getAccessibleEntities, hasAccessToEntity]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="p-8">Loading project data...</div>;
  }

  if (!project) {
    return <div className="p-8">Project not found or you do not have access to view it.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      <WorkmodeHeader 
        title={project.name} 
        entityId={projectId || ''} 
        entityType="project" 
      />
      
      <div className="p-6">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Tasks in this Project</h2>
        
        {tasks.length === 0 ? (
          <p>No tasks found in this project.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full bg-white">
              <thead className="bg-gray-100">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-2 px-4 text-left">Title</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-4 text-left">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-4 text-left">Assignee</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-4 text-left">Priority</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                {tasks.map(task => (
                  <tr key={task.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                    <td className="py-2 px-4">{task.title}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-4">
                      <span className={`inline-block px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full ${
                        task.status === 'todo' ? 'bg-gray-200' :
                        task.status === 'in-progress' ? 'bg-blue-200' :
                        task.status === 'review' ? 'bg-yellow-200' :
                        'bg-green-200'
                      }`}>
                        {task.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-4">{task.assignee || 'Unassigned'}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-4">
                      <span className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full mr-2 ${
                        task.priority === 'high' ? 'bg-red-500' :
                        task.priority === 'medium' ? 'bg-yellow-500' :
                        'bg-green-500'
                      }`}></span>
                      {task.priority}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProjectWorkmode;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import axios from 'axios';

interface UserSettings {
  notifications_enabled: boolean;
  default_model_tier: string;
  theme: 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
  auto_save: boolean;
  token_warning_threshold: number;
}

interface SystemInfo {
  version: string;
  api_status: 'operational' | 'degraded' | 'maintenance';
  llm_services: {
    name: string;
    status: 'operational' | 'degraded' | 'down';
  }[];
}

const Settings: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<UserSettings>({
    notifications_enabled: true,
    default_model_tier: 'standard',
    theme: 'system',
    auto_save: true,
    token_warning_threshold: 80
  });
  const [systemInfo, setSystemInfo] = useState<SystemInfo | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [saveMessage, setSaveMessage] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchData = async () => {
      try {
        const [settingsResponse, systemResponse] = await Promise.all([
          axios.get('/api/user/settings'),
          axios.get('/api/system/info')
        ]);
        
        setSettings(settingsResponse.data);
        setSystemInfo(systemResponse.data);
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load settings');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchData();
  }, []);

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const { name, value, type } = e.target as HTMLInputElement;
    
    setSettings(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: type === 'checkbox' ? (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked : value
    }));
  };

  const handleSaveSettings = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    setSaveMessage('');
    setError('');
    
    try {
      await axios.put('/api/user/settings', settings);
      setSaveMessage('Settings saved successfully');
      
      // Clear success message after 3 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        setSaveMessage('');
      }, 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to save settings');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading settings...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="settings-container">
      <div className="settings-header">
        <h1>Settings</h1>
      </div>
      
      {error && (
        <div className="error-message">{error}</div>
      )}
      
      {saveMessage && (
        <div className="success-message">{saveMessage}</div>
      )}

      <div className="settings-layout">
        <div className="settings-section">
          <h2>User Settings</h2>
          
          <div className="settings-card">
            <h3>Account Information</h3>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Username</label>
              <div className="static-field">{user?.username}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Email</label>
              <div className="static-field">{user?.email}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label>Role</label>
              <div className="static-field">{user?.role}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="settings-card">
            <h3>Preferences</h3>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label htmlFor="theme">Theme</label>
              <select
                id="theme"
                name="theme"
                value={settings.theme}
                onChange={handleInputChange}
                className="form-control"
              >
                <option value="light">Light</option>
                <option value="dark">Dark</option>
                <option value="system">System Default</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            
            <div className="form-group">
              <label htmlFor="default_model_tier">Default Model Tier</label>
              <select
                id="default_model_tier"
                name="default_model_tier"
                value={settings.default_model_tier}
                onChange={handleInputChange}
                className="form-control"
              >
                <option value="prod_mgmt">Economy (GPT-3.5-Turbo)</option>
                <option value="standard">Standard (GPT-4o)</option>
                <option value="premium">Premium (Claude-3-Opus)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            
            <div className="form-group checkbox-group">
              <label htmlFor="auto_save">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  id="auto_save"
                  name="auto_save"
                  checked={settings.auto_save}
                  onChange={handleInputChange}
                />
                <span>Enable auto-save in workspace</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="settings-card">
            <h3>Notifications</h3>
            <div className="form-group checkbox-group">
              <label htmlFor="notifications_enabled">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  id="notifications_enabled"
                  name="notifications_enabled"
                  checked={settings.notifications_enabled}
                  onChange={handleInputChange}
                />
                <span>Enable notifications</span>
              </label>
            </div>
            
            <div className="form-group">
              <label htmlFor="token_warning_threshold">Token Warning Threshold (%)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                id="token_warning_threshold"
                name="token_warning_threshold"
                value={settings.token_warning_threshold}
                onChange={handleInputChange}
                min="10"
                max="100"
                className="form-control"
              />
              <span className="form-hint">Show warning when token usage reaches this percentage of the budget</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="form-actions">
            <button
              className="btn btn-primary"
              onClick={handleSaveSettings}
              disabled={isSaving}
            >
              {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Settings'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="settings-section">
          <h2>System Information</h2>
          
          <div className="settings-card">
            <h3>About</h3>
            <div className="info-row">
              <span className="info-label">Version</span>
              <span className="info-value">{systemInfo?.version || 'Unknown'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="info-row">
              <span className="info-label">API Status</span>
              <span className={`status-badge ${systemInfo?.api_status || 'unknown'}`}>
                {systemInfo?.api_status || 'Unknown'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="settings-card">
            <h3>LLM Services</h3>
            {systemInfo?.llm_services.map((service, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="info-row">
                <span className="info-label">{service.name}</span>
                <span className={`status-badge ${service.status}`}>
                  {service.status}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          
          <div className="settings-card">
            <h3>Resources</h3>
            <ul className="resource-links">
              <li>
                <a href="/docs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Documentation</a>

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

  name: string;

  maxTokens: number;
  customInstructions: string;

interface TeamTemplate {

interface FeedbackConfig {

  autoRequest: true,
  frequency: 'milestone',
  reviewSteps: true,
  incorporationStrategy: 'review'

const getTooltip = (key: string): string => {
  const tooltips: { [key: string]: string } = {
    autoRequest: 'Automatically request feedback at specified intervals',
    frequency: 'How often the system should request feedback',
    reviewSteps: 'Allow reviewing individual steps before proceeding',
    incorporationStrategy: 'How feedback should be incorporated into the workflow',
    budgetAllocation: 'Distribute budget across different agents',
    maxTokens: 'Maximum tokens an agent can use per request',
    customInstructions: 'Special instructions for this agent'
  };
  
  return tooltips[key] || 'No additional information available';
};

const TeamCreation: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [teamName, setTeamName] = useState('');
  const [teamDescription, setTeamDescription] = useState('');
  const [selectedRoles, setSelectedRoles] = useState<string[]>(
    availableRoles.filter(role => role.isRequired).map(role => role.id)
  );
  const [agentConfigs, setAgentConfigs] = useState<AgentConfig[]>([]);
  const [totalBudget, setTotalBudget] = useState<number>(100);
  const [modelTier, setModelTier] = useState<string>('standard');
  const [workspaceSettings, setWorkspaceSettings] = useState({
    gitIntegration: false,
    autoCommit: false,
    documentationLevel: 'standard',
    securityChecks: true
  });
  const [feedbackConfig, setFeedbackConfig] = useState<FeedbackConfig>(defaultFeedbackConfig);
  const [activeTemplate, setActiveTemplate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showTooltip, setShowTooltip] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isConfigOpen, setIsConfigOpen] = useState<{ [key: string]: boolean }>({});
  const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showPreview, setShowPreview] = useState(false);
  const [savedConfigs, setSavedConfigs] = useState<{ id: string; name: string }[]>([]);
  
  // Initialize agent configs when roles change
  useEffect(() => {
    const newConfigs = selectedRoles
      .filter(roleId => !agentConfigs.some(config => config.roleId === roleId))
      .map(roleId => {
        const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
        return {
          id: `${roleId}-${Date.now()}`,
          roleId,
          name: role?.name || '',
          model: modelTier,
          budget: Math.floor(totalBudget / selectedRoles.length),
          maxTokens: 4000,
          customInstructions: ''
        };
      });
    
    setAgentConfigs(prev => [...prev.filter(config => selectedRoles.includes(config.roleId)), ...newConfigs]);
  }, [selectedRoles, modelTier]);

  // Apply template
  const applyTemplate = (templateId: string) => {
    const template = teamTemplates.find(t => t.id === templateId);
    if (!template) return;
    
    setSelectedRoles(template.roles);
    setFeedbackConfig(template.feedbackConfig);
    setActiveTemplate(templateId);
    
    // Reset configs to match template
    const newConfigs = template.roles.map(roleId => {
      const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
      return {
        id: `${roleId}-${Date.now()}`,
        roleId,
        name: role?.name || '',
        model: modelTier,
        budget: template.budgetAllocation[roleId] || Math.floor(totalBudget / template.roles.length),
        maxTokens: 4000,
        customInstructions: ''
      };
    });
    
    setAgentConfigs(newConfigs);
  };

  // Handle drag and drop
  const onDragEnd = (result: any) => {
    if (!result.destination) return;
    
    const items = Array.from(selectedRoles);
    const [reorderedItem] = items.splice(result.source.index, 1);
    items.splice(result.destination.index, 0, reorderedItem);
    
    setSelectedRoles(items);
  };

  // Toggle role selection
  const handleRoleToggle = (roleId: string) => {
    const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
    if (role?.isRequired) return;

    setSelectedRoles(prev => 
      prev.includes(roleId)
        ? prev.filter(id => id !== roleId)
        : [...prev, roleId]
    );
    
    // Clear active template if roles don't match anymore
    setActiveTemplate(null);
  };

  // Update agent configuration
  const updateAgentConfig = (id: string, field: keyof AgentConfig, value: any) => {
    setAgentConfigs(prev => prev.map(config => 
      config.id === id ? { ...config, [field]: value } : config
    ));
  };

  // Save current config
  const saveCurrentConfig = () => {
    const configId = `config-${Date.now()}`;
    const configToSave = {
      id: configId,
      name: teamName || `Configuration ${savedConfigs.length + 1}`,
      selectedRoles,
      agentConfigs,
      feedbackConfig,
      workspaceSettings
    };
    
    localStorage.setItem(configId, JSON.stringify(configToSave));
    setSavedConfigs(prev => [...prev, { id: configId, name: configToSave.name }]);
  };

  // Load saved config
  const loadSavedConfig = (configId: string) => {
    const savedConfig = localStorage.getItem(configId);
    if (!savedConfig) return;
    
    const config = JSON.parse(savedConfig);
    setSelectedRoles(config.selectedRoles);
    setAgentConfigs(config.agentConfigs);
    setFeedbackConfig(config.feedbackConfig);
    setWorkspaceSettings(config.workspaceSettings);
    setActiveTemplate(null);
  };

  // Validate team configuration
  const validateTeam = (): string[] => {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    
    if (teamName.trim() === '') {
      errors.push('Team name is required');
    }
    
    if (selectedRoles.length < 2) {
      errors.push('At least two roles are required (including required roles)');
    }
    
    // Check for budget allocation
    const totalAllocated = agentConfigs.reduce((sum, config) => sum + config.budget, 0);
    if (totalAllocated > totalBudget) {
      errors.push(`Budget allocation exceeds total budget (${totalAllocated} > ${totalBudget})`);
    }
    
    return errors;
  };

  // Submit form
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const errors = validateTeam();
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      setValidationErrors(errors);
      return;
    }
    
    setValidationErrors([]);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const response = await axios.post('/api/teams', {
        name: teamName,
        description: teamDescription,
        roles: selectedRoles,
        agentConfigs,
        totalBudget,
        feedbackConfig,
        workspaceSettings
      });

      navigate(`/workspace/${response.data.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setValidationErrors(['Failed to create team. Please try again.']);
      console.error(err);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Toggle agent configuration panel
  const toggleConfigPanel = (roleId: string) => {
    setIsConfigOpen(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [roleId]: !prev[roleId]
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="team-creation-container">
      <div className="creation-header">
        <h1>Create a New Team</h1>
        <p>Configure your AI agent team with specialized roles</p>
      </div>

      {validationErrors.length > 0 && (
        <div className="validation-errors">
          <h3>Please fix the following issues:</h3>
          <ul>
            {validationErrors.map((error, index) => (
              <li key={index}>{error}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="team-templates">
        <h2>Team Templates</h2>
        <p className="section-description">Start with a pre-configured team setup</p>
        
        <div className="templates-grid">
          {teamTemplates.map(template => (
            <div 
              key={template.id}
              className={`template-card ${activeTemplate === template.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => applyTemplate(template.id)}
            >
              <h3>{template.name}</h3>
              <p>{template.description}</p>
              <div className="template-roles">
                {template.roles.map(roleId => {
                  const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.id === roleId);
                  return (
                    <span key={roleId} className="role-tag">
                      {role?.name}
                    </span>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="creation-form">
        <div className="form-section">
          <h2>Team Details</h2>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="teamName">Team Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="teamName"
              value={teamName}
              onChange={e => setTeamName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter a name for your team"
              className="form-control"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="teamDescription">Team Description</label>
            <textarea
              id="teamDescription"
              value={teamDescription}
              onChange={e => setTeamDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Describe what this team will be working on"
              className="form-control"
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>
          
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="totalBudget">Total Budget (USD)</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              id="totalBudget"
              min="10"
              max="1000"
              value={totalBudget}
              onChange={e => setTotalBudget(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="form-control"
            />
            <span className="form-hint">Maximum budget allowed for this team's operations</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="form-section">
          <h2>Agent Roles</h2>
          <p className="section-description">
            Select and arrange agent roles for your team 
            <span 
              className="tooltip-trigger"
              onMouseEnter={() => setShowTooltip('roles')}
              onMouseLeave={() => setShowTooltip(null)}
            >
              ℹ️
            </span>
          </p>
          {showTooltip === 'roles' && (
            <div className="tooltip">
              Drag and drop roles to change their priority. Click on a role to select/deselect it.
            </div>
          )}
          
          <div className="roles-grid">
            {availableRoles.map(role => (
              <div 
                key={role.id}
                className={`role-card ${selectedRoles.includes(role.id) ? 'selected' : ''} ${role.isRequired ? 'required' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => handleRoleToggle(role.id)}
              >
                <div className="role-header">
                  <h3>{role.name}</h3>
                  {role.isRequired && <span className="required-badge">Required</span>}
                </div>
                <p className="role-description">{role.description}</p>
                <div className="role-capabilities">
                  <h4>Capabilities:</h4>
                  <ul>
                    {role.capabilities.map((capability, index) => (
                      <li key={index}>{capability}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
                <div className="selection-indicator">
                  {selectedRoles.includes(role.id) ? '✓' : '+'}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          
          <h3>Team Composition</h3>
          <div className="team-composition">
            <DragDropContext onDragEnd={onDragEnd}>
              <Droppable droppableId="team-roles" direction="horizontal">
                {(provided) => (

                                      e.stopPropagation();

                                    {isConfigOpen[roleId] ? '▲' : '▼'}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import axios from 'axios';

interface Agent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  avatar?: string;
  description: string;
  model: string;
  capabilities: string[];
  active: boolean;
  performance?: {
    tasksCompleted: number;
    successRate: number;
  };
}

interface Team {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  model_tier: string;
  budget_limit: number;
  budget_used: number;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  agents: Agent[];
}

const TeamManagement: React.FC = () => {
  const { teamId } = useParams<{ teamId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [team, setTeam] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'overview' | 'agents' | 'settings'>('agents');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTeamData = async () => {
      if (!teamId) return;
      
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        // In a real implementation, this would be a real API call
        // For now, using mock data
        const response = await axios.get(`/api/teams/${teamId}`);
        setTeam(response.data);
        setError('');
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load team data');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchTeamData();
  }, [teamId]);

  const handleBack = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="loading-container">
        <div className="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading team data...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="error-container">
        <h2>Error</h2>
        <p>{error}</p>
        <button onClick={handleBack} className="back-button">
          Go Back
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="team-management-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <button onClick={handleBack} className="back-button">
          &larr; Back
        </button>
        <h1>Team Management</h1>
      </div>

      {team ? (
        <>
          <div className="team-info">
            <h2>{team.name}</h2>
            <p>{team.description}</p>

            <div className="team-stats">
              <div className="stat-card">
                <h3>Model Tier</h3>
                <div className="stat-value">{team.model_tier}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="stat-card">
                <h3>Budget</h3>
                <div className="stat-value">
                  ${team.budget_used.toFixed(2)} / ${team.budget_limit.toFixed(2)}
                </div>
                <div className="progress-container">
                  <div className="progress-bar">
                    <div 
                      className="progress-fill" 
                      style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (team.budget_used / team.budget_limit) * 100)}%` }}
                    ></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="stat-card">
                <h3>Agents</h3>
                <div className="stat-value">{team.agents.length}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="tabs">
            <button 
              className={`tab ${activeTab === 'overview' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('overview')}
            >
              Overview
            </button>
            <button 
              className={`tab ${activeTab === 'agents' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('agents')}
            >
              AI Agents
            </button>
            <button 
              className={`tab ${activeTab === 'settings' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('settings')}
            >
              Settings
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="tab-content">
            {activeTab === 'overview' && (
              <div className="overview-content">
                <h3>Team Overview</h3>
                <p>Created: {new Date(team.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                <p>Last updated: {new Date(team.updated_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                {/* Additional team overview information would go here */}
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === 'agents' && (
              <div className="agents-content">
                <h3>Team AI Agents</h3>
                <div className="agent-cards">
                  {team.agents.map(agent => (
                    <div key={agent.id} className="agent-card" onClick={() => navigate(`/agents/${agent.id}`)}>
                      <div className="agent-avatar">
                        {agent.avatar ? (
                          <img src={agent.avatar} alt={agent.name} className="agent-avatar-img" />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="avatar-placeholder">
                            {agent.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="agent-info">
                        <h3>{agent.name}</h3>
                        <span className="agent-role">{agent.role}</span>
                        {agent.performance && (
                          <div className="agent-stats">
                            <div className="stat">
                              <span className="stat-label">Tasks</span>
                              <span className="stat-value">{agent.performance.tasksCompleted}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="stat">
                              <span className="stat-label">Success</span>
                              <span className="stat-value">{(agent.performance.successRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="agent-status">
                          <span className={`status-indicator ${agent.active ? 'active' : 'inactive'}`}></span>
                          <span>{agent.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === 'settings' && (
              <div className="settings-content">
                <h3>Team Settings</h3>
                <div className="form-container">
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label htmlFor="team-name">Team Name</label>
                    <input type="text" id="team-name" value={team.name} readOnly />
                  </div>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label htmlFor="team-description">Description</label>
                    <textarea id="team-description" value={team.description} readOnly rows={3}></textarea>
                  </div>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label htmlFor="model-tier">Model Tier</label>
                    <select id="model-tier" value={team.model_tier} disabled>
                      <option value="basic">Basic</option>

                  </div>
                  <button className="btn btn-primary">Edit Team</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

      ) : (

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import axios from 'axios';
import { websocketService, screenshotService } from '../services';
import { ScreenshotTool } from '../components/ScreenshotTool';

interface Team {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  roles: string[];
  model_tier: string;
  budget_limit: number;
}

interface File {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'file' | 'directory';
  path: string;
  children?: File[];
}

interface Message {
  id: string;
  agent: string;
  content: string;
  timestamp: string;
  type: 'text' | 'code' | 'system';
}

const Workspace: React.FC = () => {
  const { teamId } = useParams<{ teamId: string }>();
  const [team, setTeam] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [activeFile, setActiveFile] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fileContent, setFileContent] = useState<string>('');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
  const [taskInput, setTaskInput] = useState('');
  const [isTaskSubmitting, setIsTaskSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [latestScreenshotPath, setLatestScreenshotPath] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTeamData = async () => {
      try {
        const [teamResponse, filesResponse] = await Promise.all([
          axios.get(`/api/teams/${teamId}`),
          axios.get(`/api/teams/${teamId}/files`)
        ]);
        
        setTeam(teamResponse.data);
        setFiles(filesResponse.data);
        
        // Also fetch recent messages
        const messagesResponse = await axios.get(`/api/teams/${teamId}/messages`);
        setMessages(messagesResponse.data);
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load workspace data');
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    if (!teamId) return;

    fetchTeamData();

    // Set up real-time message updates using WebSocket
    websocketService.connect();
    
    websocketService.onConnect(() => {
      console.log('WebSocket connected');
      if (teamId) {
        websocketService.joinTeam(teamId);
      }
    });

    websocketService.onMessage('message', (message: Message) => {
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, message]);
    });

    websocketService.onMessage('file_updated', (data: { path: string, content: string }) => {
      if (data.path === activeFile) {
        setFileContent(data.content);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      websocketService.disconnect();
    };
  }, [teamId, activeFile]);

  const handleFileSelect = async (filePath: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`/api/teams/${teamId}/files/${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}/content`);
      setActiveFile(filePath);
      setFileContent(response.data.content);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load file content', err);
    }
  };

  const handleTaskSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (taskInput.trim() === '') return;
    
    setIsTaskSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      await axios.post(`/api/teams/${teamId}/tasks`, {
        goal: taskInput,
        complexity: 'M', // Default complexity
        budget: team?.budget_limit || 10
      });
      
      setTaskInput('');
      
      // Add a system message showing the task was submitted
      const newMessage: Message = {
        id: `system-${Date.now()}`,
        agent: 'System',
        content: `Task submitted: ${taskInput}`,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        type: 'system'
      };
      
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, newMessage]);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to submit task');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setIsTaskSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleScreenshotTaken = async (path: string) => {
    setLatestScreenshotPath(path);
    
    // Add a system message showing a screenshot was captured
    const newMessage: Message = {
      id: `screenshot-${Date.now()}`,
      agent: 'System',
      content: `UI Screenshot captured: ${path}`,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      type: 'system'
    };
    
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, newMessage]);
    
    // Notify agents about the screenshot
    try {
      await axios.post(`/api/screenshots`, {
        path,
        teamId,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        context: {
          url: window.location.href,

--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\src\services\api.ts ---
import axios, { AxiosRequestConfig, AxiosResponse, AxiosError } from 'axios';
import { API_BASE_URL, AUTH_TOKEN_KEY } from '../config';

// Create axios instance with base configuration
const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
});

// Add request interceptor for authentication
api.interceptors.request.use(
  (config: AxiosRequestConfig) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
    if (token && config.headers) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error: AxiosError) => {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

// Add response interceptor for error handling
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response: AxiosResponse) => {
    return response;
  },
  (error: AxiosError) => {
    // Handle authentication errors
    if (error.response && error.response.status === 401) {
      localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
      window.location.href = '/login';
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export default api; 


--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\src\services\auth.ts ---
import api from './api';
import { AUTH_TOKEN_KEY } from '../config';
import { AxiosError } from 'axios';

interface LoginCredentials {
  username: string;
  password: string;
}

interface LoginResponse {
  token: string;
  user: {
    id: string;
    username: string;
    email: string;
    role: string;
  };
}

interface ErrorResponse {
  response?: {
    status: number;
  };
}

const AuthService = {
  /**
   * Login user with credentials
   */
  async login(credentials: LoginCredentials): Promise<LoginResponse> {
    try {
      const response = await api.post<LoginResponse>('/auth/login', credentials);
      const { token, user } = response.data;
      
      // Store token in localStorage
      localStorage.setItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, token);
      
      return response.data;
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Logout current user
   */
  logout(): void {
    localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
    // Optionally, notify the server about logout
    api.post('/auth/logout').catch((error: AxiosError) => {
      console.error('Logout error:', error);
    });
  },
  
  /**
   * Check if user is authenticated
   */
  isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    return !!localStorage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
  },
  
  /**
   * Get current user profile
   */
  async getCurrentUser() {
    if (!this.isAuthenticated()) {
      return null;
    }
    
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/auth/me');
      return response.data;
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      // If profile fetch fails, user might not be authenticated
      const err = error as ErrorResponse;
      if (err.response && err.response.status === 401) {
        this.logout();
      }
      return null;
    }
  }
};

export default AuthService;

import axios from 'axios';

// This mock service intercepts axios requests and returns mock data
const setupMockService = () => {
  // Check if we should use mock data (dev environment or specified in query params)
  const useMockData = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || 
                    window.location.search.includes('mock=true');
  
  if (useMockData) {
    // Setup axios interceptor for GET requests
    axios.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
      if (config.method?.toLowerCase() === 'get') {
        const mockEndpoint = `/mock-api${config.url}.json`;
        try {
          console.log(`Using mock data from: ${mockEndpoint}`);
          config.url = mockEndpoint;
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn(`No mock data found for: ${config.url}`);
        }
      }
      return config;
    });

    // Setup axios interceptor for POST requests (just return success with mock ID)
    axios.interceptors.response.use(
      response => response,
      async (error) => {
        // Only handle errors from POST requests in mock mode
        if (error.config.method?.toLowerCase() === 'post') {
          console.log(`Mock POST response for: ${error.config.url}`);
          return {
            data: { 
              id: `mock-${Date.now()}`,
              success: true
            }
          };
        }
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
    );
  }
};

export default setupMockService;

// This file simulates WebSocket behavior for local development
class MockWebSocket {
  private listeners: Record<string, ((data: any) => void)[]> = {};
  private teamId: string | null = null;
  private connected: boolean = false;
  private mockMessages = [
    {
      id: "auto-msg-1",
      agent: "Manager",
      content: "I'm analyzing the current task...",
      timestamp: "",
      type: "text"
    },
    {
      id: "auto-msg-2",
      agent: "Planner",
      content: "Based on our current progress, I recommend we focus on implementing the shopping cart functionality next.",
      timestamp: "",
      type: "text"
    },
    {
      id: "auto-msg-3",
      agent: "Coder",
      content: "I'll start working on the ShoppingCart component. It will need to handle adding/removing items and updating quantities.",
      timestamp: "",
      type: "text"
    },
    {
      id: "auto-msg-4",
      agent: "Tester",
      content: "I'll prepare test cases for the shopping cart, focusing on edge cases like empty cart, item quantity limits, and price calculations.",
      timestamp: "",
      type: "text"
    }
  ];
  private messageInterval: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  
  constructor() {
    console.log("Mock WebSocket initialized");
  }
  
  public connect(url: string): void {
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.connected = true;
      this.emit('connect', {});
      console.log("Mock WebSocket connected");
    }, 500);
  }
  
  public on(event: string, callback: (data: any) => void): void {
    if (!this.listeners[event]) {
      this.listeners[event] = [];
    }
    this.listeners[event].push(callback);
  }
  
  public emit(event: string, data: any): void {
    if (this.listeners[event]) {
      this.listeners[event].forEach(callback => callback(data));
    }
  }
  
  public joinTeam(teamId: string): void {
    this.teamId = teamId;
    console.log(`Joined team: ${teamId}`);
    this.startMockMessageStream();
  }
  
  private startMockMessageStream(): void {
    if (this.messageInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.messageInterval);
    }
    
    let messageIndex = 0;
    
    // Send a message every 10-20 seconds
    this.messageInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.connected || !this.teamId) return;
      
      const message = {...this.mockMessages[messageIndex]};
      message.timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
      message.id = `auto-msg-${Date.now()}`;
      
      this.emit('message', message);
      
      messageIndex = (messageIndex + 1) % this.mockMessages.length;
    }, Math.random() * 10000 + 10000); // Between 10 and 20 seconds
  }
  
  public disconnect(): void {
    this.connected = false;
    if (this.messageInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.messageInterval);
      this.messageInterval = null;
    }
    console.log("Mock WebSocket disconnected");
  }
  
  public isConnected(): boolean {
    return this.connected;
  }
}

export default MockWebSocket;
