import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/tauri';
import { appWindow } from '@tauri-apps/api/window';
import { save } from '@tauri-apps/api/dialog';
import { writeTextFile, createDir, exists, readDir } from '@tauri-apps/api/fs';
import { desktopDir, join } from '@tauri-apps/api/path';
import html2canvas from 'html2canvas';

interface ScreenshotOptions {
  captureActiveElement?: boolean;
  includeMetadata?: boolean;
  quality?: number;
}

interface ScreenshotMetadata {
  timestamp: string;
  url: string;
  viewport: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };
  elementSelector?: string;
}

/**
 * Service for capturing screenshots of the UI for agent awareness
 */
export class ScreenshotService {
  private readonly screenshotsFolder = 'hive-mind-screenshots';
  private initialized = false;
  
  constructor() {
    this.init();
  }
  
  private async init() {
    try {
      // Create screenshots directory if it doesn't exist
      const desktopPath = await desktopDir();
      const screenshotsPath = await join(desktopPath, this.screenshotsFolder);
      
      if (!(await exists(screenshotsPath))) {
        await createDir(screenshotsPath, { recursive: true });
      }
      
      this.initialized = true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to initialize screenshot service:', error);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Captures a screenshot of the current UI
   */
  async captureFullScreen(options: ScreenshotOptions = {}): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.init();
    
    try {
      // Use html2canvas to capture the full page
      const canvas = await html2canvas(document.body, {
        scale: 1,
        useCORS: true,
        logging: false,
        allowTaint: true,
        ...options
      });
      
      const screenshotData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      const filePath = await this.saveScreenshot(screenshotData, options);
      return filePath;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to capture screenshot:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Captures a specific element in the UI
   */
  async captureElement(selector: string, options: ScreenshotOptions = {}): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.init();
    
    try {
      const element = document.querySelector(selector);
      if (!element) {
        console.error(`Element with selector ${selector} not found`);
        return null;
      }
      
      // Use html2canvas to capture the element
      const screenshotData = await this.captureElementToDataUrl(element as HTMLElement);
      
      const filePath = await this.saveScreenshot(
        screenshotData, 
        { ...options, captureActiveElement: true }
      );
      return filePath;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to capture element screenshot:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }
  
  private async captureElementToDataUrl(element: HTMLElement): Promise<string> {
    const canvas = await html2canvas(element, {
      scale: 1,
      useCORS: true,
      logging: false,
      allowTaint: true
    });
    
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  }
  
  private async saveScreenshot(
    dataUrl: string, 
    options: ScreenshotOptions
  ): Promise<string> {
    const desktopPath = await desktopDir();
    const screenshotsPath = await join(desktopPath, this.screenshotsFolder);
    
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/:/g, '-');
    const filename = `screenshot-${timestamp}.png`;
    const filePath = await join(screenshotsPath, filename);
    
    // Convert data URL to blob data
    const base64Data = dataUrl.replace(/^data:image\/\w+;base64,/, '');
    
    // Save metadata if requested
    if (options.includeMetadata) {
      const metadata: ScreenshotMetadata = {
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        url: window.location.href,
        viewport: {
          width: window.innerWidth,
          height: window.innerHeight
        },
        elementSelector: options.captureActiveElement ? document.activeElement?.tagName : undefined
      };
      
      const metadataFilePath = await join(screenshotsPath, `screenshot-${timestamp}.json`);
      await writeTextFile(metadataFilePath, JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2));
    }
    
    // Save the screenshot
    await writeTextFile(filePath, base64Data, { append: false });
    
    console.log(`Screenshot saved to ${filePath}`);
    return filePath;
  }
  
  /**
   * Provides the latest screenshot to agents
   */
  async getLatestScreenshotForAgent(): Promise<{ path: string; base64Data?: string } | null> {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.init();
    
    try {
      const desktopPath = await desktopDir();
      const screenshotsPath = await join(desktopPath, this.screenshotsFolder);
      
      // Read the directory to find all screenshots
      const entries = await readDir(screenshotsPath);
      
      // Filter for PNG files and sort by creation time (filename contains timestamp)
      const pngFiles = entries
        .filter(entry => entry.name && entry.name.endsWith('.png'))
        .sort((a, b) => {
          // Sort in descending order (newest first)
          return (b.name || '').localeCompare(a.name || '');
        });
      
      if (pngFiles.length === 0) {
        return null;
      }
      
      // Return the most recent screenshot
      const latestScreenshot = pngFiles[0];
      return { 
        path: latestScreenshot.path
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to get latest screenshot:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }
}

export const screenshotService = new ScreenshotService();

import { WS_URL, AUTH_TOKEN_KEY } from '../config';
import MockWebSocket from './mockWebSocket';

type MessageHandler = (data: any) => void;
type ConnectionHandler = () => void;

class WebSocketService {
  private socket: WebSocket | null = null;
  private mockSocket: MockWebSocket | null = null;
  private messageHandlers: Map<string, MessageHandler[]> = new Map();
  private onConnectHandlers: ConnectionHandler[] = [];
  private onDisconnectHandlers: ConnectionHandler[] = [];
  private reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private isConnecting = false;
  private useMockSocket = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || window.location.search.includes('mock=true');

  constructor() {
    this.connect = this.connect.bind(this);
    this.disconnect = this.disconnect.bind(this);
    this.send = this.send.bind(this);
    this.onMessage = this.onMessage.bind(this);
    this.onConnect = this.onConnect.bind(this);
    this.onDisconnect = this.onDisconnect.bind(this);
    this.handleMessage = this.handleMessage.bind(this);
    this.joinTeam = this.joinTeam.bind(this);
  }

  connect(): void {
    if (this.useMockSocket) {
      console.log('Using mock WebSocket');
      this.connectMock();
      return;
    }

    if (this.socket && (this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN || this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING)) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.isConnecting) {
      return;
    }

    this.isConnecting = true;

    const token = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
    const url = token ? `${WS_URL}?token=${token}` : WS_URL;
    
    this.socket = new WebSocket(url);
    
    this.socket.onopen = () => {
      this.isConnecting = false;
      this.onConnectHandlers.forEach(handler => handler());
      
      if (this.reconnectTimer) {
        clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
        this.reconnectTimer = null;
      }
    };
    
    this.socket.onclose = () => {
      this.isConnecting = false;
      this.onDisconnectHandlers.forEach(handler => handler());
      
      if (!this.reconnectTimer) {
        this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          this.connect();
        }, 3000);
      }
    };
    
    this.socket.onmessage = (event) => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
        this.handleMessage(data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing WebSocket message:', error);
      }
    };
    
    this.socket.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
      this.isConnecting = false;
    };
  }
  
  private connectMock(): void {
    if (this.mockSocket) {
      return;
    }
    
    this.mockSocket = new MockWebSocket();
    
    this.mockSocket.on('connect', () => {
      this.onConnectHandlers.forEach(handler => handler());
    });
    
    this.mockSocket.on('message', (message) => {
      this.handleMessage({ type: 'message', payload: message });
    });
    
    this.mockSocket.connect(WS_URL);
  }
  
  joinTeam(teamId: string): void {
    if (this.useMockSocket && this.mockSocket) {
      this.mockSocket.joinTeam(teamId);
      return;
    }
    
    this.send('join_team', { team_id: teamId });
  }
  
  disconnect(): void {
    if (this.useMockSocket && this.mockSocket) {
      this.mockSocket.disconnect();
      this.mockSocket = null;
      return;
    }
    
    if (this.socket) {
      this.socket.close();
      this.socket = null;
    }
    
    if (this.reconnectTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
      this.reconnectTimer = null;
    }
  }
  
  send(type: string, payload: any): boolean {
    if (this.useMockSocket && this.mockSocket) {
      this.mockSocket.emit(type, payload);
      return true;
    }
    
    if (!this.socket || this.socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
      return false;
    }
    
    this.socket.send(JSON.stringify({ type, payload }));
    return true;
  }
  
  onMessage(type: string, handler: MessageHandler): () => void {
    if (!this.messageHandlers.has(type)) {
      this.messageHandlers.set(type, []);
    }
    
    const handlers = this.messageHandlers.get(type)!;
    handlers.push(handler);
    
    return () => {
      const index = handlers.indexOf(handler);
      if (index !== -1) {
        handlers.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }
  
  onConnect(handler: ConnectionHandler): () => void {
    this.onConnectHandlers.push(handler);
    
    return () => {
      const index = this.onConnectHandlers.indexOf(handler);
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.onConnectHandlers.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }
  
  onDisconnect(handler: ConnectionHandler): () => void {
    this.onDisconnectHandlers.push(handler);
    
    return () => {
      const index = this.onDisconnectHandlers.indexOf(handler);
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.onDisconnectHandlers.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }
  
  private handleMessage(data: { type: string; payload: any }): void {
    if (!data || !data.type) {
      return;
    }
    
    const handlers = this.messageHandlers.get(data.type);
    if (handlers) {
      handlers.forEach(handler => handler(data.payload));
    }
  }
}

// Create singleton instance
const websocketService = new WebSocketService();

export default websocketService;

  const newTag = { ...tag, id: `tag-${Date.now()}` };
  tags.push(newTag);
  return newTag;
};

export const updateTag = (id: string, tag: Partial<Omit<Tag, 'id'>>): Tag | null => {
  const index = tags.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
  if (index === -1) return null;
  
  tags[index] = { ...tags[index], ...tag };
  return tags[index];
};

export const deleteTag = (id: string): boolean => {
  const index = tags.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
  if (index === -1) return false;
  
  tags.splice(index, 1);
  return true;
};

// Entity Tag Management
export const getTaggedEntities = (): TaggedEntity[] => {
  return taggedEntities;
};

export const getEntityTags = (entityId: string): string[] => {
  const entity = taggedEntities.find(e => e.id === entityId);
  return entity ? entity.tags : [];
};

export const tagEntity = (entityId: string, entityName: string, entityType: 'workspace' | 'project', tagIds: string[]): TaggedEntity => {
  const existingIndex = taggedEntities.findIndex(e => e.id === entityId);
  
  if (existingIndex === -1) {
    const newEntity: TaggedEntity = {
      id: entityId,
      name: entityName,
      type: entityType,
      tags: tagIds
    };
    taggedEntities.push(newEntity);
    return newEntity;
  } else {
    taggedEntities[existingIndex].tags = tagIds;
    return taggedEntities[existingIndex];
  }
};

  return userAccess.find(a => a.userId === userId) || null;
};

  const existingIndex = userAccess.findIndex(a => a.userId === access.userId);
  
  if (existingIndex === -1) {
    userAccess.push(access);
    return access;
  } else {
    userAccess[existingIndex] = access;
    return access;
  }
};

  return access ? access.role : null;
};

  return true;

// Check if a user has access to an entity based on tags
export const userHasAccessToEntity = (userId: string, entityId: string): boolean => {
  const user = getUserAccess(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  
  // Admins have access to everything
  if (user.role === 'admin') return true;
  
  const entity = taggedEntities.find(e => e.id === entityId);
  if (!entity) return false;
  
  // Check if the user has any of the tags associated with the entity
  return entity.tags.some(tagId => user.tags.includes(tagId));
};

import { API_BASE_URL } from '../config';

/**
 * Checks if the API is accessible
 * @returns Promise that resolves to true if accessible, false otherwise
 */
export const checkApiConnection = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/health`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      // Timeout after 3 seconds
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000),
    });
    
    return response.ok;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('API connection check failed:', error);
    return false;
  }
};

/**
 * Displays a warning banner if the API is not accessible
 */
export const showApiWarningIfNeeded = async () => {
  try {
    const isConnected = await checkApiConnection();
    
    if (!isConnected) {
      const warningDiv = document.createElement('div');
      warningDiv.style.position = 'fixed';
      warningDiv.style.top = '0';
      warningDiv.style.left = '0';
      warningDiv.style.right = '0';
      warningDiv.style.backgroundColor = '#FFA500';
      warningDiv.style.color = '#000';
      warningDiv.style.padding = '10px';
      warningDiv.style.textAlign = 'center';
      warningDiv.style.zIndex = '9999';
      warningDiv.innerHTML = `
        <strong>Warning:</strong> Unable to connect to the backend API at <code>${API_BASE_URL}</code>. 
        The UI will use mock data for demonstration purposes. Some features may not work properly.
      `;
      
      document.body.appendChild(warningDiv);
      
      // Enable mock API data automatically
      window.localStorage.setItem('USE_MOCK_API', 'true');
      (window as any).USE_MOCK_API = true;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in API warning check:', error);
    // Ensure UI doesn't block even if this check fails
    window.localStorage.setItem('USE_MOCK_API', 'true');
    (window as any).USE_MOCK_API = true;
  }
};

/**
 * Use this function to get either mock data or real data
 * based on API availability
 * @param mockData Mock data to return if API is not available
 * @param apiFn Function to call to get real data
 */
export const getDataWithFallback = async <T>(mockData: T, apiFn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
  if ((window as any).USE_MOCK_API || window.localStorage.getItem('USE_MOCK_API') === 'true') {
    return Promise.resolve(mockData);
  }
  
  try {
    return await apiFn();
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('API call failed, using mock data:', error);
    window.localStorage.setItem('USE_MOCK_API', 'true');
    (window as any).USE_MOCK_API = true;
    return mockData;
  }
};

--- FILE: C:\Users\urib9\projects\Hive mind\vscode-hive-mind-extension\extension.js ---
const vscode = require('vscode');
const axios = require('axios');
const io = require('socket.io-client');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');

const autoConnect = true;

let socket = null;
let statusBarItem = null;
let backendUrl = 'http://localhost:5000';
let connectionStatus = 'Disconnected';
let clientId = null;
let fileChangeTimeout = null;
let pendingChanges = new Map();
let currentContext = {
  branch: null,
  commit: null
};

/**
 * Activate the extension
 * @param {vscode.ExtensionContext} context
 */
function activate(context) {
  console.log('Hive Mind extension is now active');

  // Create status bar item
  statusBarItem = vscode.window.createStatusBarItem(vscode.StatusBarAlignment.Left, 100);
  statusBarItem.text = '$(cloud) Hive Mind: Disconnected';
  statusBarItem.tooltip = 'Click to show Hive Mind status';
  statusBarItem.command = 'hivemind.showStatus';
  statusBarItem.show();
  
  // Register commands
  const connectCmd = vscode.commands.registerCommand('hivemind.connect', connectToBackend);
  const disconnectCmd = vscode.commands.registerCommand('hivemind.disconnect', disconnectFromBackend);
  const statusCmd = vscode.commands.registerCommand('hivemind.showStatus', showStatus);
  const connectCustomCmd = vscode.commands.registerCommand('hivemind.connectCustom', connectToCustomBackend);
  const grantPermissionCmd = vscode.commands.registerCommand('hivemind.grantPermission', grantPermission);
  const denyPermissionCmd = vscode.commands.registerCommand('hivemind.denyPermission', denyPermission);
  
  context.subscriptions.push(connectCmd);
  context.subscriptions.push(disconnectCmd);
  context.subscriptions.push(statusCmd);
  context.subscriptions.push(connectCustomCmd);
  context.subscriptions.push(grantPermissionCmd);
  context.subscriptions.push(denyPermissionCmd);
  context.subscriptions.push(statusBarItem);
  
  // Register file change listeners
  const fileWatcher = vscode.workspace.createFileSystemWatcher('**/*');
  fileWatcher.onDidChange(handleFileChange);
  fileWatcher.onDidCreate(handleFileChange);
  fileWatcher.onDidDelete(handleFileDelete);
  context.subscriptions.push(fileWatcher);
  
  // Auto-connect if enabled in settings or by default
  const config = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('hivemind');
  if ((config && config.get('autoConnect')) || autoConnect) {
    // Connect with a slight delay to ensure VS Code is fully loaded
    setTimeout(connectToBackend, 3000);
  }
}

/**
 * Handle file changes by sending to backend
 * @param {vscode.Uri} uri 
 */
async function handleFileChange(uri) {
  // Skip if not connected
  if (!socket || !clientId) return;
  
  try {
    const filePath = uri.fsPath;
    const workspaceFolder = vscode.workspace.getWorkspaceFolder(uri);
    if (!workspaceFolder) return;
    
    const relativePath = path.relative(workspaceFolder.uri.fsPath, filePath);
    
    // Skip node_modules, .git, and other standard ignore patterns
    if (
      relativePath.includes('node_modules') || 
      relativePath.includes('.git') ||
      relativePath.startsWith('dist/') ||
      relativePath.startsWith('build/')
    ) {
      return;
    }
    
    // Read file content
    const content = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath, 'utf8').catch(err => null);
    if (content === null) return; // File might have been deleted or is binary
    
    // Add to pending changes
    pendingChanges.set(relativePath, {
      path: relativePath,
      content,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      event: 'change'
    });
    
    // Debounce sending changes
    if (fileChangeTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(fileChangeTimeout);
    }
    
    fileChangeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      sendPendingChanges();
    }, 3000); // Wait 3 seconds to batch changes
    
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error handling file change:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Handle file deletion
 * @param {vscode.Uri} uri 
 */
function handleFileDelete(uri) {
  // Skip if not connected
  if (!socket || !clientId) return;
  
  try {
    const filePath = uri.fsPath;
    const workspaceFolder = vscode.workspace.getWorkspaceFolder(uri);
    if (!workspaceFolder) return;
    
    const relativePath = path.relative(workspaceFolder.uri.fsPath, filePath);
    
    // Skip node_modules, .git, and other standard ignore patterns
    if (
      relativePath.includes('node_modules') || 
      relativePath.includes('.git') ||
      relativePath.startsWith('dist/') ||
      relativePath.startsWith('build/')
    ) {
      return;
    }
    
    // Add to pending changes
    pendingChanges.set(relativePath, {
      path: relativePath,
      content: null,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      event: 'delete'
    });
    
    // Debounce sending changes
    if (fileChangeTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(fileChangeTimeout);
    }
    
    fileChangeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      sendPendingChanges();
    }, 3000); // Wait 3 seconds to batch changes
    
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error handling file deletion:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Send pending changes to backend
 */
async function sendPendingChanges() {
  if (pendingChanges.size === 0 || !socket || !clientId) return;
  
  try {
    const changes = Array.from(pendingChanges.values());
    pendingChanges.clear();
    
    console.log(`Sending ${changes.length} file changes to backend`);
    
    socket.emit('file-changes', {
      clientId,
      changes,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error sending file changes:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Grant permission to the backend
 */
async function grantPermission() {
  if (!clientId) {
    vscode.window.showErrorMessage('Not connected to Hive Mind backend');
    return;
  }
  
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(`${backendUrl}/api/vscode/permission`, {
      clientId,
      allowed: true,
      reason: 'User manually granted permission'
    });
    
    vscode.window.showInformationMessage('Permission granted to Hive Mind backend');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error granting permission:', error);
    vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Failed to grant permission: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Deny permission to the backend
 */
async function denyPermission() {
  if (!clientId) {
    vscode.window.showErrorMessage('Not connected to Hive Mind backend');
    return;
  }
  
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(`${backendUrl}/api/vscode/permission`, {
      clientId,
      allowed: false,
      reason: 'User manually denied permission'
    });
    
    vscode.window.showInformationMessage('Permission denied to Hive Mind backend');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error denying permission:', error);
    vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Failed to deny permission: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Connect to a custom backend URL specified by the user
 */
async function connectToCustomBackend() {
  try {
    // First disconnect if already connected
    if (socket) {
      await disconnectFromBackend();
    }
    
    // Prompt user for backend URL
    const inputUrl = await vscode.window.showInputBox({
      prompt: 'Enter the Hive Mind backend URL',
      placeHolder: 'http://localhost:5000',
      value: backendUrl
    });
    
    if (!inputUrl) {
      return; // User cancelled
    }
    
    // Update the backend URL
    backendUrl = inputUrl;
    
    // Save the URL to user settings
    const config = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('hivemind');
    await config.update('backendUrl', backendUrl, vscode.ConfigurationTarget.Global);
    
    // Connect to the specified backend
    await connectToBackend();
    
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error connecting to custom backend:', error);
    vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Failed to connect to custom backend: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Connect to the backend server
 */
async function connectToBackend() {
  try {
    console.log('Connecting to Hive Mind backend at ' + backendUrl);
    
    // Check if there's a Git repository in the workspace
    const gitExtension = vscode.extensions.getExtension('vscode.git')?.exports;
    const api = gitExtension?.getAPI(1);
    
    if (!api || api.repositories.length === 0) {
      vscode.window.showErrorMessage('No Git repository found in the current workspace.');
      return;
    }
    
    // Register with backend
    const workspaceFolders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders;
    const workspaceName = workspaceFolders && workspaceFolders.length > 0 
      ? workspaceFolders[0].name 
      : 'unknown';
    
    console.log('Registering with backend...');
    console.log('Workspace name: ' + workspaceName);
    console.log('Current branch: ' + (api.repositories[0].state.HEAD?.name || 'unknown'));
    
    try {
      const registration = await axios.post(`${backendUrl}/api/vscode/register`, {
        workspaceName,
        workspacePath: workspaceFolders[0].uri.fsPath,
        initialBranch: api.repositories[0].state.HEAD?.name || 'unknown'
      });
      
      clientId = registration.data.clientId;
      console.log('Registered with clientId: ' + clientId);
      
      // Connect to WebSocket
      console.log('Connecting to WebSocket...');
      socket = io(backendUrl, {
        query: {
          clientId
        }
      });
      
      // Listen for Git commands
      socket.on('connect', () => {
        console.log('WebSocket connected!');
        connectionStatus = 'Connected';
        statusBarItem.text = `$(cloud) Hive Mind: Connected`;
        vscode.window.showInformationMessage(`Connected to Hive Mind backend at ${backendUrl}`);
        
        // Prompt for permission at the start of the session
        promptForPermission();
      });
      
      socket.on('disconnect', () => {
        console.log('WebSocket disconnected!');
        connectionStatus = 'Disconnected';
        statusBarItem.text = `$(cloud) Hive Mind: Disconnected`;
      });
      
      socket.on('checkout', async (data) => {
        try {
          console.log('Received checkout command:', data);
          // Handle branch & commit checkout command
          await executeGitCommand(data.branch, data.commit);
          
          // Update current context
          currentContext.branch = data.branch;
          currentContext.commit = data.commit;
          
          // Send acknowledgment back to server
          socket.emit('checkout-result', {
            success: true,
            branch: data.branch,
            commit: data.commit
          });
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error during checkout:', error);
          socket.emit('checkout-result', {
            success: false,
            error: error.message
          });
        }
      });
      
      // Message from backend for the user
      socket.on('user-message', (data) => {
        try {
          console.log('Received user message:', data);
          vscode.window.showInformationMessage(data.message, ...(data.actions || []));
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error showing user message:', error);
        }
      });
      
      // Handle permission requests from the backend
      socket.on('request-permission', async (data) => {
        try {
          console.log('Received permission request:', data);
          
          // Extract request details
          const requestType = data.requestType;
          const details = data.details;
          
          let message = 'The Hive Mind backend is requesting permission to control this VS Code instance.';
          
          // Customize message based on request type
          if (requestType === 'branch-checkout') {
            message = `The Hive Mind backend wants to change your branch to "${details.branch}"`;
            if (details.commit) {
              message += ` at commit "${details.commit.substring(0, 7)}..."`;
            }
            if (details.message) {
              message += `\n\nReason: ${details.message}`;
            }
          }
          
          // Add warning about what this means
          message += '\n\nGranting permission allows the backend to control your Git branches.';
          
          // Show confirmation dialog
          const response = await vscode.window.showInformationMessage(
            message,
            { modal: true },
            'Allow',
            'Deny'
          );
          
          if (response === 'Allow') {
            // User granted permission
            socket.emit('permission-response', {
              granted: true,
              requestType: requestType,
              reason: 'User granted permission via VS Code UI'
            });
            
            vscode.window.showInformationMessage('Permission granted. The backend can now control this VS Code instance.');
            
            // If this was a checkout request, the backend will send a separate checkout command
          } else {
            // User denied or dismissed the dialog
            socket.emit('permission-response', {
              granted: false,
              requestType: requestType,
              reason: 'User denied permission via VS Code UI'
            });
            
            vscode.window.showInformationMessage('Permission denied. The backend cannot control this VS Code instance.');
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error handling permission request:', error);
          socket.emit('permission-response', {
            granted: false,
            requestType: data.requestType,
            reason: `Error: ${error.message}`
          });
        }
      });
      
      socket.on('error', (error) => {
        console.error('Socket error:', error);
        vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Hive Mind connection error: ${error}`);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Registration error:', error);
      vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Failed to register with Hive Mind backend: ${error.message}`);
    }
    
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Connection error:', error);
    vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Failed to connect to Hive Mind backend: ${error.message}`);
    connectionStatus = 'Error';
    statusBarItem.text = `$(cloud) Hive Mind: Error`;
  }
}

/**
 * Prompt the user for permission at the start of a session
 */
async function promptForPermission() {
  if (!clientId) return;
  
  try {
    // Get the client info from the backend
    const clientInfo = await axios.get(`${backendUrl}/api/vscode/client/${clientId}`);
    
    // Only show prompt if permission not yet granted
    if (!clientInfo.data.permission.allowed) {
      const message = 'Allow Hive Mind to control your VS Code instance? This includes changing Git branches and receiving your code changes for AI assistance.';
      
      const response = await vscode.window.showInformationMessage(
        message,
        { modal: true },
        'Allow',
        'Deny'
      );
      
      if (response === 'Allow') {
        await grantPermission();
      } else {
        await denyPermission();
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error prompting for permission:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Execute a Git command to change branch and/or commit
 */
async function executeGitCommand(branch, commit) {
  const gitExtension = vscode.extensions.getExtension('vscode.git')?.exports;
  const api = gitExtension?.getAPI(1);
  
  if (!api || api.repositories.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('No Git repository found in the current workspace');
  }
  
  const repo = api.repositories[0];
  
  // Check if there are unsaved changes
  const hasChanges = await vscode.workspace.saveAll();
  
  if (repo.state.workingTreeChanges.length > 0) {
    const stashChoice = await vscode.window.showWarningMessage(
      'You have uncommitted changes. Stash them before checkout?',
      { modal: true },
      'Stash Changes',
      'Force Checkout (Discard Changes)',
      'Cancel'
    );
    
    if (stashChoice === 'Stash Changes') {
      await repo.clean();
    } else if (stashChoice === 'Force Checkout (Discard Changes)') {
      // Continue with checkout (will force)
    } else {
      throw new Error('Checkout canceled due to uncommitted changes');
    }
  }
  
  // First checkout the branch
  await repo.checkout(branch);
  
  // Then checkout specific commit if provided
  if (commit) {
    await repo.checkout(commit);
  }
  
  vscode.window.showInformationMessage(`Switched to: ${branch}${commit ? ` at commit ${commit.substring(0, 7)}...` : ''}`);
}

/**
 * Disconnect from the backend
 */
function disconnectFromBackend() {
  if (socket) {
    socket.disconnect();
    socket = null;
  }
  
  connectionStatus = 'Disconnected';
  statusBarItem.text = `$(cloud) Hive Mind: Disconnected`;
  vscode.window.showInformationMessage('Disconnected from Hive Mind backend');
  
  return Promise.resolve();
}

/**
 * Show the extension status
 */
function showStatus() {
  vscode.window.showInformationMessage(
    `Hive Mind Extension Status\n` +
    `Connection: ${connectionStatus}\n` +
    `Backend URL: ${backendUrl}\n` +
    `Client ID: ${clientId || 'Not registered'}`
  );
}

/**
 * Deactivate the extension
 */
function deactivate() {
  if (socket) {
    socket.disconnect();
    socket = null;
  }
}

module.exports = {
  activate,
  deactivate
}

# PowerShell script to install the Hive Mind VS Code extension

# Determine VS Code extensions directory
$extensionsDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.vscode\extensions"
$extensionName = "vscode-hive-mind-extension"
$extensionDir = "$extensionsDir\$extensionName"

# Determine current script directory
$scriptPath = $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $scriptPath
$sourceDir = $scriptDir

Write-Host "Installing Hive Mind extension to VS Code..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Check if VS Code extensions directory exists
if (-not (Test-Path $extensionsDir)) {
    Write-Host "Creating VS Code extensions directory..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    New-Item -Path $extensionsDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
}

# Remove existing extension if it exists
if (Test-Path $extensionDir) {
    Write-Host "Removing existing Hive Mind extension..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Remove-Item -Path $extensionDir -Recurse -Force
}

# Create extension directory
Write-Host "Creating extension directory..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
New-Item -Path $extensionDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null

# Copy extension files
Write-Host "Copying extension files..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Copy-Item -Path "$sourceDir\*" -Destination $extensionDir -Recurse -Exclude "install.ps1", "node_modules"

# Install dependencies
Write-Host "Installing dependencies..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Set-Location -Path $extensionDir
npm install

Write-Host "`nHive Mind extension has been installed successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Please reload VS Code to activate the extension." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "You can do this by pressing Ctrl+Shift+P and running 'Developer: Reload Window'" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Return to the original directory
Set-Location -Path $scriptDir

#!/bin/bash

# Bash script to install the Hive Mind VS Code extension

echo -e "\e[36mInstalling Hive Mind extension to VS Code...\e[0m"

# Determine VS Code extensions directory
if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
    # macOS
    EXTENSIONS_DIR="$HOME/.vscode/extensions"
else
    # Linux
    EXTENSIONS_DIR="$HOME/.vscode/extensions"
fi

EXTENSION_NAME="vscode-hive-mind-extension"
EXTENSION_DIR="$EXTENSIONS_DIR/$EXTENSION_NAME"

# Get script directory
SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd "$( dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" &> /dev/null && pwd )"
SOURCE_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR"

# Check if VS Code extensions directory exists
if [ ! -d "$EXTENSIONS_DIR" ]; then
    echo -e "\e[33mCreating VS Code extensions directory...\e[0m"
    mkdir -p "$EXTENSIONS_DIR"
fi

# Remove existing extension if it exists
if [ -d "$EXTENSION_DIR" ]; then
    echo -e "\e[33mRemoving existing Hive Mind extension...\e[0m"
    rm -rf "$EXTENSION_DIR"
fi

# Create extension directory
echo -e "\e[33mCreating extension directory...\e[0m"
mkdir -p "$EXTENSION_DIR"

# Copy extension files
echo -e "\e[33mCopying extension files...\e[0m"
cp -R "$SOURCE_DIR"/* "$EXTENSION_DIR"
# Remove install scripts and node_modules from destination
rm -f "$EXTENSION_DIR/install.ps1" "$EXTENSION_DIR/install.sh"
rm -rf "$EXTENSION_DIR/node_modules"

# Install dependencies
echo -e "\e[33mInstalling dependencies...\e[0m"
cd "$EXTENSION_DIR"
npm install

echo -e "\n\e[32mHive Mind extension has been installed successfully!\e[0m"
echo -e "\e[32mPlease reload VS Code to activate the extension.\e[0m"
echo -e "\e[36mYou can do this by pressing Cmd+Shift+P (macOS) or Ctrl+Shift+P (Linux) and running 'Developer: Reload Window'\e[0m"

# Return to the original directory
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# Hive Mind VS Code Extension

This VS Code extension enables your backend system to control the Git branch and commit that the user sees in their VS Code workspace.

## Features

- Allows a backend service to remotely control which Git branch and commit is checked out in VS Code
- Real-time synchronization between backend commands and the VS Code workspace
- Status bar indicator showing connection status
- Commands to manually connect/disconnect from the backend

## Requirements

- VS Code 1.60.0 or higher
- Git extension for VS Code (built-in)
- A Git repository open in the workspace
- A running Hive Mind backend service

## Installation

1. Copy this extension to your `.vscode/extensions` directory or build and install from source
2. Reload VS Code
3. Configure the backend URL in settings

## Extension Settings

This extension contributes the following settings:

* `hivemind.backendUrl`: URL of the Hive Mind backend service (default: "http://localhost:5000")
* `hivemind.autoConnect`: Automatically connect to the backend on startup (default: false)

## Commands

* `Hive Mind: Connect to Backend`: Connect to the backend service
* `Hive Mind: Disconnect from Backend`: Disconnect from the backend service
* `Hive Mind: Show Connection Status`: Display current connection status

## Setting Up the Backend API

To use this extension, you need to implement the following API endpoints in your backend:

### 1. Registration Endpoint

```
POST /api/vscode/register
```

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "workspaceName": "project-name",
  "workspacePath": "/path/to/workspace",
  "initialBranch": "main"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "clientId": "unique-client-id"
}
```

### 2. WebSocket Events

The backend should use Socket.IO to send events to the VS Code client:

**Checkout event:**
```javascript
socket.emit('checkout', {
  branch: "feature/new-feature",
  commit: "a1b2c3d4e5f6" // Optional, if null will checkout the latest commit
});
```

**Response from client:**
```javascript
socket.on('checkout-result', (result) => {
  // result = { success: true, branch: "feature/new-feature", commit: "a1b2c3d4e5f6" }
  // or 
  // result = { success: false, error: "Error message" }
});
```

## Security Considerations

- The extension should only be used in trusted environments
- Consider implementing authentication for the WebSocket connection
- Be aware that allowing remote control of Git operations could potentially lead to data loss if misused
